--- transit-dash/NOTES.md ---
# Transit Dash
Controls: swipe left/right = change track, swipe up (or tap) = vault, swipe down = slide. Keyboard: arrows/WASD, Space = vault, P/Esc = pause, R = restart, M = mute.
Loop: 3-lane endless run through a seeded daily transit route — vault rail cars, slide under barriers, dodge signal blocks, hit green ramps for the high-value rooftop coin arc.
Pickups: magnet, grind board (absorbs one hit), double fare. Stumble once and the inspector tails you for 13s; stumble again while he's there and you're caught.
Missions: 3 daily mission chains run in the background; clearing one banks tokens AND rotates the live route theme (rail yard -> rooftop line -> deep tunnel), which regenerates the track ahead.
Persistence: best distance, banked tokens, mission tiers and current route theme are stored in localStorage.

--- parlor-pop/NOTES.md ---
# Parlor Pop

Controls: swipe (or tap tile, then tap a neighbour) to swap. Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter selects/swaps, Esc backs out, 1/2/3 arm a booster, R restarts.
Loop: match 3+ tiles to hit each level's goals (collect a colour, smash plated floor, drop keys to the floor) before the moves run out. Crates and ivy break when a match lands beside them; ivy spreads if you ignore it.
Out of moves = instant retry, no lives and no waiting. Stars from finishing with moves to spare fund three restored parlor rooms; each slot offers two furnishings and the choice persists.
Boosters (hammer / row rocket / shuffle) are earned only by 3-star finishes and never cost money; every level is clearable without them.
Build check: `node verify.js` replays each level 200x with a greedy solver; `--fix` raises move budgets until all clear >=90%.

# Emberline Outpost

Drag a card from the tray onto a tile and flick before releasing: the flick sets the defender's FACING, which rotates its firing footprint. Tap a placed defender for its skill / scrap button.
Loop: hold 8 maps of ground-lane + air waves. Deploy charge regenerates in-map and drops from kills; leak too many enemies through the outpost gate and the map is lost. Clearing maps 1-4 unlocks 2 of the 10 defenders each, and every clear pays salvage.
Between maps, the Workshop crafts deploy kits from salvage into unlockable slots (charge, regen, leak cap, hull, cooldown, salvage rate) — all play-earned, nothing purchasable.
Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, Q/E pick a card, R rotates facing, Space places or selects, Enter fires the skill, X scraps, P pauses, F toggles 2x speed.
Progress, roster, kits and per-map best score persist locally; map 8 is the win.

# Molehunt Manor
Ten staff work a 16-room manor; two are moles who fake tasks and sabotage. Six rounds.

    14	// Cheap heuristic: how much does this swap advance the goals?
    15	function score(st, mv) {
    16	  st.rawSwap(mv[0], mv[1], mv[2], mv[3]);
    17	  var runs = st.findMatches(), p = 0;
    18	  for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
    19	    var r = runs[i], j, w = 1;
    20	    for (j = 0; j < st.goals.length; j++) {
    21	      var g = st.goals[j];
    22	      if (g.have >= g.need) continue;
    23	      if (g.type === 'collect' && g.color === r.c) w = 4;
    24	    }
    25	    p += r.len * w;
    26	    if (r.len >= 4) p += 6;
    27	    // reward clearing plates and cells under keys / beside blockers
    28	    for (j = 0; j < r.len; j++) {
    29	      var cx = r.h ? r.x + j : r.x, cy = r.h ? r.y : r.y + j;
    30	      var cc = st.at(cx, cy);
    31	      if (cc.plate) p += 5;
    32	      for (var k = cy - 1; k >= 0; k--) { if (st.at(cx, k).key) { p += 45; break; } }
    33	      var d = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]];
    34	      for (var q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
    35	        var nx = cx + d[q][0], ny = cy + d[q][1];
    36	        if (st.inb(nx, ny) && st.at(nx, ny).b) {

    38	          // a blocker sitting under a key is worth a lot more

    48	function playout(level, r) {
    49	  var st = new E.State(level);
    50	  st.settle();
    51	  var guard = 0;
    52	  while (st.over === 0 && guard++ < 400) {
    53	    var moves = st.listMoves();
    54	    if (!moves.length) { st.shuffle(); moves = st.listMoves(); if (!moves.length) break; }
    55	    var pick;
    56	    if (r() < 0.85) {
    57	      // greedy over a random sample (cheap)
    58	      var best = -1e9;
    59	      for (var i = 0; i < moves.length; i++) {
    60	        var s = score(st, moves[i]);
    61	        if (s > best) { best = s; pick = moves[i]; }
    62	      }
    63	    } else {
    64	      pick = moves[(r() * moves.length) | 0];
    65	    }
    66	    st.playSwap(pick[0], pick[1], pick[2], pick[3]);
    67	  }
    68	  return st.over === 1;
    69	}

    71	function rate(level, n) {
    72	  n = n || TRIALS;
    73	  var wins = 0, r = E.rng(level.seed ^ 0x9e3779b9);
    74	  for (var t = 0; t < n; t++) if (playout(level, r)) wins++;
    75	  return wins / n;
    76	}

   155	          got.push(b2);
   156	        }
   157	      } else {

   159	      }

   162	    },

   164	    soundOn: function () { return !!data.sound; },
   165	    setSound: function (v) { data.sound = v ? 1 : 0; save(); },
   166	    markSeen: function () { data.seen = 1; save(); },
   167	    hasSeen: function () { return !!data.seen; }

   253	  // Compute one resolution step. Returns null when the board is settled.
   254	  P.clearStep = function () {
   255	    var runs = this.findMatches();
   256	    if (!runs.length) return null;
   257	    var i, j, k, x, y;
   258	    var mark = {};              // idx -> true
   259	    var newSpecials = [];       // {x,y,sp,c}
   260	    var queue = [];
   261	
   262	    for (i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
   263	      var r = runs[i], list = [];
   264	      for (j = 0; j < r.len; j++) {
   265	        var cx = r.h ? r.x + j : r.x, cy = r.h ? r.y : r.y + j;
   266	        list.push(cy * W + cx); mark[cy * W + cx] = true;
   267	      }
   268	      // special creation
   269	      var sp = SP_NONE;
   270	      if (r.len === 4) sp = r.h ? SP_ROW : SP_COL;
   271	      else if (r.len >= 5) sp = SP_BLOOM;
   272	      if (sp) {
   273	        var mid = list[(r.len / 2) | 0];
   274	        newSpecials.push({ i: mid, sp: sp, c: r.c });
   275	      }
   276	    }
   277	    // cross intersections -> bomb
   278	    for (i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) for (j = 0; j < runs.length; j++) {
   279	      var a = runs[i], b = runs[j];
   280	      if (!a.h || b.h || a.c !== b.c) continue;
   281	      if (b.x >= a.x && b.x < a.x + a.len && a.y >= b.y && a.y < b.y + b.len) {
   282	        var mi = a.y * W + b.x;
   283	        var found = false;
   284	        for (k = 0; k < newSpecials.length; k++) if (newSpecials[k].i === mi) { newSpecials[k].sp = SP_BOMB; found = true; }
   285	        if (!found) newSpecials.push({ i: mi, sp: SP_BOMB, c: a.c });
   286	      }
   287	    }
   288	
   289	    for (var m in mark) queue.push(+m);
   290	    var blasts = [];
   291	    this.expand(queue, mark, blasts);
   292	
   293	    return this.commit(mark, newSpecials, blasts);
   294	  };
   295	
   296	  // Detonate specials found in the marked set (cascading).
   297	  P.expand = function (queue, mark, blasts) {
   298	    var guard = 0;
   299	    while (queue.length && guard++ < 4000) {
   300	      var idx = queue.pop();
   301	      var cc = this.cells[idx];
   302	      if (!cc || !cc.sp) continue;
   303	      var sp = cc.sp; cc.sp = SP_NONE;
   304	      var x = idx % W, y = (idx / W) | 0, i;
   305	      blasts.push({ x: x, y: y, sp: sp });
   306	      var add = [];
   307	      if (sp === SP_ROW) { for (i = 0; i < W; i++) add.push(y * W + i); }
   308	      else if (sp === SP_COL) { for (i = 0; i < H; i++) add.push(i * W + x); }
   309	      else if (sp === SP_BOMB) {
   310	        for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
   311	          if (this.inb(x + dx, y + dy)) add.push((y + dy) * W + x + dx);
   312	      } else if (sp === SP_BLOOM) {
   313	        var col = cc.c;
   314	        for (i = 0; i < W * H; i++) if (this.cells[i].c === col && !this.cells[i].b) add.push(i);
   315	      }
   316	      for (i = 0; i < add.length; i++) {
   317	        var ai = add[i]; if (mark[ai]) continue;
   318	        var t = this.cells[ai];
   319	        if (t.b || t.key) continue;
   320	        mark[ai] = true; queue.push(ai);
   321	      }
   322	    }
   323	  };
   324	
   325	  // Explicit blast (booster hammer / rocket)
   326	  P.blast = function (list) {
   327	    var mark = {}, queue = [], i;
   328	    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
   329	      var idx = list[i], t = this.cells[idx];
   330	      if (!t || t.key) continue;
   331	      mark[idx] = true; queue.push(idx);
   332	    }
   333	    var blasts = [];
   334	    this.expand(queue, mark, blasts);
   335	    return this.commit(mark, [], blasts, true);
   336	  };
   337	
   338	  P.commit = function (mark, newSpecials, blasts, force) {
   339	    var cleared = [], damaged = [], i, idx, x, y;
   340	    var keep = {};
   341	    for (i = 0; i < newSpecials.length; i++) keep[newSpecials[i].i] = newSpecials[i];
   342	
   343	    var hitNeighbors = {};
   344	    for (var m in mark) {
   345	      idx = +m; x = idx % W; y = (idx / W) | 0;
   346	      var cc = this.cells[idx];
   347	      if (cc.b) {
   348	        if (force) { // direct hit destroys a blocker
   349	          if (cc.b === B_IVY) this.ivyHitThisTurn = true;
   350	          damaged.push({ x: x, y: y, b: cc.b });
   351	          cc.b = B_NONE; cc.c = -1;
   352	          this.addGoal('blockers', -1, 1);
   353	        }
   354	        continue;
   355	      }
   356	      if (cc.key) continue;
   357	      if (cc.c < 0) continue;
   358	      cleared.push({ x: x, y: y, c: cc.c, sp: cc.sp });
   359	      this.addGoal('collect', cc.c, 1);
   360	      this.score += 10 + this.chain * 5;
   361	      if (cc.plate > 0) {
   362	        cc.plate--;
   363	        damaged.push({ x: x, y: y, plate: true });
   364	        this.addGoal('plates', -1, 1);
   365	        this.score += 25;
   366	      }
   367	      // adjacent blockers take damage
   368	      hitNeighbors[idx] = true;
   369	      if (keep[idx]) { cc.c = keep[idx].c; cc.sp = keep[idx].sp; cc.id = this.nextId++; }
   370	      else { cc.c = -1; cc.sp = SP_NONE; cc.id = 0; }
   371	    }
   372	    // blocker damage from adjacency
   373	    var dirs = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   374	    var seen = {}, slip = {};
   375	    for (var h in hitNeighbors) {
   376	      idx = +h; x = idx % W; y = (idx / W) | 0;
   377	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   378	        var nx = x + dirs[i][0], ny = y + dirs[i][1];
   379	        if (!this.inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   380	        var ni = ny * W + nx; if (seen[ni]) continue;
   381	        var nc = this.cells[ni];
   382	        if (!nc.b) continue;
   383	        seen[ni] = true;
   384	        if (nc.b) {
   385	          if (nc.b === B_IVY) this.ivyHitThisTurn = true;
   386	          damaged.push({ x: nx, y: ny, b: nc.b });
   387	          nc.b = B_NONE; nc.c = -1; nc.id = 0;
   388	          this.score += 30;
   389	        }
   390	      }
   391	      // A match anywhere around a key (including diagonals) jolts it loose: the
   392	      // tile directly beneath gives way and gravity carries the key one row down.
   393	      for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
   394	        var kx = x + KDIR[i][0], ky = y + KDIR[i][1];
   395	        if (!this.inb(kx, ky)) continue;
   396	        var kc2 = this.at(kx, ky);
   397	        if (kc2.key) slip[ky * W + kx] = true;
   398	      }
   399	    }
   400	    // resolve key slips after the neighbour sweep so order cannot matter
   401	    for (var sk in slip) {
   402	      idx = +sk; x = idx % W; y = (idx / W) | 0;
   403	      // the jolt shakes loose up to two tiles beneath the key
   404	      for (var drop = 1; drop <= 2; drop++) {
   405	        if (y + drop >= H) break;
   406	        var below = this.at(x, y + drop);
   407	        if (below.b || below.key || below.c < 0) break;
   408	        cleared.push({ x: x, y: y + drop, c: below.c, sp: below.sp, slip: true });
   409	        this.addGoal('collect', below.c, 1);
   410	        this.score += 10;
   411	        if (below.plate > 0) {
   412	          below.plate--;
   413	          damaged.push({ x: x, y: y + drop, plate: true });
   414	          this.addGoal('plates', -1, 1);
   415	          this.score += 25;
   416	        }
   417	        below.c = -1; below.sp = SP_NONE; below.id = 0;
   418	      }
   419	    }
   420	    this.chain++;
   421	    if (cleared.length || damaged.length) return { cleared: cleared, damaged: damaged, blasts: blasts, specials: newSpecials };
   422	    return null;
   423	  };
   424	
   425	  /* ---------- gravity ---------- */
   426	  // Column-wise, split into segments by blockers. Each segment compacts down
   427	  // and refills from its own top, so no permanent holes can form.
   428	  P.gravity = function () {
   429	    var moves = [], spawns = [], x, y;
   430	    for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   431	      var segEnd = H - 1;
   432	      for (y = H - 1; y >= -1; y--) {
   433	        var isBlock = (y < 0) || this.at(x, y).b;
   434	        if (!isBlock) continue;
   435	        // segment is rows [y+1 .. segEnd]
   436	        if (segEnd > y) this.compact(x, y + 1, segEnd, moves, spawns);
   437	        segEnd = y - 1;
   438	      }
   439	    }
   440	    return { moves: moves, spawns: spawns };
   441	  };
   442	
   443	  P.compact = function (x, top, bottom, moves, spawns) {
   444	    var write = bottom, y;
   445	    for (y = bottom; y >= top; y--) {
   446	      var cc = this.at(x, y);
   447	      if (cc.c < 0 && !cc.key) continue;
   448	      if (write !== y) {
   449	        var d = this.at(x, write);
   450	        d.c = cc.c; d.sp = cc.sp; d.key = cc.key; d.id = cc.id;
   451	        cc.c = -1; cc.sp = SP_NONE; cc.key = false; cc.id = 0;
   452	        moves.push({ fx: x, fy: y, tx: x, ty: write });
   453	      }
   454	      write--;
   455	    }
   456	    for (y = write; y >= top; y--) {
   457	      var n = this.at(x, y);
   458	      n.c = this.randColor(); n.sp = SP_NONE; n.key = false; n.id = this.nextId++;
   459	      spawns.push({ x: x, y: y });
   460	    }
   461	  };
   462	
   463	  // keys that reached the bottom row leave the board
   464	  P.collectKeys = function () {
   465	    var out = [];
   466	    for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   467	      var cc = this.at(x, H - 1);
   468	      if (cc.key) {
   469	        cc.key = false; cc.c = -1; cc.id = 0;
   470	        this.addGoal('keys', -1, 1);
   471	        this.score += 200;
   472	        out.push({ x: x, y: H - 1 });
   473	      }
   474	    }
   475	    return out;
   476	  };
   477	
   478	  /* ---------- turn bookkeeping ---------- */
   479	  P.spreadIvy = function () {
   480	    var i, x, y;
   481	    if (this.ivyHitThisTurn) { this.ivyTick = 0; return null; }
   482	    this.ivyTick++;
   483	    if (this.ivyTick < 4) return null;
   484	    this.ivyTick = 0;
   485	    var ivies = [], count = 0;
   486	    for (i = 0; i < W * H; i++) if (this.cells[i].b === B_IVY) { ivies.push(i); count++; }
   487	    if (!count || count >= (this.ivyMax || MAX_IVY)) return null;
   488	    // shuffle candidate order deterministically
   489	    var dirs = [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]];
   490	    for (var t = 0; t < 40; t++) {
   491	      var src = ivies[(this.rnd() * ivies.length) | 0];
   492	      x = src % W; y = (src / W) | 0;
   493	      var d = dirs[(this.rnd() * 4) | 0];
   494	      var nx = x + d[0], ny = y + d[1];
   495	      if (!this.inb(nx, ny) || ny === 0) continue;
   496	      var nc = this.at(nx, ny);
   497	      if (nc.b || nc.key || nc.plate) continue;
   498	      // never seal the cell directly under a key: that would strand the drop
   499	      if (ny > 0 && this.at(nx, ny - 1).key) continue;
   500	      nc.b = B_IVY; nc.c = -1; nc.sp = SP_NONE; nc.id = 0;
   501	      return { x: nx, y: ny };
   502	    }
   503	    return null;
   504	  };
   505	
   506	  P.goalsMet = function () {
   507	    for (var i = 0; i < this.goals.length; i++) if (this.goals[i].have < this.goals[i].need) return false;
   508	    return true;
   509	  };
   510	
   511	  P.stars = function () {
   512	    var m = this.level.moves, s = 1;
   513	    if (this.movesLeft >= Math.ceil(m * 0.15)) s++;
   514	    if (this.movesLeft >= Math.ceil(m * 0.3)) s++;
   515	    return s;
   516	  };
   517	
   518	  /* ---------- headless full resolution (used by verify + boosters) ---------- */
   519	  P.settle = function () {
   520	    var guard = 0;
   521	    this.chain = 0;
   522	    while (guard++ < 200) {
   523	      var r = this.clearStep();
   524	      if (!r) break;
   525	      this.gravity();
   526	      this.collectKeys();
   527	    }
   528	    this.collectKeys();
   529	    if (!this.hasMove()) this.shuffle();
   530	  };
   531	
   532	  P.playSwap = function (x1, y1, x2, y2) {
   533	    this.rawSwap(x1, y1, x2, y2);
   534	    this.movesLeft--;
   535	    this.ivyHitThisTurn = false;
   536	    this.settle();
   537	    this.spreadIvy();
   538	    this.gravity();
   539	    this.settle();
   540	    if (this.goalsMet()) this.over = 1;
   541	    else if (this.movesLeft <= 0) this.over = 2;
   542	  };

   545	    W: W, H: H, State: State, rng: rng,

   547	    SP_NONE: SP_NONE, SP_ROW: SP_ROW, SP_COL: SP_COL, SP_BOMB: SP_BOMB, SP_BLOOM: SP_BLOOM
   548	  };
   549	  root.PP = root.PP || {};
   550	  root.PP.engine = API;

   245	  function cellRect(x, y) {
   246	    var i = y * 8 + x;
   247	    return { x: BX + x * CELL + off[i * 2], y: BY + y * CELL + off[i * 2 + 1] };

   250	  function setOff(i, dx, dy) { off[i * 2] = dx; off[i * 2 + 1] = dy; }

   252	  /* ---------------- play controller ---------------- */
   253	  function trySwap(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
   254	    if (phase !== 'idle' || !st || st.over) return;
   255	    if (!st.inb(x2, y2)) return;
   256	    idleT = 0; hintMove = null;
   257	    if (!st.canSwapCell(x1, y1) || !st.canSwapCell(x2, y2)) { A.bad(); shake(3); return; }
   258	    var i1 = y1 * 8 + x1, i2 = y2 * 8 + x2;
   259	    var dx = (x2 - x1) * CELL, dy = (y2 - y1) * CELL;
   260	    if (st.testSwap(x1, y1, x2, y2)) {
   261	      st.rawSwap(x1, y1, x2, y2);
   262	      setOff(i1, dx, dy); setOff(i2, -dx, -dy);
   263	      st.movesLeft--;
   264	      st.ivyHitThisTurn = false;
   265	      st.chain = 0;
   266	      A.swap();
   267	      phase = 'swap'; ptimer = 0.15;
   268	    } else {
   269	      // illegal: show the nudge without committing
   270	      setOff(i1, dx * 0.45, dy * 0.45); setOff(i2, -dx * 0.45, -dy * 0.45);
   271	      A.bad(); shake(2);
   272	    }
   273	    sel = null;
   274	  }

   276	  function applyResult(r) {
   277	    if (!r) return;
   278	    var i, c;
   279	    for (i = 0; i < r.cleared.length; i++) {
   280	      c = r.cleared[i];
   281	      ghost(c.x, c.y, c.c, c.sp);
   282	      burst(BX + c.x * CELL + CELL / 2, BY + c.y * CELL + CELL / 2, COLORS[c.c] || '#fff', c.slip ? 5 : 3);
   283	    }
   284	    for (i = 0; i < r.damaged.length; i++) {
   285	      var d = r.damaged[i];

   287	      if (d.plate) burst(px, py, '#d9b26a', 6);
   288	      else { burst(px, py, d.b === E.B_IVY ? '#5fc26a' : '#b98a54', 10); A.crack(); shake(3); }
   289	    }

   300	    if (r.cleared.length >= 6) shake(3);
   301	  }

   303	  function doGravity() {
   304	    var g = st.gravity();
   305	    var i, m;
   306	    for (i = 0; i < g.moves.length; i++) {
   307	      m = g.moves[i];
   308	      setOff(m.ty * 8 + m.tx, 0, (m.fy - m.ty) * CELL);
   309	    }
   310	    for (i = 0; i < g.spawns.length; i++) {

   312	      setOff(s.y * 8 + s.x, 0, -(s.y + 1.4) * CELL);

   317	      floatText('KEY!', BX + got[i].x * CELL + CELL / 2, BY + got[i].y * CELL, '#ffcf5c');

   322	  function endTurn() {
   323	    var sp = st.spreadIvy();
   324	    if (sp) {
   325	      burst(BX + sp.x * CELL + CELL / 2, BY + sp.y * CELL + CELL / 2, '#5fc26a', 10);
   326	      pop[sp.y * 8 + sp.x] = 0.3;
   327	      say('The ivy spreads. Match beside it to cut it back.');
   328	      A.crack();
   329	    }
   330	    if (!st.hasMove()) {
   331	      st.shuffle();
   332	      for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) pop[i] = 0.25;
   333	      say('No moves left on the board — reshuffled, free of charge.');
   334	      A.click();
   335	    }
   336	    if (st.goalsMet()) { finishLevel(true); return; }
   337	    if (st.movesLeft <= 0) { finishLevel(false); return; }
   338	    phase = 'idle'; idleT = 0;
   339	  }
   340	
   341	  function finishLevel(win) {
   342	    st.over = win ? 1 : 2;
   343	    phase = 'over';
   344	    if (win) {
   345	      var s = st.stars();
   346	      var got = M.finish(lvIdx, s, st.score);
   347	      result = { win: true, stars: s, score: st.score, got: got, shown: 0 };
   348	      A.win(s);
   349	      flashT = 0.4;
   350	      for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
   351	        burst(DW / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 300, 200 + Math.random() * 200, COLORS[(Math.random() * 7) | 0], 1);
   352	      }
   353	    } else {
   354	      result = { win: false, stars: 0, score: st.score, got: [], shown: 0 };
   355	      A.lose();
   356	    }
   357	  }

   359	  function useBooster(k, x, y) {
   360	    if (!M.useBooster(k)) return;
   361	    var list = [], i;
   362	    if (k === 0) { list.push(y * 8 + x); A.crack(); shake(5); }
   363	    else if (k === 1) { for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) list.push(y * 8 + i); beam(x, y, E.SP_ROW); A.rocket(); shake(7); }
   364	    else {
   365	      st.shuffle();
   366	      for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) pop[i] = 0.28;
   367	      A.click(); say('Board shuffled.');
   368	      boosterArmed = -1;
   369	      return;
   370	    }
   371	    st.chain = 0;
   372	    var r = st.blast(list);
   373	    applyResult(r);
   374	    boosterArmed = -1;
   375	    phase = 'clear'; ptimer = 0.2;
   376	  }

   378	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   379	  function update(dt) {
   380	    var i, p;
   381	    // decay cell offsets
   382	    var k = Math.exp(-dt * 15);
   383	    for (i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
   384	      if (off[i] !== 0) { off[i] *= k; if (Math.abs(off[i]) < 0.4) off[i] = 0; }
   385	    }
   386	    for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (pop[i] > 0) pop[i] = Math.max(0, pop[i] - dt);
   387	
   388	    for (i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   389	      p = parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   390	      if (p.t >= p.life) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   391	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 620 * dt;
   392	    }
   393	    for (i = ghosts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { ghosts[i].t += dt; if (ghosts[i].t >= ghosts[i].max) ghosts.splice(i, 1); }
   394	    for (i = beams.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { beams[i].t += dt; if (beams[i].t >= beams[i].max) beams.splice(i, 1); }
   395	    for (i = floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { floats[i].t += dt; floats[i].y -= 26 * dt; if (floats[i].t >= floats[i].max) floats.splice(i, 1); }
   396	    if (shakeT > 0) { shakeT -= dt; if (shakeT <= 0) shakeM = 0; else shakeM *= Math.exp(-dt * 6); }
   397	    if (flashT > 0) flashT -= dt;
   398	    if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   399	    if (galaT > 0) galaT -= dt;
   400	    if (hintT > 0) hintT -= dt;
   401	
   402	    if (screen !== 'play' || !st) return;
   403	
   404	    if (phase === 'swap' || phase === 'clear' || phase === 'fall') {
   405	      ptimer -= dt;
   406	      if (ptimer <= 0) {
   407	        if (phase === 'swap') {
   408	          var r0 = st.clearStep();
   409	          if (r0) { applyResult(r0); phase = 'clear'; ptimer = 0.2; }
   410	          else { endTurn(); }
   411	        } else if (phase === 'clear') {
   412	          doGravity(); phase = 'fall'; ptimer = 0.22;
   413	        } else {
   414	          var r1 = st.clearStep();
   415	          if (r1) { applyResult(r1); phase = 'clear'; ptimer = 0.2; }
   416	          else { endTurn(); }
   417	        }
   418	      }
   419	    } else if (phase === 'idle') {
   420	      idleT += dt;
   421	      if (idleT > 5 && !hintMove) {
   422	        var moves = st.listMoves();
   423	        hintMove = moves.length ? moves[(Math.random() * moves.length) | 0] : null;
   424	      }
   425	    }
   426	  }
   427	
   428	  /* ---------------- render: board ---------------- */
   429	  function drawTile(x, y, c, sp, sc) {
   430	    var r = cellRect(x, y);
   431	    var cx = r.x + CELL / 2, cy = r.y + CELL / 2;
   432	    var rad = CELL * 0.36 * (sc === undefined ? 1 : sc);
   433	    if (rad <= 0.5) return;
   434	    shape(cx, cy, rad, c % 7, COLORS[c % 7], DARK[c % 7]);
   435	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
   436	    shape(cx - rad * 0.25, cy - rad * 0.3, rad * 0.3, 0, '#ffffff');
   437	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   438	    if (sp) {
   439	      ctx.save();
   440	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff6dd'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   441	      ctx.beginPath();
   442	      if (sp === E.SP_ROW) { ctx.moveTo(cx - rad, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + rad, cy); }
   443	      else if (sp === E.SP_COL) { ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - rad); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + rad); }
   444	      else if (sp === E.SP_BOMB) { ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.62, 0, 6.2832); }
   445	      else { for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var a = i * 0.7854 * 2 + 0.3927; ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * rad * .3, cy + Math.sin(a) * rad * .3); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * rad, cy + Math.sin(a) * rad); } }
   446	      ctx.stroke();
   447	      ctx.restore();
   448	    }
   449	  }
   450	
   451	  function drawKey(x, y) {
   452	    var r = cellRect(x, y);
   453	    var cx = r.x + CELL / 2, cy = r.y + CELL / 2;
   454	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf5c';
   455	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy - 7, 8, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   456	    ctx.fillStyle = '#171320';
   457	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy - 7, 3.2, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   458	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf5c';
   459	    ctx.fillRect(cx - 2.5, cy - 2, 5, 16);
   460	    ctx.fillRect(cx - 2.5, cy + 6, 9, 3.4);
   461	    ctx.fillRect(cx - 2.5, cy + 11, 7, 3.4);
   462	  }

   464	  function drawBlocker(x, y, b) {
   465	    var px = BX + x * CELL, py = BY + y * CELL;
   466	    if (b === E.B_CRATE) {
   467	      rr(px + 4, py + 4, CELL - 8, CELL - 8, 5);
   468	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6440'; ctx.fill();
   469	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5d4128'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
   470	      ctx.beginPath();
   471	      ctx.moveTo(px + 7, py + 7); ctx.lineTo(px + CELL - 7, py + CELL - 7);
   472	      ctx.moveTo(px + CELL - 7, py + 7); ctx.lineTo(px + 7, py + CELL - 7);
   473	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6d4d2f'; ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.stroke();
   474	    } else {
   475	      rr(px + 3, py + 3, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 9);
   476	      ctx.fillStyle = '#2f5c31'; ctx.fill();
   477	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5fc26a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
   478	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5fc26a'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   479	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   480	        ctx.beginPath();
   481	        var yy = py + 12 + i * 10;
   482	        ctx.moveTo(px + 8, yy);
   483	        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(px + CELL / 2, yy + (i % 2 ? 9 : -9), px + CELL - 8, yy);
   484	        ctx.stroke();
   485	      }
   486	    }
   487	  }

   489	  function drawBoard() {
   490	    var i, x, y, cc;
   491	    // frame
   492	    rr(BX - 6, BY - 6, BW + 12, BW + 12, 14);
   493	    ctx.fillStyle = '#241d31'; ctx.fill();
   494	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3d3350'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
   495	
   496	    ctx.save();
   497	    rr(BX - 3, BY - 3, BW + 6, BW + 6, 12);
   498	    ctx.clip();
   499	
   500	    for (y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
   501	      cc = st.at(x, y);
   502	      var px = BX + x * CELL, py = BY + y * CELL;
   503	      ctx.fillStyle = ((x + y) & 1) ? '#2b2338' : '#251e31';
   504	      ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
   505	      if (cc.plate > 0) {
   506	        ctx.fillStyle = cc.plate > 1 ? '#7a6136' : '#5e4d2e';
   507	        ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 2, CELL - 4, CELL - 4);
   508	        ctx.strokeStyle = '#a98c4e'; ctx.lineWidth = cc.plate > 1 ? 3 : 1.5;
   509	        ctx.strokeRect(px + 3.5, py + 3.5, CELL - 7, CELL - 7);
   510	        if (cc.plate > 1) {
   511	          ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9b26a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   512	          ctx.strokeRect(px + 8.5, py + 8.5, CELL - 17, CELL - 17);
   513	        }
   514	      }
   515	    }
   516	
   517	    // selection + hint
   518	    if (sel) {
   519	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffcf5c'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   520	      rr(BX + sel.x * CELL + 2, BY + sel.y * CELL + 2, CELL - 4, CELL - 4, 8); ctx.stroke();
   521	    }
   522	    if (hintMove && phase === 'idle') {
   523	      var a = 0.35 + 0.3 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 180);
   524	      ctx.globalAlpha = a; ctx.strokeStyle = '#8be0ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   525	      rr(BX + hintMove[0] * CELL + 3, BY + hintMove[1] * CELL + 3, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 8); ctx.stroke();
   526	      rr(BX + hintMove[2] * CELL + 3, BY + hintMove[3] * CELL + 3, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 8); ctx.stroke();
   527	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   528	    }
   529	
   530	    // ghosts (just-cleared tiles)
   531	    for (i = 0; i < ghosts.length; i++) {
   532	      var g = ghosts[i], t = g.t / g.max;
   533	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - t;
   534	      var gx = BX + g.x * CELL + CELL / 2, gy = BY + g.y * CELL + CELL / 2;
   535	      shape(gx, gy, CELL * 0.36 * (1 + t * 0.7), g.c % 7, COLORS[g.c % 7]);
   536	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   537	    }
   538	
   539	    for (y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
   540	      cc = st.at(x, y);
   541	      i = y * 8 + x;
   542	      if (cc.b) { drawBlocker(x, y, cc.b); continue; }
   543	      if (cc.key) { drawKey(x, y); continue; }
   544	      if (cc.c >= 0) {
   545	        var sc = 1;
   546	        if (pop[i] > 0) sc = 1 + Math.sin(Math.min(1, pop[i] / 0.3) * 3.1416) * 0.28;
   547	        drawTile(x, y, cc.c, cc.sp, sc);
   548	      }
   549	    }
   550	
   551	    // beams
   552	    for (i = 0; i < beams.length; i++) {
   553	      var b = beams[i], bt = 1 - b.t / b.max;
   554	      ctx.globalAlpha = bt * 0.8;
   555	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff6dd';
   556	      if (b.k === E.SP_ROW) ctx.fillRect(BX, BY + b.y * CELL + CELL / 2 - 4 * bt, BW, 8 * bt);
   557	      else if (b.k === E.SP_COL) ctx.fillRect(BX + b.x * CELL + CELL / 2 - 4 * bt, BY, 8 * bt, BW);
   558	      else {
   559	        ctx.beginPath();
   560	        ctx.arc(BX + b.x * CELL + CELL / 2, BY + b.y * CELL + CELL / 2, (1 - bt) * CELL * 2.2, 0, 6.2832);
   561	        ctx.lineWidth = 6 * bt; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff6dd'; ctx.stroke();
   562	      }
   563	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   564	    }
   565	    ctx.restore();
   566	  }

   569	  function goalIcon(g, x, y, r) {

   573	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9b26a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeRect(x - r + 1, y - r + 1, r * 2 - 2, r * 2 - 2);
   574	    } else {
   575	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf5c';
   576	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - r * .4, r * .5, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   577	      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y - r * .2, 4, r * 1.1);
   578	      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + r * .4, 6, 2.6);
   579	    }
   580	  }

   774	  function drawRoomArt(r, x, y, w, h) {
   775	    var R = M.ROOMS[r];
   776	    ctx.fillStyle = R.wall; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
   777	    ctx.fillStyle = R.floor; ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * 0.72, w, h * 0.28);
   778	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   779	    ctx.strokeRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2);
   780	    var spots = [[0.06, 0.3, 0.28, 0.55], [0.37, 0.34, 0.3, 0.52], [0.7, 0.16, 0.26, 0.55]];
   781	    for (var s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
   782	      var v = M.choiceFor(r, s);
   783	      var sx = x + spots[s][0] * w, sy = y + spots[s][1] * h, sw = spots[s][2] * w, sh = spots[s][3] * h;
   784	      if (v < 0) {
   785	        ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
   786	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   787	        ctx.strokeRect(sx, sy, sw, sh);
   788	        ctx.setLineDash([]);
   789	        text(R.slots[s].name, sx + sw / 2, sy + sh / 2, 11, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)', 'center', 600);
   790	      } else {
   791	        drawFurnishing(r, s, v, sx, sy, sw, sh);
   792	      }
   793	    }
   794	  }

   841	  function drawFx() {
   842	    var i;
   843	    for (i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
   844	      var p = parts[i];
   845	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p.t / p.life);
   846	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   847	      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.s / 2, p.y - p.s / 2, p.s, p.s);
   848	    }
   849	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   850	    for (i = 0; i < floats.length; i++) {
   851	      var f = floats[i];
   852	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - f.t / f.max);
   853	      text(f.s, f.x, f.y, 16, f.c, 'center');
   854	    }
   855	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   856	    if (flashT > 0) {
   857	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.5, flashT);
   858	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff6dd'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH);
   859	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   860	    }
   861	  }

   863	  function render() {
   864	    ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
   865	    ctx.fillStyle = '#171320';
   866	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, DW, DH);
   867	    btns.length = 0;
   868	
   869	    ctx.save();
   870	    if (shakeM > 0.2) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeM, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeM);
   871	
   872	    if (screen === 'play' && st) {
   873	      drawPlay();
   874	      drawFx();
   875	      if (result) drawResult();
   876	    } else if (screen === 'map') { drawMap(); drawFx(); }
   877	    else if (screen === 'rooms') { drawRooms(); drawFx(); }
   878	    else if (screen === 'gala') { drawGala(); drawFx(); }
   879	    ctx.restore();
   880	  }

   882	  var last = 0;
   883	  function frame(ts) {
   884	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   885	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   886	    last = ts;
   887	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   888	    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);           // clamped delta
   889	    if (paused) dt = 0;                // rotate overlay freezes the whole sim
   890	    if (dt > 0) update(dt);
   891	    render();
   892	  }

   894	  /* ---------------- actions ---------------- */
   895	  function act(id) {
   896	    A.click();
   897	    if (id === 'back') {
   898	      if (screen === 'play') { screen = 'map'; resetInput(); }
   899	      else if (screen === 'gala') { screen = 'map'; resetInput(); }
   900	      else { screen = 'play'; resetInput(); if (!st) startLevel(M.unlocked()); }
   901	      return;
   902	    }
   903	    if (id === 'snd') { M.setSound(!M.soundOn()); A.setOn(M.soundOn()); return; }
   904	    if (id === 'retry') { startLevel(lvIdx); return; }
   905	    if (id === 'rooms') { screen = 'rooms'; resetInput(); return; }
   906	    if (id === 'play') { startLevel(M.unlocked()); return; }
   907	    if (id === 'reset') { M.reset(); startLevel(0); screen = 'map'; say('Progress reset.'); return; }
   908	    if (id === 'next') {
   909	      if (lvIdx + 1 < LEVELS.length) startLevel(lvIdx + 1);
   910	      else { screen = 'map'; resetInput(); }
   911	      return;
   912	    }
   913	    if (id.indexOf('lv') === 0) {
   914	      var i = parseInt(id.slice(2), 10);
   915	      if (M.isUnlocked(i)) startLevel(i);
   916	      return;
   917	    }
   918	    if (id.indexOf('tab') === 0) { roomTab = parseInt(id.slice(3), 10); return; }
   919	    if (id.indexOf('opt') === 0) {
   920	      var p = id.slice(3).split('-');
   921	      var r = +p[0], s = +p[1], o = +p[2];
   922	      var had = M.choiceFor(r, s) >= 0;
   923	      if (!had && M.freeStars() < M.ROOMS[r].slots[s].cost) return;
   924	      M.setChoice(r, s, o);
   925	      burst(DW / 2, 220, '#ffcf5c', 16);
   926	      if (!had) { A.goal(); }
   927	      if (M.allDone() && !had) { screen = 'gala'; galaT = 3; A.fanfare(); }
   928	      return;
   929	    }
   930	    if (id.indexOf('b') === 0 && id.length === 2) {
   931	      var k = parseInt(id.slice(1), 10);
   932	      if (M.boosters()[k] <= 0 || phase !== 'idle' || result) return;
   933	      if (k === 2) { useBooster(2); return; }
   934	      boosterArmed = boosterArmed === k ? -1 : k;
   935	      return;
   936	    }
   937	  }
   938	
   939	  function boardCell(px, py) {
   940	    var x = Math.floor((px - BX) / CELL), y = Math.floor((py - BY) / CELL);
   941	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > 7 || y > 7) return null;
   942	    return { x: x, y: y };
   943	  }
   944	
   945	  /* ---------------- pointer handling (per-id) ---------------- */
   946	  function onDown(e) {
   947	    if (paused) return;
   948	    var p = toDesign(e);
   949	    var b = hitButton(p.x, p.y);
   950	    var rec = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, btn: b ? b.id : null, cell: null, moved: false };
   951	    if (!b && screen === 'play' && !result && phase === 'idle') {
   952	      rec.cell = boardCell(p.x, p.y);
   953	      if (rec.cell) {
   954	        if (boosterArmed >= 0) {
   955	          useBooster(boosterArmed, rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y);
   956	          rec.cell = null;
   957	        } else if (st.canSwapCell(rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y)) {
   958	          sel = { x: rec.cell.x, y: rec.cell.y };
   959	          cur.x = rec.cell.x; cur.y = rec.cell.y;
   960	        }
   961	      }
   962	    }
   963	    pointers[e.pointerId] = rec;
   964	  }
   965	
   966	  function onMove(e) {
   967	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];
   968	    if (!rec || paused) return;
   969	    var p = toDesign(e);
   970	    rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   971	    if (!rec.cell || rec.moved) return;
   972	    var dx = p.x - rec.sx, dy = p.y - rec.sy;
   973	    if (Math.abs(dx) < 14 && Math.abs(dy) < 14) return;
   974	    rec.moved = true;
   975	    var tx = rec.cell.x, ty = rec.cell.y;
   976	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   977	    else ty += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   978	    trySwap(rec.cell.x, rec.cell.y, tx, ty);
   979	  }
   980	
   981	  function onUp(e) {
   982	    var rec = pointers[e.pointerId];
   983	    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
   984	    if (!rec || paused) return;
   985	    if (rec.btn) {
   986	      var b = hitButton(rec.x, rec.y);
   987	      if (b && b.id === rec.btn) act(rec.btn);
   988	      return;
   989	    }
   990	    // tap-to-select then tap-neighbour to swap
   991	    if (rec.cell && !rec.moved) {
   992	      var c = boardCell(rec.x, rec.y);
   993	      if (c && sel && (Math.abs(c.x - sel.x) + Math.abs(c.y - sel.y)) === 1) trySwap(sel.x, sel.y, c.x, c.y);
   994	      else if (c && sel && c.x === sel.x && c.y === sel.y) { /* keep selection */ }
   995	    }
   996	  }
   997	
   998	  function onCancel(e) { delete pointers[e.pointerId]; }
   999	
  1000	  function releaseAll() { pointers = {}; keys = {}; sel = null; }
  1001	
  1002	  /* ---------------- keyboard ---------------- */
  1003	  function onKey(e) {
  1004	    if (paused) return;
  1005	    var k = e.key;
  1006	    if (keys[k] && k !== 'ArrowLeft' && k !== 'ArrowRight' && k !== 'ArrowUp' && k !== 'ArrowDown') return;
  1007	    keys[k] = 1;
  1008	    var dx = 0, dy = 0;
  1009	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') dx = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowRight') dx = 1;
  1010	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp') dy = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowDown') dy = 1;
  1011	
  1012	    if (screen !== 'play') {
  1013	      if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'Backspace') { act('back'); e.preventDefault(); }
  1014	      if (screen === 'rooms' && (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight')) { roomTab = (roomTab + dx + 3) % 3; e.preventDefault(); }
  1015	      if (screen === 'map' && (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ')) { act('play'); e.preventDefault(); }
  1016	      return;
  1017	    }
  1018	    if (result) {
  1019	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') act(result.win ? 'next' : 'retry');
  1020	      else if (k === 'Escape') act('back');
  1021	      e.preventDefault();
  1022	      return;
  1023	    }
  1024	    if (dx || dy) {
  1025	      e.preventDefault();
  1026	      if (sel && phase === 'idle') { trySwap(sel.x, sel.y, sel.x + dx, sel.y + dy); cur.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.x + dx)); cur.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.y + dy)); }
  1027	      else { cur.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.x + dx)); cur.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, cur.y + dy)); }
  1028	      idleT = 0; hintMove = null;
  1029	      return;
  1030	    }
  1031	    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
  1032	      e.preventDefault();
  1033	      if (boosterArmed >= 0) { useBooster(boosterArmed, cur.x, cur.y); return; }
  1034	      if (sel && sel.x === cur.x && sel.y === cur.y) sel = null;
  1035	      else if (st.canSwapCell(cur.x, cur.y)) { sel = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y }; A.click(); }
  1036	      return;
  1037	    }
  1038	    if (k === 'Escape') { if (boosterArmed >= 0) boosterArmed = -1; else if (sel) sel = null; else act('back'); e.preventDefault(); }
  1039	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') act('retry');
  1040	    if (k === '1' || k === '2' || k === '3') act('b' + (parseInt(k, 10) - 1));
  1041	  }
  1042	
  1043	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete keys[e.key]; }
  1044	
  1045	  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
  1046	  function boot() {
  1047	    cv = document.getElementById('cv');
  1048	    ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  1049	    M.load();
  1050	    A.setOn(M.soundOn());
  1051	    fit();
  1052	
  1053	    root.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  1054	    root.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { later(fit, 60); });
  1055	    root.addEventListener('blur', releaseAll);
  1056	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) releaseAll(); });
  1057	
  1058	    var opt = { passive: false };
  1059	    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onDown(e); }, opt);
  1060	    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onMove(e); }, opt);
  1061	    cv.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onUp(e); }, opt);
  1062	    cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onCancel(e); }, opt);
  1063	    cv.addEventListener('pointerleave', onCancel);
  1064	    cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  1065	    cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);
  1066	    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);
  1067	    root.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  1068	    root.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  1069	
  1070	    var start = document.getElementById('start');
  1071	    var go = function (e) {
  1072	      if (e) e.preventDefault();
  1073	      A.unlock();
  1074	      A.setOn(M.soundOn());
  1075	      start.classList.remove('on');
  1076	      booted = true;
  1077	      M.markSeen();
  1078	      startLevel(M.unlocked());
  1079	      checkOrientation();
  1080	    };
  1081	    document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', go);
  1082	    document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('touchend', go, opt);
  1083	    start.addEventListener('click', go);
  1084	
  1085	    startLevel(M.unlocked());

   241	  function tone(freq, duration = .08, type = 'sine', volume = .035) {
   242	    if (!audioReady || !audioCtx) return;
   243	    try {
   244	      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
   245	      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
   246	      osc.type = type;
   247	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
   248	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
   249	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
   250	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
   251	      osc.start();
   252	      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
   253	    } catch (_) {}
   254	  }

   358	    target.hp -= damage;
   359	    target.hitCooldown = .12;
   360	    target.flash = .18;
   361	    combo = Math.min(99, combo + 1);
   362	    score += damage * 12;
   363	    emit(target.x, target.y, target.color, target.type === 'boss' ? 11 : 6, 88, .35);
   364	    tone(target.type === 'boss' ? 130 : 250 + damage * 40, .045, 'square', .022);
   365	    if (target.hp <= 0) {
   366	      const value = target.type === 'boss' ? 500 : target.type === 'heavy' ? 130 : 80;
   367	      score += value;
   368	      emit(target.x, target.y, '#fdf0bc', target.type === 'boss' ? 26 : 12, 150, .7);
   369	      shake = Math.max(shake, target.type === 'boss' ? 10 : 4);
   370	      enemies = enemies.filter((item) => item !== target);
   371	      addEffect({ kind: 'pop', x: target.x, y: target.y, t: .45, max: .45, color: target.color });
   372	    }
   373	    if (source === 'player' && creature.passive === 'SPLIT' && !player.splitUsed) {
   374	      player.splitUsed = true;
   375	      const base = Math.atan2(player.vy, player.vx);
   376	      for (const offset of [-.42, .42]) {
   377	        if (shards.length < MAX_SHARDS) shards.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, vx: Math.cos(base + offset) * 150, vy: Math.sin(base + offset) * 150, r: 7, life: 1.8, hit: 0 });
   378	      }
   379	      emit(player.x, player.y, creature.color, 14, 110, .5);
   380	      tone(520, .1, 'triangle', .035);
   381	    }
   382	    if (source === 'player' && creature.passive === 'PIERCE') {
   383	      player.banked = player.banked || player.bounces > 0;
   384	    }
   385	    if (normal && source === 'player' && creature.passive !== 'PIERCE') {
   386	      const dot = player.vx * normal.x + player.vy * normal.y;
   387	      player.vx -= 2 * dot * normal.x;
   388	      player.vy -= 2 * dot * normal.y;
   389	      player.vx *= .88;
   390	      player.vy *= .88;
   391	    }
   392	    if (source === 'player' && target.type !== 'boss') hurtTeam(target.type === 'heavy' ? 7 : 4);
   393	  }
   394	
   395	  function hurtTeam(amount) {
   396	    const warded = effects.some((item) => item.kind === 'shield' && item.t > 0);
   397	    if (warded) amount = Math.ceil(amount * .35);
   398	    teamHP = clamp(teamHP - amount, 0, 100);
   399	    flash = Math.max(flash, .16);
   400	    shake = Math.max(shake, 4);
   401	    if (teamHP <= 0) failStage();
   402	  }
   403	
   404	  function triggerAura(slot) {
   405	    const id = team[slot];
   406	    const creature = roster[id];
   407	    const base = basePosition(slot);
   408	    combo = Math.min(99, combo + 2);
   409	    if (creature.aura === 'HEAL') {
   410	      teamHP = clamp(teamHP + 18, 0, 100);
   411	      addEffect({ kind: 'heal', x: base.x, y: base.y, t: .7, max: .7, color: creature.color });
   412	      emit(base.x, base.y, creature.color, 18, 92, .62);
   413	      tone(530, .16, 'sine', .04);
   414	    } else if (creature.aura === 'SPARK') {
   415	      addEffect({ kind: 'spark', x: base.x, y: base.y, t: .42, max: .42, color: creature.color });
   416	      emit(base.x, base.y, creature.color, 22, 170, .5);
   417	      for (const target of enemies.slice()) {
   418	        if (Math.hypot(target.x - base.x, target.y - base.y) < 100) hitEnemy(target, 2, 'aura');
   419	      }
   420	      tone(760, .13, 'square', .04);
   421	    } else if (creature.aura === 'SHIELD') {
   422	      addEffect({ kind: 'shield', x: base.x, y: base.y, t: 4, max: 4, color: creature.color });
   423	      emit(base.x, base.y, creature.color, 16, 76, .55);
   424	      tone(340, .18, 'triangle', .045);
   425	    } else {
   426	      addEffect({ kind: 'pulse', x: base.x, y: base.y, t: .48, max: .48, color: creature.color });
   427	      emit(base.x, base.y, creature.color, 10, 100, .4);
   428	      tone(300, .07, 'sine', .025);
   429	    }
   430	    announce.textContent = `${creature.name} aura: ${creature.aura === 'HEAL' ? 'vitality restored' : creature.aura === 'SPARK' ? 'nearby foes shocked' : creature.aura === 'SHIELD' ? 'damage dampened' : creature.aura.toLowerCase()}.`;
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function bossWallsCleared() {
   434	    return walls.every((wall) => !wall.alive);
   435	  }
   436	
   437	  function wallCollision(wall) {
   438	    if (!wall.alive || !player.launched) return false;
   439	    const closestX = clamp(player.x, wall.x - wall.w / 2, wall.x + wall.w / 2);
   440	    const closestY = clamp(player.y, wall.y - wall.h / 2, wall.y + wall.h / 2);
   441	    const dx = player.x - closestX;
   442	    const dy = player.y - closestY;
   443	    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > player.r * player.r) return false;
   444	    if (player.bounces > 0) {
   445	      wall.hp -= 1;
   446	      wall.flash = .22;
   447	      player.banked = true;
   448	      emit(wall.x, wall.y, '#ffd681', 12, 105, .4);
   449	      tone(470, .08, 'square', .028);
   450	      if (wall.hp <= 0) { wall.alive = false; score += 110; emit(wall.x, wall.y, '#c8ffcf', 20, 130, .58); }
   451	    }
   452	    const horizontal = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy);
   453	    if (horizontal) player.vx *= -1; else player.vy *= -1;
   454	    if (horizontal) player.x += dx > 0 ? 3 : -3; else player.y += dy > 0 ? 3 : -3;
   455	    player.vx *= .9; player.vy *= .9;
   456	    shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
   457	    return true;
   458	  }
   459	
   460	  function updateAim(dt) {
   461	    if (player?.launched || !player) return;
   462	    let ax = 0;
   463	    let ay = 0;
   464	    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft')) ax -= 1;
   465	    if (keys.has('ArrowRight')) ax += 1;
   466	    if (keys.has('ArrowUp')) ay -= 1;
   467	    if (keys.has('ArrowDown')) ay += 1;
   468	    if (ax || ay) {
   469	      const current = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x);
   470	      const desired = Math.atan2(ay, ax);
   471	      let diff = desired - current;
   472	      while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= TAU;
   473	      while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += TAU;
   474	      const next = current + clamp(diff, -dt * 2.9, dt * 2.9);
   475	      aim = { x: Math.cos(next), y: Math.sin(next) };
   476	    }
   477	  }
   478	
   479	  function update(dt) {
   480	    if (orientationPaused || audioGate) return;
   481	    if (state !== 'play') {
   482	      updateParticles(dt);
   483	      return;
   484	    }
   485	    stageSeconds = Math.max(0, (performance.now() - stageStartedAt) / 1000);
   486	    updateAim(dt);
   487	    if (queuedActions.length) {
   488	      const action = queuedActions.shift();
   489	      if (action === 'launch') launch();
   490	    }
   491	    walls.forEach((wall) => { wall.flash = Math.max(0, wall.flash - dt); });
   492	    enemies.forEach((item) => {
   493	      item.hitCooldown = Math.max(0, item.hitCooldown - dt);
   494	      item.flash = Math.max(0, item.flash - dt);
   495	      if (roster[team[activeSlot]]?.passive === 'MAGNET' && player.launched && item.type !== 'boss') {
   496	        const dx = player.x - item.x;
   497	        const dy = player.y - item.y;
   498	        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   499	        if (d > 12 && d < 124) { item.vx += dx / d * 16 * dt; item.vy += dy / d * 16 * dt; }
   500	      }
   501	      item.x = clamp(item.x + item.vx * dt, ARENA.left + item.r, ARENA.right - item.r);
   502	      item.y = clamp(item.y + item.vy * dt, ARENA.top + item.r, 408 - item.r);
   503	      item.vx *= Math.pow(.02, dt);
   504	      item.vy *= Math.pow(.02, dt);
   505	    });
   506	    updateShards(dt);
   507	    updateEffects(dt);
   508	    updateParticles(dt);
   509	    if (!player.launched) return;
   510	    player.shotTime += dt;
   511	    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);
   512	    player.x += player.vx * dt;
   513	    player.y += player.vy * dt;
   514	    player.vx *= Math.pow(.19, dt);
   515	    player.vy *= Math.pow(.19, dt);
   516	    trails.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, life: .34 });
   517	    while (trails.length > 24) trails.shift();
   518	    let bounced = false;
   519	    if (player.x - player.r < ARENA.left) { player.x = ARENA.left + player.r; player.vx = Math.abs(player.vx); bounced = true; }
   520	    if (player.x + player.r > ARENA.right) { player.x = ARENA.right - player.r; player.vx = -Math.abs(player.vx); bounced = true; }
   521	    if (player.y - player.r < ARENA.top) { player.y = ARENA.top + player.r; player.vy = Math.abs(player.vy); bounced = true; }
   522	    if (player.y + player.r > ARENA.bottom) { player.y = ARENA.bottom - player.r; player.vy = -Math.abs(player.vy); bounced = true; }
   523	    if (bounced) {
   524	      player.bounces = Math.min(20, player.bounces + 1);
   525	      player.banked = true;
   526	      emit(player.x, player.y, '#d9f5ff', 5, 50, .25);
   527	      tone(165 + player.bounces * 14, .035, 'sine', .018);
   528	    }
   529	    for (const wall of walls) wallCollision(wall);
   530	    for (const target of enemies.slice()) {
   531	      const d = Math.hypot(player.x - target.x, player.y - target.y);
   532	      if (d < player.r + target.r) {
   533	        if (target.type === 'boss' && !bossWallsCleared() && player.bounces === 0) {
   534	          hurtTeam(3);
   535	          const n = normalize(player.x - target.x, player.y - target.y);
   536	          player.vx = Math.abs(player.vx) * n.x - Math.abs(player.vy) * n.y;
   537	          player.vy = Math.abs(player.vx) * n.y + Math.abs(player.vy) * n.x;
   538	          emit(target.x, target.y, '#ef9b86', 8, 75, .3);
   539	        } else {
   540	          const normal = normalize(player.x - target.x, player.y - target.y);
   541	          hitEnemy(target, roster[team[activeSlot]].passive === 'PIERCE' ? 2 : 1, 'player', normal);
   542	          player.x = target.x + normal.x * (player.r + target.r + 1);
   543	          player.y = target.y + normal.y * (player.r + target.r + 1);
   544	        }
   545	      }
   546	    }
   547	    for (let i = 0; i < team.length; i++) {
   548	      if (i === activeSlot) continue;
   549	      const ally = basePosition(i);
   550	      if (Math.hypot(player.x - ally.x, player.y - ally.y) < player.r + 22) {
   551	        const auraKey = `ally-${i}`;
   552	        const already = effects.some((item) => item.kind === auraKey);
   553	        if (!already) {
   554	          addEffect({ kind: auraKey, x: ally.x, y: ally.y, t: .46, max: .46, color: roster[team[i]].color });
   555	          triggerAura(i);
   556	          const n = normalize(player.x - ally.x, player.y - ally.y);
   557	          player.vx = Math.abs(player.vx) * n.x;
   558	          player.vy = Math.abs(player.vy) * n.y;
   559	        }
   560	      }
--- 561-980 ---
   561	    }
   562	    const speed = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
   563	    if (speed < 24) player.settle += dt; else player.settle = 0;
   564	    if (player.settle > .52 || player.shotTime > 8) endShot();
   565	    if (!enemies.length && !walls.some((wall) => wall.alive)) clearStage();
   566	    if (teamHP <= 0) failStage();
   567	  }
   568	
   569	  function endShot() {
   570	    player.launched = false;
   571	    player.vx = 0;
   572	    player.vy = 0;
   573	    const previous = activeSlot;
   574	    activeSlot = (activeSlot + 1) % team.length;
   575	    if (activeSlot === previous) activeSlot = 0;
   576	    resetPlayer();
   577	    renderTeamControls();
   578	    if (enemies.length > 0) hurtTeam(Math.min(7, Math.max(1, enemies.length - 4)));
   579	  }
   580	
   581	  function updateShards(dt) {
   582	    for (let i = shards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   583	      const shard = shards[i];
   584	      shard.life -= dt;
   585	      shard.hit = Math.max(0, shard.hit - dt);
   586	      shard.x += shard.vx * dt;
   587	      shard.y += shard.vy * dt;
   588	      shard.vx *= Math.pow(.06, dt);
   589	      shard.vy *= Math.pow(.06, dt);
   590	      if (shard.x - shard.r < ARENA.left || shard.x + shard.r > ARENA.right) shard.vx *= -1;
   591	      if (shard.y - shard.r < ARENA.top || shard.y + shard.r > ARENA.bottom) shard.vy *= -1;
   592	      for (const target of enemies.slice()) {
   593	        if (shard.hit <= 0 && Math.hypot(shard.x - target.x, shard.y - target.y) < shard.r + target.r) {
   594	          shard.hit = .16;
   595	          hitEnemy(target, 1, 'shard', normalize(shard.x - target.x, shard.y - target.y));
   596	        }
   597	      }
   598	      if (shard.life <= 0) shards.splice(i, 1);
   599	    }
   600	  }
   601	
   602	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   603	    for (let i = effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   604	      effects[i].t -= dt;
   605	      if (effects[i].t <= 0) effects.splice(i, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    for (let i = trails.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   608	      trails[i].life -= dt;
   609	      if (trails[i].life <= 0) trails.splice(i, 1);
   610	    }
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   614	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   615	      const p = particles[i];
   616	      p.life -= dt;
   617	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   618	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   619	      p.vx *= Math.pow(.08, dt);
   620	      p.vy *= Math.pow(.08, dt);
   621	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   622	    }
   623	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 18);
   624	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   625	  }
   626	
   627	  function guideEndpoint() {
   628	    const origin = player;
   629	    const dir = normalize(aim.x, aim.y);
   630	    let best = 330;
   631	    let hit = null;
   632	    if (dir.x > 0) { const t = (ARENA.right - origin.r - origin.x) / dir.x; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'x'; } }
   633	    if (dir.x < 0) { const t = (ARENA.left + origin.r - origin.x) / dir.x; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'x'; } }
   634	    if (dir.y > 0) { const t = (ARENA.bottom - origin.r - origin.y) / dir.y; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'y'; } }
   635	    if (dir.y < 0) { const t = (ARENA.top + origin.r - origin.y) / dir.y; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'y'; } }
   636	    return { x: origin.x + dir.x * best, y: origin.y + dir.y * best, hit, dir };
   637	  }

   639	  function draw() {
   640	    const sx = layout.dpr * layout.scale;
   641	    const sy = layout.dpr * layout.scale;
   642	    ctx.setTransform(sx, 0, 0, sy, layout.dpr * (layout.ox + shake * (Math.random() - .5)), layout.dpr * (layout.oy + shake * (Math.random() - .5)));
   643	    ctx.clearRect(-20, -20, VW + 40, VH + 40);
   644	    drawBackground();
   645	    ctx.save();
   646	    roundRect(10, 10, 370, 590, 24, '#111a28', 'rgba(203,230,246,.16)', 1);
   647	    ctx.clip();
   648	    drawArena();
   649	    ctx.restore();
   650	    drawHud();
   651	    drawBottomHint();
   652	    if (state === 'fail') drawStateCard('RUN OUT', 'The team vitality pool hit zero.', 'Retry this stage');
   653	    if (state === 'clear') drawStateCard('FORMATION CLEARED', `+${stageScore} score  •  next stage loading`, progress.unlocked >= Math.min(6, stage + 3) ? 'Roster expanded' : 'Nice bank');
   654	    if (state === 'win') drawStateCard('Slingfang complete', `12 stages cleared  •  ${score} score`, 'Play again');
   655	  }

   657	  function drawBackground() {
   658	    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, VH);
   659	    bg.addColorStop(0, '#0b111c'); bg.addColorStop(.55, '#111d2b'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#0d1521');
   660	    ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(-1, -1, VW + 2, VH + 2);
   661	    for (const dot of backdropDots) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160,216,232,${dot.a})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dot.x, dot.y, dot.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   662	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(133,179,201,.055)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   663	    for (let x = 20; x < VW; x += 26) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 94); ctx.lineTo(x, 612); ctx.stroke(); }
   664	    for (let y = 110; y < 612; y += 26) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(10, y); ctx.lineTo(380, y); ctx.stroke(); }
   665	  }

   667	  function drawArena() {
   668	    const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ARENA.top, 0, ARENA.bottom);
   669	    field.addColorStop(0, '#15283a'); field.addColorStop(1, '#101a27');
   670	    roundRect(17, 116, 356, 462, 19, field, 'rgba(175,221,239,.22)', 1.5);
   671	    ctx.save();
   672	    ctx.globalAlpha = .23;
   673	    ctx.setLineDash([5, 9]);
   674	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8acbd6';
   675	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(25, 420); ctx.lineTo(365, 420); ctx.stroke();
   676	    ctx.restore();
   677	    for (const wall of walls) drawWall(wall);
   678	    for (const trail of trails) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(178,239,245,${trail.life * .7})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(trail.x, trail.y, 3 + trail.life * 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   679	    for (const target of enemies) drawEnemy(target);
   680	    for (const shard of shards) { ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd47c'; ctx.shadowColor = '#ffb15c'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(shard.x, shard.y, shard.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0; }
   681	    for (let i = 0; i < team.length; i++) drawAlly(i);
   682	    drawGuide();
   683	    if (player) drawPlayer();
   684	    for (const effect of effects) drawEffect(effect);
   685	    for (const p of particles) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.maxLife, 0, 1); ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   686	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   687	  }

   720	  function drawWall(wall) {
   721	    if (!wall.alive) return;
   722	    ctx.save();
   723	    ctx.translate(wall.x, wall.y);
   724	    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffbd6d'; ctx.shadowBlur = wall.flash ? 22 : 9;

   806	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {

   809	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   810	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth; ctx.stroke(); }

   538	          emit(target.x, target.y, '#ef9b86', 8, 75, .3);
   539	        } else {
   540	          const normal = normalize(player.x - target.x, player.y - target.y);
   541	          hitEnemy(target, roster[team[activeSlot]].passive === 'PIERCE' ? 2 : 1, 'player', normal);
   542	          player.x = target.x + normal.x * (player.r + target.r + 1);
   543	          player.y = target.y + normal.y * (player.r + target.r + 1);
   544	        }
   545	      }
   546	    }
   547	    for (let i = 0; i < team.length; i++) {
   548	      if (i === activeSlot) continue;
   549	      const ally = basePosition(i);
   550	      if (Math.hypot(player.x - ally.x, player.y - ally.y) < player.r + 22) {
   551	        const auraKey = `ally-${i}`;
   552	        const already = effects.some((item) => item.kind === auraKey);
   553	        if (!already) {
   554	          addEffect({ kind: auraKey, x: ally.x, y: ally.y, t: .46, max: .46, color: roster[team[i]].color });
   555	          triggerAura(i);
   556	          const n = normalize(player.x - ally.x, player.y - ally.y);
   557	          player.vx = Math.abs(player.vx) * n.x;
   558	          player.vy = Math.abs(player.vy) * n.y;
   559	        }
   560	      }
   561	    }
   562	    const speed = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
   563	    if (speed < 24) player.settle += dt; else player.settle = 0;
   564	    if (player.settle > .52 || player.shotTime > 8) endShot();
   565	    if (!enemies.length && !walls.some((wall) => wall.alive)) clearStage();
   566	    if (teamHP <= 0) failStage();
   567	  }
   568	
   569	  function endShot() {
   570	    player.launched = false;
   571	    player.vx = 0;
   572	    player.vy = 0;
   573	    const previous = activeSlot;
   574	    activeSlot = (activeSlot + 1) % team.length;
   575	    if (activeSlot === previous) activeSlot = 0;
   576	    resetPlayer();
   577	    renderTeamControls();
   578	    if (enemies.length > 0) hurtTeam(Math.min(7, Math.max(1, enemies.length - 4)));
   579	  }

   581	  function updateShards(dt) {
   582	    for (let i = shards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   583	      const shard = shards[i];
   584	      shard.life -= dt;
   585	      shard.hit = Math.max(0, shard.hit - dt);
   586	      shard.x += shard.vx * dt;
   587	      shard.y += shard.vy * dt;
   588	      shard.vx *= Math.pow(.06, dt);
   589	      shard.vy *= Math.pow(.06, dt);
   590	      if (shard.x - shard.r < ARENA.left || shard.x + shard.r > ARENA.right) shard.vx *= -1;
   591	      if (shard.y - shard.r < ARENA.top || shard.y + shard.r > ARENA.bottom) shard.vy *= -1;
   592	      for (const target of enemies.slice()) {
   593	        if (shard.hit <= 0 && Math.hypot(shard.x - target.x, shard.y - target.y) < shard.r + target.r) {
   594	          shard.hit = .16;
   595	          hitEnemy(target, 1, 'shard', normalize(shard.x - target.x, shard.y - target.y));
   596	        }
   597	      }
   598	      if (shard.life <= 0) shards.splice(i, 1);
   599	    }
   600	  }
   601	
   602	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   603	    for (let i = effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   604	      effects[i].t -= dt;
   605	      if (effects[i].t <= 0) effects.splice(i, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    for (let i = trails.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   608	      trails[i].life -= dt;
   609	      if (trails[i].life <= 0) trails.splice(i, 1);
   610	    }
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   614	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   615	      const p = particles[i];
   616	      p.life -= dt;
   617	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   618	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   619	      p.vx *= Math.pow(.08, dt);
   620	      p.vy *= Math.pow(.08, dt);
   621	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   622	    }
   623	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 18);
   624	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   625	  }

   627	  function guideEndpoint() {
   628	    const origin = player;
   629	    const dir = normalize(aim.x, aim.y);
   630	    let best = 330;
   631	    let hit = null;
   632	    if (dir.x > 0) { const t = (ARENA.right - origin.r - origin.x) / dir.x; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'x'; } }
   633	    if (dir.x < 0) { const t = (ARENA.left + origin.r - origin.x) / dir.x; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'x'; } }
   634	    if (dir.y > 0) { const t = (ARENA.bottom - origin.r - origin.y) / dir.y; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'y'; } }
   635	    if (dir.y < 0) { const t = (ARENA.top + origin.r - origin.y) / dir.y; if (t > 0 && t < best) { best = t; hit = 'y'; } }
   636	    return { x: origin.x + dir.x * best, y: origin.y + dir.y * best, hit, dir };
   637	  }

   639	  function draw() {

   641	    const sy = layout.dpr * layout.scale;
   642	    ctx.setTransform(sx, 0, 0, sy, layout.dpr * (layout.ox + shake * (Math.random() - .5)), layout.dpr * (layout.oy + shake * (Math.random() - .5)));
   643	    ctx.clearRect(-20, -20, VW + 40, VH + 40);
   644	    drawBackground();

   646	    roundRect(10, 10, 370, 590, 24, '#111a28', 'rgba(203,230,246,.16)', 1);
   647	    ctx.clip();
   648	    drawArena();
   649	    ctx.restore();
   650	    drawHud();
   651	    drawBottomHint();
   652	    if (state === 'fail') drawStateCard('RUN OUT', 'The team vitality pool hit zero.', 'Retry this stage');
   653	    if (state === 'clear') drawStateCard('FORMATION CLEARED', `+${stageScore} score  •  next stage loading`, progress.unlocked >= Math.min(6, stage + 3) ? 'Roster expanded' : 'Nice bank');
   654	    if (state === 'win') drawStateCard('Slingfang complete', `12 stages cleared  •  ${score} score`, 'Play again');
   655	  }
