   164	      localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
   165	    } catch (_) {
   166	      // Storage can be disabled or full; the run remains playable.
   167	    }
   168	  }
   169	
   170	  function later(fn, ms) {
   171	    if (pendingTimers.size >= MAX_TIMERS) {
   172	      const oldest = pendingTimers.values().next().value;
   173	      window.clearTimeout(oldest);
   174	      pendingTimers.delete(oldest);
   175	    }
   176	    let timer = 0;
   177	    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
   178	      pendingTimers.delete(timer);
   179	      fn();
   180	    }, ms);
   181	    pendingTimers.add(timer);
   182	    return timer;
   183	  }
   184	
   185	  function cancelTimers() {
   186	    pendingTimers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
   187	    pendingTimers.clear();
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  function clearInput() {
   191	    input.activePointers.clear();
   192	    input.pressedKeys.clear();
   193	    input.queuedActions.length = 0;
   194	    input.stick.x = 0;
   195	    input.stick.y = 0;
   196	  }
   197	
   198	  function announce(message, duration = 1800) {
   199	    game.notice = message;
   200	    game.noticeUntil = performance.now() + duration;
   201	    later(() => {
   202	      if (performance.now() >= game.noticeUntil) game.notice = '';
   203	    }, duration + 30);
   204	  }
   205	
   206	  function unlockAudio() {
   207	    try {
   208	      if (!audioContext) audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
   209	      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume();
   210	    } catch (_) {
   211	      audioContext = null;
   212	    }
   213	  }
   214	
   215	  function tone(frequency, duration, type = 'sine', volume = 0.025) {
   216	    if (!audioContext) return;
   217	    try {
   218	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   219	      const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   220	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   221	      oscillator.type = type;
   222	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   223	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, now);
   224	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
   225	      oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
   226	      oscillator.start(now);
   227	      oscillator.stop(now + duration);
   228	    } catch (_) { /* Audio is optional. */ }
   229	  }
   230	
   231	  function seedFromTime() {
   232	    let seed = (Date.now() ^ Math.floor(performance.now() * 1000)) >>> 0;
   233	    try {
   234	      if (window.crypto && window.crypto.getRandomValues) {
   235	        const values = new Uint32Array(1);
   236	        window.crypto.getRandomValues(values);
   237	        seed ^= values[0];
   238	      }
   239	    } catch (_) { /* Time seed is sufficient. */ }
   240	    return seed || 1;
   241	  }
   242	
   243	  function random() {
   244	    game.rng = (Math.imul(game.rng, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
   245	    return game.rng / 4294967296;
   246	  }
   247	
   248	  function xpForNext() {
   249	    return Math.round(26 + game.rank * 11 + game.rank * game.rank * 0.6);
   250	  }
   251	
   252	  function resetRun() {
   253	    clearInput();
   254	    cancelTimers();
   255	    game.status = 'playing';
   256	    game.rank = 1;
   257	    game.xp = 0;
   258	    game.runXp = 0;
   259	    game.runElapsed = 0;
   260	    game.score = 0;
--- 261-620 ---
   261	    game.runSeed = seedFromTime();
   262	    game.rng = game.runSeed;
   263	    game.legacyAtStart = records.legacy;
   264	    game.maxHp = 72 + records.legacy * 4;
   265	    game.playerHp = game.maxHp;
   266	    game.foeIndex = 0;
   267	    game.attackTimer = 0.25;
   268	    game.foeTimer = 1.05;
   269	    game.sampleTimer = 1;
   270	    game.history = [{ t: 0, xp: 0 }];
   271	    game.particles.length = 0;
   272	    game.floaters.length = 0;
   273	    game.recentDrops.length = 0;
   274	    game.choiceTier = 0;
   275	    game.path = [];
   276	    game.loot = { gear: 0, food: 0, trinket: 0 };
   277	    game.stats = { power: 12 + records.legacy * 0.8, armor: 2 + records.legacy * 0.25, tempo: 1, fortune: records.legacy * 0.005 };
   278	    game.skills = { guard: 0, crit: 0, food: 0 };
   279	    game.ratePerMin = 0;
   280	    game.finalForm = '';
   281	    game.notice = '';
   282	    game.noticeUntil = 0;
   283	    game.shake = 0;
   284	    game.flash = 0;
   285	    game.lastDrop = 'Tap the foe to strike. Forage for a free upgrade.';
   286	    spawnFoe();
   287	  }
   288	
   289	  function spawnFoe() {
   290	    const base = FOES[(game.foeIndex + game.rank - 1) % FOES.length];
   291	    const maxHp = Math.round(28 + game.rank * 8 + game.foeIndex % 3 * 5);
   292	    game.foe = {
   293	      name: base.name,
   294	      color: base.color,
   295	      shape: base.shape,
   296	      maxHp,
   297	      hp: maxHp,
   298	      damage: 5 + game.rank * 0.9 + (game.foeIndex % 4) * 0.8,
   299	      bob: random() * TAU,
   300	      hit: 0,
   301	    };
   302	    game.foeTimer = 1.05;
   303	  }
   304	
   305	  function capPush(list, item, limit) {
   306	    if (list.length >= limit) list.splice(0, list.length - limit + 1);
   307	    list.push(item);
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function addParticles(x, y, color, count = 8, spread = 1) {
   311	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
   312	      capPush(game.particles, {
   313	        x, y,
   314	        vx: (random() - 0.5) * 100 * spread,
   315	        vy: (random() - 0.78) * 120 * spread,
   316	        life: 0.35 + random() * 0.45,
   317	        maxLife: 0.8,
   318	        size: 2 + random() * 4,
   319	        color,
   320	      }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   321	    }
   322	  }
   323	
   324	  function addFloater(textValue, x, y, color) {
   325	    capPush(game.floaters, { text: textValue, x, y, life: 0.8, color }, MAX_FLOATERS);
   326	  }
   327	
   328	  function updateFx(dt) {
   329	    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 16);
   330	    game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt * 4);
   331	    for (let i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   332	      const p = game.particles[i];
   333	      p.life -= dt;
   334	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   335	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   336	      p.vy += 160 * dt;
   337	      if (p.life <= 0) game.particles.splice(i, 1);
   338	    }
   339	    for (let i = game.floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   340	      const f = game.floaters[i];
   341	      f.life -= dt;
   342	      f.y -= 28 * dt;
   343	      if (f.life <= 0) game.floaters.splice(i, 1);
   344	    }
   345	  }
   346	
   347	  function attack() {
   348	    if (game.status !== 'playing' || !game.foe) return;
   349	    const crit = random() < 0.08 + game.skills.crit + game.stats.fortune;
   350	    const damage = game.stats.power * (crit ? 1.75 : 1) + random() * 2.5;
   351	    game.foe.hp -= damage;
   352	    game.foe.hit = 0.16;
   353	    game.shake = Math.min(8, game.shake + (crit ? 3.5 : 1.4));
   354	    game.flash = 0.2;
   355	    game.flashColor = crit ? palette.gold : palette.cyan;
   356	    addFloater(`${crit ? 'CRIT ' : ''}-${Math.round(damage)}`, 278, 142, crit ? palette.gold : palette.paper);
   357	    addParticles(280, 190, crit ? palette.gold : palette.cyan, crit ? 10 : 5, 0.7);
   358	    tone(crit ? 620 : 350, crit ? 0.11 : 0.06, 'triangle', crit ? 0.04 : 0.022);
   359	    if (game.foe.hp <= 0) defeatFoe();
   360	  }
   361	
   362	  function defeatFoe() {
   363	    if (!game.foe) return;
   364	    const reward = Math.round(10 + game.rank * 3.4 + game.stats.fortune * 20);
   365	    game.xp += reward;
   366	    game.runXp += reward;
   367	    game.score += reward * 4 + game.rank * 6;
   368	    addFloater(`+${reward} XP`, 286, 176, palette.gold);
   369	    addParticles(282, 194, game.foe.color, 15, 1.2);
   370	    game.flash = 0.34;
   371	    game.flashColor = game.foe.color;
   372	    game.foeIndex += 1;
   373	    tone(180, 0.08, 'square', 0.03);
   374	    spawnFoe();
   375	    checkRankUps();
   376	  }
   377	
   378	  function checkRankUps() {
   379	    let safety = 0;
   380	    while (game.status === 'playing' && game.rank < 20 && game.xp >= xpForNext() && safety < 4) {
   381	      safety += 1;
   382	      const requirement = xpForNext();
   383	      game.xp -= requirement;
   384	      game.rank += 1;
   385	      game.score += game.rank * 40;
   386	      game.maxHp += 3;
   387	      game.playerHp = Math.min(game.maxHp, game.playerHp + 8);
   388	      records.bestRank = Math.max(records.bestRank, game.rank);
   389	      saveRecords();
   390	      addFloater(`RANK ${game.rank}`, 92, 156, palette.gold);
   391	      addParticles(96, 204, palette.gold, 18, 1.3);
   392	      game.flash = 0.55;
   393	      game.flashColor = palette.gold;
   394	      tone(520, 0.12, 'sine', 0.04);
   395	      if (game.rank === 5 || game.rank === 10 || game.rank === 15) {
   396	        openChoice(Math.floor(game.rank / 5));
   397	        return;
   398	      }
   399	    }
   400	    if (game.rank >= 20) winRun();
   401	  }
   402	
   403	  function openChoice(tier) {
   404	    game.status = 'choice';
   405	    game.choiceTier = tier;
   406	    input.queuedActions.length = 0;
   407	    choiceControls = [];
   408	    announce(`RANK ${game.rank} REACHED — choose a branch`, 2200);
   409	  }
   410	
   411	  function chooseEvolution(branch) {
   412	    if (game.status !== 'choice' || !EVOLUTION[branch]) return;
   413	    const tierIndex = game.choiceTier - 1;
   414	    const delta = EVOLUTION[branch].tiers[tierIndex];
   415	    game.path[tierIndex] = branch;
   416	    game.stats.power += delta.power;
   417	    game.stats.armor += delta.armor;
   418	    game.stats.tempo += delta.tempo;
   419	    if (branch === 'guardian') game.skills.guard += [0.08, 0.12, 0.18][tierIndex];
   420	    if (branch === 'trickster') game.skills.crit += [0.07, 0.14, 0.22][tierIndex];
   421	    if (branch === 'bloom') game.skills.food += [12, 22, 35][tierIndex];
   422	    records.tree[branch] = Math.min(30, records.tree[branch] + 1);
   423	    saveRecords();
   424	    game.status = 'playing';
   425	    game.lastDrop = `${EVOLUTION[branch].label} chosen • ${delta.skill}`;
   426	    game.flash = 0.5;
   427	    game.flashColor = EVOLUTION[branch].color;
   428	    addParticles(195, 208, EVOLUTION[branch].color, 20, 1.4);
   429	    tone(420 + tierIndex * 80, 0.15, 'sine', 0.04);
   430	    checkRankUps();
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function forage() {
   434	    if (game.status !== 'playing') return;
   435	    const roll = random();
   436	    let kind;
   437	    if (roll < 0.45) {
   438	      kind = 'gear';
   439	      const value = 1.2 + game.rank * 0.12;
   440	      game.stats.power += value;
   441	      game.loot.gear += 1;
   442	      game.lastDrop = `GEAR found • +${value.toFixed(1)} power`;
   443	      addFloater(`POWER +${value.toFixed(1)}`, 90, 478, palette.cyan);
   444	      addParticles(90, 550, palette.cyan, 12, 1);
   445	    } else if (roll < 0.8) {
   446	      kind = 'food';
   447	      const value = 8 + game.rank + game.skills.food;
   448	      game.playerHp = Math.min(game.maxHp, game.playerHp + value);
   449	      game.loot.food += 1;
   450	      game.lastDrop = `FOOD found • +${value} vitality`;
   451	      addFloater(`VITAL +${value}`, 90, 478, palette.green);
   452	      addParticles(90, 550, palette.green, 12, 1);
   453	    } else {
   454	      kind = 'trinket';
   455	      const value = 0.07 + game.rank * 0.004;
   456	      game.stats.tempo += value;
   457	      game.stats.fortune += 0.008;
   458	      game.loot.trinket += 1;
   459	      game.lastDrop = `TRINKET found • +${value.toFixed(2)} tempo, luck`;
   460	      addFloater('TEMPO UP', 90, 478, palette.purple);
   461	      addParticles(90, 550, palette.purple, 12, 1);
   462	    }
   463	    capPush(game.recentDrops, kind, MAX_DROPS);
   464	    game.score += 12 + game.rank;
   465	    game.flash = 0.22;
   466	    game.flashColor = kind === 'gear' ? palette.cyan : kind === 'food' ? palette.green : palette.purple;
   467	    tone(kind === 'trinket' ? 740 : kind === 'food' ? 480 : 580, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.03);
   468	  }
   469	
   470	  function foeStrike() {
   471	    if (!game.foe || game.foe.hp <= 0) return;
   472	    const mitigation = Math.max(0.35, 1 - game.stats.armor * 0.028 - game.skills.guard);
   473	    const damage = game.foe.damage * mitigation;
   474	    game.playerHp -= damage;
   475	    game.shake = Math.min(9, game.shake + 2.2);
   476	    addFloater(`-${Math.round(damage)}`, 100, 145, palette.coral);
   477	    addParticles(105, 202, palette.coral, 6, 0.7);
   478	    tone(120, 0.06, 'sawtooth', 0.018);
   479	    if (game.playerHp <= 0) loseRun();
   480	  }
   481	
   482	  function update(dt) {
   483	    if (game.status !== 'playing') return;
   484	    game.runElapsed += dt;
   485	    game.attackTimer -= dt;
   486	    game.foeTimer -= dt;
   487	    let loops = 0;
   488	    while (game.attackTimer <= 0 && loops < 3 && game.status === 'playing') {
   489	      attack();
   490	      game.attackTimer += Math.max(0.34, 0.86 / (game.stats.tempo + 0.2));
   491	      loops += 1;
   492	    }
   493	    loops = 0;
   494	    while (game.foeTimer <= 0 && loops < 2 && game.status === 'playing') {
   495	      foeStrike();
   496	      game.foeTimer += Math.max(0.68, 1.15 - game.rank * 0.008);
   497	      loops += 1;
   498	    }
   499	    if (game.foe) game.foe.hit = Math.max(0, game.foe.hit - dt);
   500	    game.sampleTimer -= dt;
   501	    if (game.sampleTimer <= 0) {
   502	      game.sampleTimer += 1;
   503	      capPush(game.history, { t: game.runElapsed, xp: game.runXp }, MAX_HISTORY);
   504	      updateRate();
   505	    }
   506	    updateFx(dt);
   507	  }
   508	
   509	  function updateRate() {
   510	    if (game.history.length < 2) {
   511	      game.ratePerMin = 0;
   512	      return;
   513	    }
   514	    const newest = game.history[game.history.length - 1];
   515	    const cutoff = newest.t - 60;
   516	    let oldest = game.history[0];
   517	    for (let i = game.history.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   518	      if (game.history[i].t <= cutoff) { oldest = game.history[i]; break; }
   519	    }
   520	    const seconds = Math.max(1, newest.t - oldest.t);
   521	    game.ratePerMin = Math.max(0, (newest.xp - oldest.xp) / seconds * 60);
   522	  }
   523	
   524	  function loseRun() {
   525	    if (game.status !== 'playing') return;
   526	    game.status = 'lost';
   527	    game.playerHp = 0;
   528	    records.bestRank = Math.max(records.bestRank, game.rank);
   529	    records.bestScore = Math.max(records.bestScore, Math.floor(game.score));
   530	    saveRecords();
   531	    clearInput();
   532	    addParticles(104, 203, palette.coral, 20, 1.5);
   533	    tone(90, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.04);
   534	  }
   535	
   536	  function winRun() {
   537	    if (game.status === 'won') return;
   538	    game.status = 'won';
   539	    game.rank = 20;
   540	    game.finalForm = EVOLUTION[game.path[2] || game.path[1] || game.path[0] || 'bloom'].final;
   541	    game.score += 1000 + records.legacy * 100;
   542	    records.bestRank = 20;
   543	    records.bestScore = Math.max(records.bestScore, Math.floor(game.score));
   544	    records.wins = Math.min(9999, records.wins + 1);
   545	    records.legacy = Math.min(20, records.legacy + 1);
   546	    saveRecords();
   547	    clearInput();
   548	    addParticles(195, 210, palette.gold, 35, 1.8);
   549	    tone(520, 0.16, 'sine', 0.04);
   550	    later(() => tone(780, 0.22, 'sine', 0.04), 130);
   551	  }

   553	  function isPaused() {
   554	    return view.landscape || view.hidden || game.status !== 'playing';
   555	  }
   556	
   557	  function processActions() {
   558	    if (input.queuedActions.length > 12) input.queuedActions.splice(0, input.queuedActions.length - 12);
   559	    while (input.queuedActions.length) {
   560	      const action = input.queuedActions.shift();
   561	      if (action === 'restart') { resetRun(); return; }
   562	      if (game.status === 'playing') {
   563	        if (action === 'attack') attack();
   564	        if (action === 'forage') forage();
   565	      } else if (game.status === 'choice' && action.indexOf('choose-') === 0) {
   566	        chooseEvolution(BRANCHES[Number(action.slice(7))]);
   567	      }
   568	    }
   569	  }
   570	
   571	  function queueAction(action) {
   572	    if (input.queuedActions.length < 12) input.queuedActions.push(action);
   573	  }
   574	
   575	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
   576	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   577	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height) };
   578	  }
   579	
   580	  function inside(point, rect) {
   581	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   582	  }
   583	
   584	  function hitControl(point) {
   585	    if (game.status === 'choice') {
   586	      for (let i = 0; i < choiceControls.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, choiceControls[i])) return `choose-${i}`;
   587	      return '';
   588	    }
   589	    if (game.status === 'lost' || game.status === 'won') return inside(point, mainControls.restart) ? 'restart' : '';
   590	    if (inside(point, mainControls.forage)) return 'forage';
   591	    if (point.y >= 92 && point.y <= 312 && point.x >= 176) return 'attack';
   592	    return '';
   593	  }
   594	
   595	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   596	    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
   597	    event.preventDefault();
   598	    unlockAudio();
   599	    if (input.activePointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS || input.activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;
   600	    const control = hitControl(pointFromEvent(event));
   601	    if (!control) return;
   602	    input.activePointers.set(event.pointerId, control);
   603	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* Capture is optional. */ }
   604	  }
   605	
   606	  function onPointerUp(event) {
   607	    event.preventDefault();
   608	    const control = input.activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   609	    input.activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   610	    if (control) queueAction(control);
   611	  }
   612	
   613	  function onPointerCancel(event) {
   614	    event.preventDefault();
   615	    input.activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   616	  }
   617	
   618	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   619	    if (event.code === 'Space' || event.key === '1' || event.key === '2' || event.key === '3' || event.key.toLowerCase() === 'f' || event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') event.preventDefault();
   620	    if (input.pressedKeys.has(event.code)) return;
--- 621-1000 ---
   621	    if (input.pressedKeys.size >= MAX_KEYS) input.pressedKeys.clear();
   622	    input.pressedKeys.add(event.code);
   623	    unlockAudio();
   624	    if (event.code === 'Space') queueAction('attack');
   625	    else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'f') queueAction('forage');
   626	    else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction('restart');
   627	    else if (event.key === '1' || event.key === '2' || event.key === '3') queueAction(`choose-${Number(event.key) - 1}`);
   628	  }
   629	
   630	  function onKeyUp(event) {
   631	    input.pressedKeys.delete(event.code);
   632	  }
   633	
   634	  function resizeCanvas() {
   635	    const rect = shell.getBoundingClientRect();
   636	    const rawDpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   637	    view.dpr = Math.min(rawDpr, 960 / Math.max(1, rect.width, rect.height));
   638	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * view.dpr));
   639	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * view.dpr));
   640	    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
   641	    updateOrientation();
   642	  }
   643	
   644	  function updateOrientation() {
   645	    const next = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   646	    if (next !== view.landscape) clearInput();
   647	    view.landscape = next;
   648	    rotateOverlay.hidden = !view.landscape;
   649	  }
   650	
   651	  function roundedRect(x, y, w, h, radius) {
   652	    const r = Math.min(radius, w / 2, h / 2);
   653	    ctx.beginPath();
   654	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   655	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   656	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   657	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   658	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   659	    ctx.closePath();

   794	  function drawChart(x, y, w, h) {
   795	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#314364'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   796	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h); ctx.stroke();
   797	    if (game.history.length < 2) {
   798	      ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + h - 2); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
   799	      label('collecting live data', x + w / 2, y + h / 2, 8, palette.muted, 'center', 700);
   800	      return;
   801	    }
   802	    const start = game.history[0].t;
   803	    const end = game.history[game.history.length - 1].t;
   804	    const span = Math.max(1, end - start);
   805	    const minXp = game.history.reduce((m, point) => Math.min(m, point.xp), game.history[0].xp);
   806	    const maxXp = game.history.reduce((m, point) => Math.max(m, point.xp), game.history[0].xp);
   807	    const range = Math.max(1, maxXp - minXp);
   808	    ctx.strokeStyle = palette.gold; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath();
   809	    game.history.forEach((point, index) => {
   810	      const px = x + ((point.t - start) / span) * w;
   811	      const py = y + h - ((point.xp - minXp) / range) * (h - 4) - 2;
   812	      if (index === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
   813	    });
   814	    ctx.stroke();
   815	  }

   928	  function frame(now) {
   929	    const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000));
   930	    lastFrame = now;
   931	    if (view.landscape || view.hidden) {
   932	      lastFrame = now;
   933	      // A rotate overlay is a hard simulation pause: no physics, timers, spawns, or particles advance.
   934	    } else {
   935	      // Input still resolves while a choice or end screen is visible; only the run simulation pauses.
   936	      processActions();
   937	      if (game.status === 'playing') update(dt);
   938	      else updateFx(Math.min(dt, 0.033));
   939	    }
   940	    draw();
   941	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   942	  }

   482	  function update(dt) {
   483	    if (game.status !== 'playing') return;
   484	    game.runElapsed += dt;
   485	    game.attackTimer -= dt;
   486	    game.foeTimer -= dt;
   487	    let loops = 0;
   488	    while (game.attackTimer <= 0 && loops < 3 && game.status === 'playing') {
   489	      attack();
   490	      game.attackTimer += Math.max(0.34, 0.86 / (game.stats.tempo + 0.2));
   491	      loops += 1;
   492	    }
   493	    loops = 0;
   494	    while (game.foeTimer <= 0 && loops < 2 && game.status === 'playing') {
   495	      foeStrike();
   496	      game.foeTimer += Math.max(0.68, 1.15 - game.rank * 0.008);
   497	      loops += 1;
   498	    }
   499	    if (game.foe) game.foe.hit = Math.max(0, game.foe.hit - dt);
   500	    game.sampleTimer -= dt;
   501	    if (game.sampleTimer <= 0) {
   502	      game.sampleTimer += 1;
   503	      capPush(game.history, { t: game.runElapsed, xp: game.runXp }, MAX_HISTORY);
   504	      updateRate();
   505	    }
   506	    updateFx(dt);
   507	  }

   509	  function updateRate() {
   510	    if (game.history.length < 2) {
   511	      game.ratePerMin = 0;
   512	      return;
   513	    }
   514	    const newest = game.history[game.history.length - 1];
   515	    const cutoff = newest.t - 60;
   516	    let oldest = game.history[0];
   517	    for (let i = game.history.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   518	      if (game.history[i].t <= cutoff) { oldest = game.history[i]; break; }
   519	    }
   520	    const seconds = Math.max(1, newest.t - oldest.t);
   521	    game.ratePerMin = Math.max(0, (newest.xp - oldest.xp) / seconds * 60);
   522	  }

   557	  function processActions() {
   558	    if (input.queuedActions.length > 12) input.queuedActions.splice(0, input.queuedActions.length - 12);
   559	    while (input.queuedActions.length) {
   560	      const action = input.queuedActions.shift();
   561	      if (action === 'restart') { resetRun(); return; }
   562	      if (game.status === 'playing') {
   563	        if (action === 'attack') attack();
   564	        if (action === 'forage') forage();
   565	      } else if (game.status === 'choice' && action.indexOf('choose-') === 0) {
   566	        chooseEvolution(BRANCHES[Number(action.slice(7))]);
   567	      }
   568	    }
   569	  }
   570	
   571	  function queueAction(action) {
   572	    if (input.queuedActions.length < 12) input.queuedActions.push(action);
   573	  }

   575	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
   576	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   577	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height) };
   578	  }

   580	  function inside(point, rect) {
   581	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   582	  }

   584	  function hitControl(point) {
   585	    if (game.status === 'choice') {
   586	      for (let i = 0; i < choiceControls.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, choiceControls[i])) return `choose-${i}`;
   587	      return '';
   588	    }
   589	    if (game.status === 'lost' || game.status === 'won') return inside(point, mainControls.restart) ? 'restart' : '';
   590	    if (inside(point, mainControls.forage)) return 'forage';
   591	    if (point.y >= 92 && point.y <= 312 && point.x >= 176) return 'attack';
   592	    return '';
   593	  }

   595	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   596	    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
   597	    event.preventDefault();
   598	    unlockAudio();
   599	    if (input.activePointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS || input.activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

   601	    if (!control) return;

   603	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) { /* Capture is optional. */ }
   604	  }

   626	    else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') queueAction('restart');

   628	  }

    58	    if (Number.isFinite(min)) n = Math.max(min, n);

   297	      if (m.ball.owner === 'opp' && m.ball.ownerIndex === p.id && p.cooldown <= 0 && m.ball.y > field.b - 140) {
   298	        aiKick(p, true);
   299	      }
   300	      targetX = clamp(targetX, field.l + 16, field.r - 16); targetY = clamp(targetY, field.t + 18, field.mid - 12);
   301	      moveToward(p, targetX, targetY, (p.pace * 58 + 18) * dt);
   302	    });
   303	    if (m.ball.owner === 'own') {
   304	      var carrier = m.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === m.ball.ownerIndex; });
   305	      if (carrier) { m.ball.x = carrier.x; m.ball.y = carrier.y - 13; m.ball.vx = carrier.vx; m.ball.vy = carrier.vy; }
   306	    } else if (m.ball.owner === 'opp') {
   307	      var oc = m.opp.find(function (p) { return p.id === m.ball.ownerIndex; });
   308	      if (oc) { m.ball.x = oc.x; m.ball.y = oc.y + 13; m.ball.vx = oc.vx; m.ball.vy = oc.vy; }
   309	    }
   310	    if (active && active.stamina < 0.42) addText(active.x, active.y - 28, 'TIRED', COLORS.yellow, 0.8);
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  function moveToward(p, tx, ty, step) {
   314	    var dx = tx - p.x, dy = ty - p.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   315	    if (d > 0.5) { var n = norm(dx, dy); p.vx = n.x * Math.min(d, step) / 0.016; p.vy = n.y * Math.min(d, step) / 0.016; p.x += n.x * Math.min(d, step); p.y += n.y * Math.min(d, step); }
   316	    else { p.vx *= 0.8; p.vy *= 0.8; }
   317	  }
   318	
   319	  function updateBall(dt) {
   320	    var b = match.ball;
   321	    if (b.owner) return;
   322	    b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.vx *= Math.pow(0.25, dt); b.vy *= Math.pow(0.25, dt); b.spin += dt * 5;
   323	    b.trail.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y }); if (b.trail.length > 9) b.trail.shift();
   324	    if (b.x < field.l + 8 || b.x > field.r - 8) { b.x = clamp(b.x, field.l + 8, field.r - 8); b.vx *= -0.75; }
   325	    if (b.y < field.t + 6) { if (b.x > 146 && b.x < 244) scoreGoal('own'); else { b.y = field.t + 6; b.vy *= -0.72; } }
   326	    if (b.y > field.b - 6) { if (b.x > 146 && b.x < 244) scoreGoal('opp'); else { b.y = field.b - 6; b.vy *= -0.72; } }
   327	    if (Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy) < 12) {
   328	      var candidates = match.own.concat(match.opp).filter(function (p) { return dist(p, b) < 18; });
   329	      if (candidates.length) { var p = candidates[0]; b.owner = p.team; b.ownerIndex = p.id; match.possession = p.team; addBurst(b.x, b.y, p.team === 'own' ? COLORS.blue : COLORS.red, 5); }
   330	    }
   331	  }
   332	
   333	  function scoreGoal(team) {
   334	    if (match.scoreFlash > 0) return;
   335	    if (team === 'own') match.ownScore++; else match.oppScore++;
   336	    match.scoreFlash = 1.1; match.banner = team === 'own' ? 'GOAL!  NICE FINISH' : 'CAUGHT ON THE BREAK'; match.bannerTime = 1.5; shake = 11; flash = 0.9;
   337	    addBurst(195, team === 'own' ? field.t + 14 : field.b - 14, team === 'own' ? COLORS.blue : COLORS.red, 28); sound(team === 'own' ? 'goal' : 'tackle');
   338	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = 195; match.ball.y = 352; match.ball.vx = 0; match.ball.vy = 0;
   339	    match.possession = team === 'own' ? 'opp' : 'own';
   340	    match.restartDelay = 0.7;
   341	  }
   342	
   343	  function passBall(vx, vy, curve) {
   344	    if (!match || match.kickCooldown > 0 || match.ball.owner !== 'own') return;
   345	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   346	    if (!carrier) return;
   347	    var n = norm(vx, vy); var target = findPassTarget(carrier, n);
   348	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = carrier.x; match.ball.y = carrier.y - 13;
   349	    match.ball.vx = n.x * 240 + (target.x - carrier.x) * 0.55; match.ball.vy = n.y * 240 + (target.y - carrier.y) * 0.55;
   350	    match.ball.spin = curve || 0; match.kickCooldown = 0.22; match.lastAction = 'PASS LANE  ·  bend the next one'; carrier.cooldown = 0.25; addBurst(carrier.x, carrier.y - 10, COLORS.mint, 9); sound('pass');
   351	  }
   352	
   353	  function shootBall(vx, vy, curve) {
   354	    if (!match || match.kickCooldown > 0 || match.ball.owner !== 'own') return;
   355	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   356	    if (!carrier) return;
   357	    var n = norm(vx, vy); if (n.y > -0.12) n.y = -0.72;
   358	    n = norm(n.x, n.y); match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = carrier.x; match.ball.y = carrier.y - 13;
   359	    var power = 350 + carrier.nerve * 50; match.ball.vx = n.x * power; match.ball.vy = n.y * power; match.ball.spin = (curve || 0) * 1.8;
   360	    match.kickCooldown = 0.38; match.lastAction = 'SHOT  ·  curve follows your swipe'; carrier.cooldown = 0.45; addBurst(carrier.x, carrier.y - 12, COLORS.yellow, 12); sound('kick'); shake = 2;
   361	  }
   362	
   363	  function findPassTarget(carrier, n) {
   364	    var candidates = match.own.filter(function (p) { return p !== carrier; });
   365	    var best = candidates[0], score = -Infinity;
   366	    candidates.forEach(function (p) { var d = norm(p.x - carrier.x, p.y - carrier.y); var s = d.x * n.x + d.y * n.y - dist(p, carrier) / 500; if (s > score) { score = s; best = p; } });
   367	    return best || carrier;
   368	  }
   369	
   370	  function aiKick(player, urgent) {
   371	    if (!match || match.ball.owner !== 'opp') return;
   372	    var target = match.style === 'wing' ? (player.x < 195 ? field.l + 58 : field.r - 58) : 195;
   373	    var n = norm(target - player.x, field.b + 50 - player.y);
   374	    match.ball.owner = null; match.ball.ownerIndex = null; match.ball.x = player.x; match.ball.y = player.y + 13;
   375	    if (urgent || Math.random() < 0.36 + saveData.cup * 0.03) { match.ball.vx = n.x * (205 + match.difficulty * 25); match.ball.vy = n.y * (205 + match.difficulty * 25); match.lastAction = 'THEIR BREAK IS ON'; }
   376	    else { match.ball.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 180; match.ball.vy = 150; match.lastAction = 'WIN IT BACK'; }
   377	    player.cooldown = 1.1; addBurst(player.x, player.y + 10, COLORS.red, 7); sound('kick');
   378	  }
   379	
   380	  function trySteal(defender) {
   381	    if (!match || match.ball.owner !== 'own' || !defender) return;
   382	    var carrier = match.own.find(function (p) { return p.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   383	    if (!carrier || dist(defender, carrier) > 43) return;
   384	    if (Math.random() < 0.4) { match.ball.owner = 'opp'; match.ball.ownerIndex = defender.id; match.possession = 'opp'; addBurst(defender.x, defender.y, COLORS.red, 8); }
   385	  }
   386	
   387	  function tackle() {
   388	    if (!match) return;
   389	    var p = match.own[match.active];
   390	    if (!p) return;
   391	    var target = match.opp.reduce(function (best, q) { return !best || dist(p, q) < dist(p, best) ? q : best; }, null);
   392	    if (target && dist(p, target) < 48) {
   393	      if (match.ball.owner === 'opp' && match.ball.ownerIndex === target.id) { match.ball.owner = 'own'; match.ball.ownerIndex = p.id; match.possession = 'own'; match.lastAction = 'CLEAN TACKLE'; addBurst(target.x, target.y, COLORS.mint, 14); sound('tackle'); shake = 3; }
   394	      else { target.x += (target.x - p.x) * 0.35; target.y += (target.y - p.y) * 0.35; addBurst(p.x, p.y, COLORS.yellow, 6); sound('tackle'); }
   395	    }
   396	  }
   397	
   398	  function switchDefender(x, y) {
   399	    if (!match) return;
   400	    var target = null;
   401	    if (Number.isFinite(x)) target = match.own.reduce(function (best, p) { return !best || dist({ x: x, y: y }, p) < dist({ x: x, y: y }, best) ? p : best; }, null);
   402	    if (target) { match.active = match.own.indexOf(target); match.own.forEach(function (p, i) { p.active = i === match.active; }); match.lastAction = target.name + ' selected'; }
   403	    tackle();
   404	  }

   406	  function actionDirection() {
   407	    var x = 0, y = -1;
   408	    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft')) x -= 1; if (keys.has('ArrowRight')) x += 1; if (keys.has('ArrowDown')) y += 1;
   409	    if (x || y !== -1) return norm(x, y);
   410	    return { x: 0, y: -1 };
   411	  }

   413	  function pointerPos(e) {
   414	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   415	    return { x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) - viewX) / viewScale, 0, W), y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) - viewY) / viewScale, 0, H) };
   416	  }
   417	
   418	  function inRect(p, r) { return !!r && p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h; }
   419	  function setControl(name, id) { if (controlPointers[name] === null) { controlPointers[name] = id; return true; } return false; }
   420	  function releaseControl(id) { Object.keys(controlPointers).forEach(function (k) { if (controlPointers[k] === id) controlPointers[k] = null; }); }
   421	
   422	  function onPointerDown(e) {
   423	    e.preventDefault(); unlockAudio();
   424	    if (blockedByOrientation) return;
   425	    var p = pointerPos(e); activePointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: p.x, y: p.y, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }], mode: null });
   426	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
   427	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   428	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.stick) && setControl('stick', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'stick'; updateStick(p); return; }
   429	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.pass) && setControl('pass', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'pass'; return; }
   430	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.shoot) && setControl('shoot', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'shoot'; return; }
   431	      if (inRect(p, hitAreas.switch) && setControl('switch', e.pointerId)) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'switch'; return; }
   432	      if (p.y >= field.t && p.y <= field.b && setControl('gesture', e.pointerId)) {
   433	        var carrier = match.own.find(function (q) { return q.id === match.ball.ownerIndex; });
   434	        if (carrier && dist(p, carrier) < 64) { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'gesture'; match.drag = { start: p, points: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }] }; }
   435	        else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'defender'; }
   436	      }
   437	    } else { activePointers.get(e.pointerId).mode = 'ui'; }
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function updateStick(p) {
   441	    if (!match) return;
   442	    var c = { x: 64, y: 650 }, v = norm(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y), d = clamp(Math.hypot(p.x - c.x, p.y - c.y) / 44, 0, 1);
   443	    match.stick = { x: v.x * d, y: v.y * d };
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  function onPointerMove(e) {
   447	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   448	    if (rec.points.length < 20) rec.points.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
   449	    if (rec.mode === 'stick') updateStick(p);
   450	    if (rec.mode === 'gesture' && match && match.drag) match.drag.points = rec.points.slice(-20);
   451	  }
   452	
   453	  function onPointerUp(e, cancelled) {
   454	    e.preventDefault(); var rec = activePointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!rec) return; var p = pointerPos(e);
   455	    activePointers.delete(e.pointerId); releaseControl(e.pointerId);
   456	    if (cancelled) { if (rec.mode === 'stick' && match) match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 }; if (match) match.drag = null; return; }
   457	    if (state === 'match' && match) {
   458	      if (rec.mode === 'pass') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0);
   459	      else if (rec.mode === 'shoot') shootBall(0, -1, 0);
   460	      else if (rec.mode === 'switch') switchDefender(match.ball.x, match.ball.y);
   461	      else if (rec.mode === 'stick') match.stick = { x: 0, y: 0 };
   462	      else if (rec.mode === 'gesture') {
   463	        var start = rec.points[0], dx = p.x - start.x, dy = p.y - start.y, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   464	        var curve = rec.points.reduce(function (acc, q, i) { if (!i) return acc; var prev = rec.points[i - 1]; return acc + (q.x - prev.x) * (q.y - start.y) - (q.y - prev.y) * (q.x - start.x); }, 0) / 5000;
   465	        if (len > 18) { if (dy < -22 && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 0.45) shootBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); else passBall(dx, dy, clamp(curve, -1, 1)); }
   466	        else { switchDefender(p.x, p.y); }
   467	        match.drag = null;
   468	      } else if (rec.mode === 'defender') switchDefender(p.x, p.y);
   469	    } else handleUiTap(p);
   470	  }
   471	
   472	  function handleUiTap(p) {
   473	    var area = Object.keys(hitAreas).find(function (key) { return key !== 'stick' && key !== 'pass' && key !== 'shoot' && inRect(p, hitAreas[key]); });
   474	    if (area === 'start') { if (state === 'menu') state = 'lineup'; else if (state === 'loss') replayMatch(); else if (state === 'trophy') newCup(); sound('ui'); }
   475	    else if (area === 'fixture') { if (state === 'lineup' && selected.length === 5) startMatch(); }
   476	    else if (area && area.indexOf('player-') === 0) togglePlayer(Number(area.slice(7)));
   477	  }
   478	
   479	  function togglePlayer(index) {
   480	    if (index < 0 || index >= roster.length) return;
   481	    if (selectedSet.has(index)) { if (selected.length <= 5) return; selected = selected.filter(function (n) { return n !== index; }); selectedSet.delete(index); }
   482	    else if (selected.length < 5) { selected.push(index); selectedSet.add(index); }
   483	    save(); sound('ui');
   484	  }

   486	  function keyDown(e) {
   487	    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'j', 'k', 'J', 'K', ' '].indexOf(e.key) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   488	    unlockAudio();
   489	    if (e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'J') { keys.add('j'); if (state === 'match') passBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   490	    else if (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K') { keys.add('k'); if (state === 'match') shootBall(actionDirection().x, actionDirection().y, 0); }
   491	    else if (e.key === ' ') { if (state === 'match') tackle(); else handleUiTap({ x: 195, y: 540 }); }
   492	    else keys.add(e.key);
   493	  }
   494	
   495	  function keyUp(e) { keys.delete(e.key); }

   497	  function draw() {
   498	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale, 0, 0, pxScale, 0, 0);
   499	    ctx.fillStyle = '#091217'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);
   500	    ctx.setTransform(pxScale * viewScale, 0, 0, pxScale * viewScale, pxScale * viewX, pxScale * viewY);
   501	    var sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
   502	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy); drawScene(); ctx.restore();
   503	    if (flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,201,' + Math.min(0.22, flash * 0.18) + ')'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); }
   504	    if (blockedByOrientation) drawRotateOverlay();
   505	  }

   521	  function roundedPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
   522	    r = Math.min(r, Math.abs(w) / 2, Math.abs(h) / 2); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
   523	  }
   524	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
   525	    roundedPath(x, y, w, h, r); if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); } if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   526	  }

   649	  function addBurst(x, y, color, count) {
   650	    count = Math.min(count || 8, 30);
   651	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: rand(-100, 100), vy: rand(-100, 100), life: rand(0.3, 0.8), max: 0.8, color: color, size: rand(2, 5) });
   652	    if (particles.length > 160) particles.splice(0, particles.length - 160);
   653	  }
   654	  function addText(x, y, value, color, life) { texts.push({ x: x, y: y, value: value, color: color, life: life || 1, max: life || 1 }); if (texts.length > 24) texts.shift(); }
   655	  function updateParticles(dt) { particles.forEach(function (p) { p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= 0.96; p.vy *= 0.96; }); particles = particles.filter(function (p) { return p.life > 0; }).slice(-160); }

   660	  function resize() {
   661	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); cssW = rect.width || W; cssH = rect.height || H;
   662	    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), longAxis = Math.max(cssW, cssH); pxScale = Math.min(dpr, 960 / Math.max(1, longAxis));
   663	    viewScale = Math.min(cssW / W, cssH / H); viewX = (cssW - W * viewScale) / 2; viewY = (cssH - H * viewScale) / 2;
   664	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssW * pxScale)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cssH * pxScale));
   665	    blockedByOrientation = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;

   306	    state.controlBlue = 0;
   307	    state.controlRed = 0;
   308	    state.roundOver = false;
   309	    state.killStreak = 0;
   310	    state.uavTimer = 0;
   311	    state.sensorTimer = 0;
   312	    state.flash = 0;
   313	    state.shake = 0;
   314	    state.charges = { frag: 2, smoke: 2, sensor: 3 };
   315	    state.particles.length = 0;
   316	    state.tracers.length = 0;
   317	    state.smokes.length = 0;
   318	    state.grenades.length = 0;
   319	    state.feed.length = 0;
   320	    state.nextEntityId = 1;
   321	    state.entities.length = 0;
   322	
   323	    const blueSpawns = state.map.spawns.blue;
   324	    const redSpawns = state.map.spawns.red;
   325	    state.player = makeEntity('YOU', 'blue', 'player', blueSpawns[0], state.weapon);
   326	    state.entities.push(state.player);
   327	    const allyNames = ['Kite', 'Mica', 'Dune'];
   328	    const botWeapons = ['ar', 'smg', 'dmr'];
   329	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(allyNames[i], 'blue', 'bot', blueSpawns[i + 1], botWeapons[i]));
   330	    const enemyNames = ['Vex', 'Nix', 'Orla', 'Rook'];
   331	    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) state.entities.push(makeEntity(enemyNames[i], 'red', 'bot', redSpawns[i], botWeapons[(i + 1) % botWeapons.length]));
   332	    $('roundResult').hidden = true;
   333	    renderUi();
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  function respawn(entity) {
   337	    const spawnSet = entity.team === 'blue' ? state.map.spawns.blue : state.map.spawns.red;
   338	    const spawn = spawnSet[(entity.deaths + entity.id) % spawnSet.length];
   339	    entity.x = spawn.x;
   340	    entity.y = spawn.y;
   341	    entity.hp = entity.maxHp;
   342	    entity.alive = true;
   343	    entity.invuln = 1.25;
   344	    entity.fireCd = .35;
   345	    entity.goal = null;
   346	    entity.target = null;
   347	    burst(entity.x, entity.y, entity.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff737b', 8, 32);
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  function circleHitsWall(x, y, radius) {
   351	    for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   352	      const qx = clamp(x, wall.x, wall.x + wall.w);
   353	      const qy = clamp(y, wall.y, wall.y + wall.h);
   354	      if ((x - qx) ** 2 + (y - qy) ** 2 < radius ** 2) return true;
   355	    }
   356	    return false;
   357	  }
   358	
   359	  function moveEntity(entity, dx, dy) {
   360	    const nx = clamp(entity.x + dx, 18, VW - 18);
   361	    const ny = clamp(entity.y + dy, 103, VH - 26);
   362	    if (!circleHitsWall(nx, entity.y, entity.r)) entity.x = nx;
   363	    if (!circleHitsWall(entity.x, ny, entity.r)) entity.y = ny;
   364	  }
   365	
   366	  function segmentHitsWall(a, b) {
   367	    const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 7);
   368	    for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
   369	      const t = i / steps;
   370	      const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   371	      const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   372	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) if (x >= wall.x && x <= wall.x + wall.w && y >= wall.y && y <= wall.y + wall.h) return true;
   373	    }
   374	    return false;
   375	  }
   376	
   377	  function segmentHitsSmoke(a, b) {
   378	    for (const smoke of state.smokes) {
   379	      const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / 9);
   380	      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
   381	        const t = i / steps;
   382	        const x = lerp(a.x, b.x, t);
   383	        const y = lerp(a.y, b.y, t);
   384	        if ((x - smoke.x) ** 2 + (y - smoke.y) ** 2 < smoke.r ** 2) return true;
   385	      }
   386	    }
   387	    return false;
   388	  }
   389	
   390	  function lineClear(a, b, includeSmoke) {
   391	    if (segmentHitsWall(a, b)) return false;
   392	    return !includeSmoke || !segmentHitsSmoke(a, b);
   393	  }
   394	
   395	  function getMoveVector() {
   396	    let x = input.left.x;
   397	    let y = input.left.y;
   398	    if (input.keys.has('w')) y -= 1;
   399	    if (input.keys.has('s')) y += 1;
   400	    if (input.keys.has('a')) x -= 1;
   401	    if (input.keys.has('d')) x += 1;
   402	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   403	    return length > 1 ? { x: x / length, y: y / length } : { x, y };
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function getAimVector() {
   407	    let x = input.right.x;
   408	    let y = input.right.y;
   409	    let usingKeyboard = false;
   410	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowLeft')) { x -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   411	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowRight')) { x += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   412	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowUp')) { y -= 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   413	    if (input.keys.has('ArrowDown')) { y += 1; usingKeyboard = true; }
   414	    const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   415	    if (length > .08) {
   416	      state.lastAim = { x: x / length, y: y / length };
   417	      return state.lastAim;
   418	    }
   419	    return state.lastAim;
   420	  }
   421	
   422	  function playerIsFiring() {
   423	    return input.right.active && Math.hypot(input.right.x, input.right.y) > .12 ||
   424	      input.keys.has('ArrowLeft') || input.keys.has('ArrowRight') || input.keys.has('ArrowUp') || input.keys.has('ArrowDown');
   425	  }
   426	
   427	  function nearestTarget(bot) {
   428	    let best = null;
   429	    let bestScore = Infinity;
   430	    for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   431	      if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === bot.team) continue;
   432	      const distance = dist(bot, candidate);
   433	      const hiddenPenalty = lineClear(bot, candidate, true) ? 0 : 230;
   434	      const score = distance + hiddenPenalty;
   435	      if (score < bestScore) { best = candidate; bestScore = score; }
   436	    }
   437	    return best;
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  function chooseBotGoal(bot) {
   441	    const target = bot.target;
   442	    if (target && target.alive) {
   443	      if (lineClear(target, bot, true)) {
   444	        let cover = null;
   445	        let coverScore = Infinity;
   446	        for (const spot of state.map.covers) {
   447	          if (lineClear(target, spot, true)) continue;
   448	          const score = dist(bot, spot) + dist(target, spot) * .08;
   449	          if (score < coverScore) { cover = spot; coverScore = score; }
   450	        }
   451	        if (cover && dist(bot, cover) < 230) return { x: cover.x, y: cover.y };
   452	      }
   453	      if (dist(bot, target) > WEAPONS[bot.weapon].range * .62) return { x: target.x, y: target.y };
   454	      return { x: target.x + Math.cos(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe, y: target.y + Math.sin(bot.angle + Math.PI / 2) * 34 * bot.strafe };
   455	    }
   456	    if (state.mode === 'control' && dist(bot, state.map.point) > 76) return { x: state.map.point.x, y: state.map.point.y };
   457	    return { x: bot.x, y: bot.y };
   458	  }
   459	
   460	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   461	    const player = state.player;
   462	    if (!player.alive) {
   463	      player.respawn -= dt;
   464	      if (player.respawn <= 0) respawn(player);
   465	      return;
   466	    }
   467	    player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);
   468	    player.fireCd -= dt;
   469	    player.weapon = state.weapon;
   470	    const move = getMoveVector();
   471	    moveEntity(player, move.x * 124 * dt, move.y * 124 * dt);
   472	    const aim = getAimVector();
   473	    player.angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x);
   474	    if (playerIsFiring()) shoot(player, aim, true);
   475	  }
   476	
   477	  function updateBot(bot, dt) {
   478	    if (!bot.alive) {
   479	      bot.respawn -= dt;
   480	      if (bot.respawn <= 0) respawn(bot);
   481	      return;
   482	    }
   483	    bot.invuln = Math.max(0, bot.invuln - dt);
   484	    bot.fireCd -= dt;
   485	    bot.think -= dt;
   486	    if (bot.think <= 0) {
   487	      bot.think = .22 + Math.random() * .18;
   488	      bot.target = nearestTarget(bot);
   489	      bot.goal = chooseBotGoal(bot);
   490	    }
   491	    const target = bot.target && bot.target.alive ? bot.target : nearestTarget(bot);
   492	    if (target) bot.target = target;
   493	    const weapon = WEAPONS[bot.weapon];
   494	    if (target && lineClear(bot, target, true)) {
   495	      const aimX = target.x - bot.x;
   496	      const aimY = target.y - bot.y;
   497	      const distance = Math.hypot(aimX, aimY);
   498	      bot.angle = Math.atan2(aimY, aimX);
   499	      if (distance < weapon.range * 1.08 && bot.fireCd <= 0) shoot(bot, { x: aimX / distance, y: aimY / distance }, false);
   500	    }
   501	    const goal = bot.goal || chooseBotGoal(bot);
   502	    if (goal) {
   503	      const gx = goal.x - bot.x;
   504	      const gy = goal.y - bot.y;
   505	      const length = Math.hypot(gx, gy);
   506	      if (length > 8) moveEntity(bot, gx / length * 64 * dt, gy / length * 64 * dt);
   507	    }
   508	  }
   509	
   510	  function shoot(shooter, aim, isPlayer) {
   511	    if (!shooter.alive || shooter.fireCd > 0) return;
   512	    const weapon = WEAPONS[shooter.weapon];
   513	    shooter.fireCd = weapon.cooldown;
   514	    const angle = Math.atan2(aim.y, aim.x) + (Math.random() - .5) * weapon.spread;
   515	    const direction = { x: Math.cos(angle), y: Math.sin(angle) };
   516	    const start = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * (shooter.r + 3), y: shooter.y + direction.y * (shooter.r + 3) };
   517	    let end = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * weapon.range, y: shooter.y + direction.y * weapon.range };
   518	    let hit = null;
   519	    for (let distance = 0; distance <= weapon.range; distance += 5) {
   520	      const point = { x: shooter.x + direction.x * distance, y: shooter.y + direction.y * distance };
   521	      let blocked = false;
   522	      for (const wall of state.map.walls) {
   523	        if (point.x >= wall.x && point.x <= wall.x + wall.w && point.y >= wall.y && point.y <= wall.y + wall.h) { blocked = true; break; }
   524	      }
   525	      if (blocked) { end = point; break; }
   526	      for (const candidate of state.entities) {
   527	        if (!candidate.alive || candidate.team === shooter.team || candidate.id === shooter.id) continue;
   528	        if ((point.x - candidate.x) ** 2 + (point.y - candidate.y) ** 2 < (candidate.r + 3) ** 2) {
   529	          hit = candidate;
   530	          end = point;
   531	          break;
   532	        }
   533	      }
   534	      if (hit) break;
   535	    }
   536	    pushCap(state.tracers, { x1: start.x, y1: start.y, x2: end.x, y2: end.y, life: .075, color: weapon.color }, MAX_TRACERS);
   537	    burst(start.x, start.y, weapon.color, isPlayer ? 3 : 2, 22);
   538	    if (hit) {
   539	      const falloff = clamp(1 - dist(shooter, hit) / weapon.range * .35, .58, 1);
   540	      takeDamage(hit, weapon.damage * falloff, shooter);
   541	      burst(end.x, end.y, hit.team === 'blue' ? '#83d2ff' : '#ff7b7e', 6, 42);
   542	      if (isPlayer) state.flash = .07;
   543	    }
   544	    tone(isPlayer ? 125 : 90, .035, 'square', isPlayer ? .018 : .009);
   545	  }
   546	
   547	  function takeDamage(target, amount, attacker) {
   548	    if (!target.alive || target.invuln > 0) return;
   549	    target.hp -= amount;
   550	    target.invuln = Math.max(target.invuln, .06);
   551	    if (target.type === 'player') { state.flash = .11; state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3); }
   552	    if (target.hp <= 0) eliminate(target, attacker);
   553	  }
   554	
   555	  function eliminate(victim, killer) {
   556	    if (!victim.alive) return;
   557	    victim.alive = false;
   558	    victim.hp = 0;
   559	    victim.respawn = 2.2;
   560	    victim.deaths++;
   561	    if (killer) {
   562	      killer.kills++;
   563	      if (killer.team === 'blue') state.blue++; else state.red++;
   564	      if (killer.type === 'player') {
   565	        state.killStreak++;
   566	        if (state.killStreak === 3) {
   567	          state.uavTimer = 8;
   568	          addFeed('UAV PING ONLINE', '#59e0c0');
   569	          tone(760, .18, 'sine', .04);
   570	        }
   571	      }
   572	      addFeed(`${killer.name} dropped ${victim.name}`, killer.team === 'blue' ? '#7ccaff' : '#ff7b7e');
   573	    }
   574	    if (victim.type === 'player') {
   575	      state.killStreak = 0;
   576	      addFeed('YOU ARE DOWN · RESPAWNING', '#ffbc63');
   577	      state.shake = 7;
   578	      tone(52, .18, 'sawtooth', .035);
   579	    }
   580	    burst(victim.x, victim.y, victim.team === 'blue' ? '#66caff' : '#ff6872', 18, 75);
   581	    if (state.mode === 'tdm' && (state.blue >= 20 || state.red >= 20)) endRound();
   582	  }
   583	
   584	  function useGadget() {
   585	    if (state.roundOver || !state.player.alive) return;
   586	    const type = state.gadget;
   587	    if (!state.charges[type]) { addFeed(`${type.toUpperCase()} EMPTY`, '#ffbc63'); tone(180, .06, 'square', .025); return; }
   588	    const aim = getAimVector();
   589	    const range = type === 'sensor' ? 0 : 106;
   590	    const target = { x: clamp(state.player.x + aim.x * range, 22, VW - 22), y: clamp(state.player.y + aim.y * range, 110, VH - 30) };
   591	    state.charges[type]--;
   592	    if (type === 'frag') {
   593	      if (state.grenades.length < MAX_GRENADES) state.grenades.push({ x: target.x, y: target.y, t: .72, owner: state.player });
   594	      addFeed('FRAG OUT', '#ffbc63');
   595	      tone(230, .08, 'square', .035);
   596	    } else if (type === 'smoke') {
   597	      pushCap(state.smokes, { x: target.x, y: target.y, r: 66, life: 7 }, MAX_SMOKES);
   598	      burst(target.x, target.y, '#aeb9bd', 16, 44);
   599	      addFeed('SMOKE SCREEN ACTIVE', '#b9d4d0');
   600	      tone(300, .08, 'sine', .025);
   601	    } else {
   602	      state.sensorTimer = 5;
   603	      addFeed('SENSOR PING · HOSTILES MARKED', '#e2b269');
   604	      burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#e2b269', 14, 34);
   605	      tone(640, .12, 'sine', .035);
   606	    }
   607	  }
   608	
   609	  function explodeFrag(grenade) {
   610	    burst(grenade.x, grenade.y, '#ffbd66', 32, 115);
   611	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 8);
   612	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   613	      if (!entity.alive || entity.team === grenade.owner.team) continue;
   614	      const distance = Math.hypot(entity.x - grenade.x, entity.y - grenade.y);
   615	      if (distance < 84 && lineClear(grenade, entity, false)) takeDamage(entity, 88 * (1 - distance / 130), grenade.owner);
   616	    }
   617	    tone(68, .22, 'sawtooth', .045);
   618	  }
   619	
   620	  function updateOrdnance(dt) {
--- 621-980 ---
   621	    for (let i = state.grenades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   622	      const grenade = state.grenades[i];
   623	      grenade.t -= dt;
   624	      if (grenade.t <= 0) { explodeFrag(grenade); state.grenades.splice(i, 1); }
   625	    }
   626	    for (let i = state.smokes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   627	      state.smokes[i].life -= dt;
   628	      if (state.smokes[i].life <= 0) state.smokes.splice(i, 1);
   629	    }
   630	  }
   631	
   632	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   633	    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   634	      const p = state.particles[i];
   635	      p.life -= dt;
   636	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   637	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   638	      p.vx *= .94;
   639	      p.vy *= .94;
   640	      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   641	    }
   642	    for (let i = state.tracers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   643	      state.tracers[i].life -= dt;
   644	      if (state.tracers[i].life <= 0) state.tracers.splice(i, 1);
   645	    }
   646	    for (let i = state.feed.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   647	      state.feed[i].life -= dt;
   648	      if (state.feed[i].life <= 0) state.feed.splice(i, 1);
   649	    }
   650	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt);
   651	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 16);
   652	    state.uavTimer = Math.max(0, state.uavTimer - dt);
   653	    state.sensorTimer = Math.max(0, state.sensorTimer - dt);
   654	  }
   655	
   656	  function updateControl(dt) {
   657	    if (state.mode !== 'control') return;
   658	    let blue = 0;
   659	    let red = 0;
   660	    for (const entity of state.entities) {
   661	      if (!entity.alive || dist(entity, state.map.point) > state.map.point.r) continue;
   662	      if (entity.team === 'blue') blue++; else red++;
   663	    }
   664	    if (blue > red) state.controlBlue = clamp(state.controlBlue + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   665	    if (red > blue) state.controlRed = clamp(state.controlRed + dt * 5, 0, 100);
   666	    if (state.controlBlue >= 100 || state.controlRed >= 100) endRound();
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  function update(dt) {
   670	    if (orientationBlocked || state.roundOver) return;
   671	    state.roundTime = Math.max(0, state.roundTime - dt);
   672	    updatePlayer(dt);
   673	    for (const entity of state.entities) if (entity.type === 'bot') updateBot(entity, dt);
   674	    updateOrdnance(dt);
   675	    updateControl(dt);
   676	    updateEffects(dt);
   677	    if (input.queuedGadget) { input.queuedGadget = 0; useGadget(); }
   678	    if (state.roundTime <= 0) endRound();
   679	  }
   680	
   681	  function burst(x, y, color, count, force) {
   682	    const safeCount = Math.min(count, MAX_PARTICLES - state.particles.length);
   683	    for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i++) {
   684	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   685	      const speed = Math.random() * force;
   686	      pushCap(state.particles, { x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: .16 + Math.random() * .35, size: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5, color }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   687	    }
   688	  }
   689	
   690	  function addFeed(text, color) { pushCap(state.feed, { text, color, life: 3.2 }, MAX_FEED); }
   691	
   692	  function endRound() {
   693	    if (state.roundOver) return;
   694	    state.roundOver = true;
   695	    releaseAllInput();
   696	    cancelPendingTimers();
   697	    const blueScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.blue : Math.floor(state.controlBlue);
   698	    const redScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.red : Math.floor(state.controlRed);
   699	    const winner = blueScore > redScore ? 'blue' : redScore > blueScore ? 'red' : 'draw';
   700	    const win = winner === 'blue';
   701	    const xpGain = winner === 'draw' ? 50 : (win ? 100 : 35) + Math.min(40, state.player.kills * 4);
   702	    profile.xp = clamp(profile.xp + xpGain, 0, 999999);
   703	    profile.wins = clamp(profile.wins + (win ? 1 : 0), 0, 999999);
   704	    profile.played = clamp(profile.played + 1, 0, 999999);
   705	    profile.bestKills = Math.max(profile.bestKills, state.player.kills);
   706	    profile.camo = clamp(Math.floor(profile.xp / 125), 0, CAMOS.length - 1);
   707	    writeStore('ironsight-ops-profile', profile);
   708	    const title = winner === 'draw' ? 'DRAW' : win ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT';
   709	    $('resultTitle').textContent = title;
   710	    $('resultTitle').style.color = winner === 'draw' ? '#ffbc63' : win ? '#59e0c0' : '#ff6872';
   711	    $('resultBody').textContent = `${state.map.name} · ${state.mode === 'tdm' ? 'TEAM DEATHMATCH' : 'CONTROL POINT'} · ${blueScore} — ${redScore}. ${win ? 'Your squad owns the drill.' : winner === 'draw' ? 'Nobody took the final lane.' : 'Recalibrate and take the next lane.'}`;
   712	    $('resultKills').textContent = `${state.player.kills} KILLS · ${xpGain} XP`;
   713	    $('resultRank').textContent = `RANK ${String(rankNumber()).padStart(2, '0')} · CAMO ${profile.camo + 1}`;
   714	    $('roundResult').hidden = false;
   715	    renderUi();
   716	    tone(win ? 520 : 120, .28, win ? 'sine' : 'sawtooth', .04);
   717	  }
   718	
   719	  function cycleMap() {
   720	    state.mapIndex = (state.mapIndex + 1) % MAPS.length;
   721	    resetRound();
   722	  }
   723	
   724	  function cycleMode() {
   725	    state.mode = state.mode === 'tdm' ? 'control' : 'tdm';
   726	    resetRound();
   727	  }
   728	
   729	  function renderUi() {
   730	    const blueScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.blue : Math.floor(state.controlBlue);
   731	    const redScore = state.mode === 'tdm' ? state.red : Math.floor(state.controlRed);
   732	    $('blueScore').textContent = pad(blueScore);
   733	    $('redScore').textContent = pad(redScore);

   507	      var angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
   508	      var speed = 18 + random() * 55;
   509	      game.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18, life: .35 + random() * .45, max: .8, size: 1.5 + random() * 3.2, color: color });
   510	    }
   511	  }
   512	
   513	  function floatText(value, x, y, color) {
   514	    if (game.floaters.length >= 20) game.floaters.shift();
   515	    game.floaters.push({ value: value, x: x, y: y, color: color || palette.cream, life: 1 });
   516	  }
   517	
   518	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   519	    for (var i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   520	      var particle = game.particles[i];
   521	      particle.life -= dt;
   522	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   523	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   524	      particle.vy += 72 * dt;
   525	      if (particle.life <= 0) game.particles.splice(i, 1);
   526	    }
   527	    for (var j = game.floaters.length - 1; j >= 0; j -= 1) {
   528	      var floater = game.floaters[j];
   529	      floater.life -= dt * .9;
   530	      floater.y -= dt * 24;
   531	      if (floater.life <= 0) game.floaters.splice(j, 1);
   532	    }
   533	  }

   535	  function roundedBar(x, y, w, h, ratio, fill, back) {
   536	    ctx.fillStyle = back || 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)';
   537	    roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, h / 2);
   538	    ctx.fill();
   539	    if (ratio > 0) {
   540	      ctx.fillStyle = fill;
   541	      roundRect(ctx, x, y, Math.max(h, w * clamp(ratio, 0, 1)), h, h / 2);
   542	      ctx.fill();
   543	    }
   544	  }

   576	  function roman(number) {
   577	    var values = ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X'];
   578	    return values[Math.min(values.length - 1, number - 1)] || 'X';
   579	  }

   809	  function drawEffects() {
   810	    for (var i = 0; i < game.particles.length; i += 1) {
   811	      var particle = game.particles[i];
   812	      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(particle.life / particle.max, 0, 1);
   813	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
   814	      ctx.fillRect(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, particle.size);
   815	    }
   816	    for (var j = 0; j < game.floaters.length; j += 1) {
   817	      var floater = game.floaters[j];
   818	      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(floater.life, 0, 1);
   819	      text(floater.value, floater.x, floater.y, 10, floater.color, 800, 'center');
   820	    }
   821	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   822	  }

   900	  function draw() {
   901	    if (!game) return;
   902	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
   903	    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, view.cssW, view.cssH);
   904	    ctx.save();
   905	    ctx.translate(view.ox, view.oy);
   906	    ctx.scale(view.scale, view.scale);
   907	    ctx.save();
   908	    if (game.shake > 0) ctx.translate((random() - .5) * game.shake, (random() - .5) * game.shake);
   909	    drawBackground();
   910	    drawHeader();
   911	    drawHint();
   912	    for (var i = 0; i < tableRects.length; i += 1) drawTable(tableRects[i], i);
   913	    drawStations();
   914	    drawUpgrades();
   915	    drawEffects();
   916	    activePointers.forEach(function (pointer) { drawDraggedPlate(pointer); });
   917	    ctx.restore();
   918	    if (game.flash > 0) {
   919	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,216,' + (game.flash * .14) + ')';

   926	  function resize() {
   927	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   928	    view.cssW = Math.max(1, rect.width);
   929	    view.cssH = Math.max(1, rect.height);
   930	    view.scale = Math.min(view.cssW / W, view.cssH / H);
   931	    view.ox = (view.cssW - W * view.scale) / 2;
   932	    view.oy = (view.cssH - H * view.scale) / 2;
   933	    view.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(view.cssW, view.cssH));
   934	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.cssW * view.dpr));
   935	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(view.cssH * view.dpr));
   936	  }

   948	  function toWorld(event) {
   949	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

   952	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top - view.oy) / view.scale, 0, H)

   956	  function inside(point, rect) {
   957	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   958	  }

   960	  function tableAt(point) {
   961	    for (var i = 0; i < tableRects.length; i += 1) if (inside(point, tableRects[i])) return i;
   962	    return -1;
   963	  }
   964	
   965	  function plateAt(point) {
   966	    if (!inside(point, stationRects[2])) return null;
   967	    if (!game.plates.length) return null;
   968	    var centerX = stationRects[2].x + 58;
   969	    var centerY = stationRects[2].y + 63;
   970	    if (Math.abs(point.x - centerX) < 42 && Math.abs(point.y - centerY) < 27) return game.plates[game.plates.length - 1];
   971	    return null;
   972	  }

   974	  function pointerDown(event) {
   975	    event.preventDefault();
   976	    if (game.orientationPaused) return;
   977	    var point = toWorld(event);
   978	    var pointer = { id: event.pointerId, kind: 'none', x: point.x, y: point.y, station: -1, plateId: null, nextAction: 0 };
   979	    var table = tableAt(point);
   980	    if (game.state !== 'rush') {
   981	      if (game.state === 'failed' && point.x >= 45 && point.x <= 345 && point.y >= 350 && point.y <= 650) restartFromFail();
   982	      else if (game.state === 'waveClear') nextWave();
   983	      else if (game.state === 'prestige') prestige();
   984	      return;
   985	    }
   986	    if (point.y >= 672) {
   987	      buyUpgrade();
   988	      return;
   989	    }
   990	    var plate = plateAt(point);
   991	    if (plate) {
   992	      pointer.kind = 'plate';
   993	      pointer.plateId = plate.id;
   994	      pointer.x = point.x;
   995	      pointer.y = point.y;
   996	      activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
   997	      try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
   998	      return;
   999	    }
  1000	    for (var i = 0; i < stationRects.length; i += 1) {
  1001	      if (inside(point, stationRects[i])) {
  1002	        game.selectedStation = i;
  1003	        pointer.kind = 'station';
  1004	        pointer.station = i;
  1005	        pointer.nextAction = 0;
  1006	        activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
  1007	        try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1008	        stationAction(i);
  1009	        return;
  1010	      }
  1011	    }
  1012	    if (table >= 0) {
  1013	      game.selectedTable = table;
  1014	      var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === table && !item.served && !item.leaving; });
  1015	      if (customer) customer.bounce = .3;
  1016	    }
  1017	    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, pointer);
  1018	  }
  1019	
  1020	  function pointerMove(event) {
  1021	    event.preventDefault();
  1022	    var pointer = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1023	    if (!pointer) return;
  1024	    var point = toWorld(event);
  1025	    pointer.x = point.x;
  1026	    pointer.y = point.y;
  1027	  }
  1028	
  1029	  function pointerUp(event) {
  1030	    event.preventDefault();
  1031	    var pointer = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
  1032	    if (!pointer) return;
  1033	    if (pointer.kind === 'plate' && game.state === 'rush') {
  1034	      var table = tableAt({ x: pointer.x, y: pointer.y });
  1035	      var plateIndex = game.plates.findIndex(function (plate) { return plate.id === pointer.plateId; });
  1036	      if (plateIndex >= 0 && table >= 0) {
  1037	        var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === table; });
  1038	        if (serveCustomer(customer)) {
  1039	          game.plates.splice(plateIndex, 1);
  1040	          game.bakedStock = Math.max(0, game.bakedStock - 1);
  1041	        }
  1042	      }
  1043	    }
  1044	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1045	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1046	  }
  1047	
  1048	  function pointerCancel(event) {
  1049	    event.preventDefault();
  1050	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  1051	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* capture is optional */ }
  1052	  }

  1054	  function restartFromFail() {
  1055	    resetWave();
  1056	    playSound('start');
  1057	  }

  1059	  function keyDown(event) {
  1060	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Space', 'Enter'].indexOf(event.code) >= 0 || /^Digit[123]$/.test(event.code) || event.code === 'KeyR') event.preventDefault();
  1061	    if (heldKeys.has(event.code)) return;
  1062	    heldKeys.add(event.code);
  1063	    if (game.orientationPaused) return;
  1064	    if (game.state !== 'rush') {
  1065	      if (event.code === 'KeyR' || event.code === 'Enter' || event.code === 'Space') {
  1066	        if (game.state === 'failed') restartFromFail();
  1067	        else if (game.state === 'waveClear') nextWave();
  1068	        else if (game.state === 'prestige') prestige();
  1069	      }
  1070	      return;
  1071	    }
  1072	    if (event.code === 'Digit1') { game.selectedStation = 0; stationAction(0); }
  1073	    if (event.code === 'Digit2') { game.selectedStation = 1; stationAction(1); }
  1074	    if (event.code === 'Digit3') { game.selectedStation = 2; }
  1075	    if (event.code === 'ArrowLeft') game.selectedStation = (game.selectedStation + 2) % 3;
  1076	    if (event.code === 'ArrowRight') game.selectedStation = (game.selectedStation + 1) % 3;
  1077	    if (event.code === 'ArrowUp') { game.selectedTable = (game.selectedTable + 2) % 3; }
  1078	    if (event.code === 'ArrowDown') { game.selectedTable = (game.selectedTable + 1) % 3; }
  1079	    if (event.code === 'Space' || event.code === 'Enter') {
  1080	      if (game.selectedStation === 2) {
  1081	        var customer = game.customers.find(function (item) { return item.table === game.selectedTable; });
  1082	        var plate = game.plates[game.plates.length - 1];
  1083	        if (plate && serveCustomer(customer)) {
  1084	          game.plates.pop();
  1085	          game.bakedStock = Math.max(0, game.bakedStock - 1);
  1086	        }
  1087	      } else stationAction(game.selectedStation);
  1088	    }
  1089	  }
  1090	
  1091	  function keyUp(event) {
  1092	    heldKeys.delete(event.code);
  1093	  }

  1095	  function loop(now) {
  1096	    if (!lastFrame) lastFrame = now;
  1097	    var dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000));
  1098	    lastFrame = now;
  1099	    if (!game.orientationPaused) {
  1100	      if (game.state === 'rush') updateRush(dt);
  1101	      updateEffects(dt);
  1102	    }
  1103	    draw();
  1104	    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  1105	  }

    13	    a = a >>> 0;
    14	    return function () {
    15	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    16	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);

    28	      pick: function (arr) { return arr[Math.floor(f() * arr.length) % arr.length]; },

   105	  function pickDailyMissions(day) {
   106	    var r = makeRng(hashSeed(day));
   107	    var pool = MISSIONS.slice();
   108	    var out = [];
   109	    for (var i = 0; i < 3 && pool.length; i++) {
   110	      var k = Math.floor(r.f() * pool.length) % pool.length;
   111	      out.push({ id: pool[k].id, tier: 0, prog: 0 });
   112	      pool.splice(k, 1);
   113	    }
   114	    return out;
   115	  }

   117	  /* ---------- save state ---------- */
   118	  var Save = {
   119	    data: null,
   120	    load: function () {
   121	      var day = dayKey();
   122	      var o = rawGet() || {};
   123	      var d = {
   124	        day: int(o.day, day),
   125	        best: int(o.best, 0),
   126	        coins: int(o.coins, 0),
   127	        runs: int(o.runs, 0),

   129	        rotations: int(o.rotations, 0),

   131	      };

   133	      if (ms && d.day === day) {
   134	        var clean = [];
   135	        for (var i = 0; i < ms.length && clean.length < 3; i++) {
   136	          var m = ms[i];
   137	          if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') continue;
   138	          if (typeof m.id !== 'string') continue;
   139	          var found = false;
   140	          for (var j = 0; j < MISSIONS.length; j++) if (MISSIONS[j].id === m.id) found = true;
   141	          if (!found) continue;
   142	          clean.push({ id: m.id, tier: clamp(int(m.tier, 0), 0, 3), prog: Math.max(0, int(m.prog, 0)) });
   143	        }
   144	        d.missions = clean.length === 3 ? clean : null;
   145	      }
   146	      if (!d.missions) { d.missions = pickDailyMissions(day); d.day = day; }
   147	      d.best = Math.max(0, Math.min(d.best, 9999999));
   148	      d.coins = Math.max(0, Math.min(d.coins, 9999999));

   156	  var Audio2 = {
   157	    ctx: null, master: null, ok: false, muted: false,
   158	    unlock: function () {
   159	      if (this.ctx) { if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') { try { this.ctx.resume(); } catch (e) { } } return; }

   167	        this.ok = true;
   168	        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
   169	      } catch (e) { this.ok = false; }
   170	    },
   171	    tone: function (freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
   172	      if (!this.ok || this.muted) return;
   173	      try {
   174	        var c = this.ctx, t = c.currentTime;
   175	        var o = c.createOscillator(), gn = c.createGain();
   176	        o.type = type || 'square';
   177	        o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   178	        if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, slideTo), t + dur);
   179	        gn.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   180	        gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.2, t + 0.012);
   181	        gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   182	        o.connect(gn); gn.connect(this.master);
   183	        o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.03);
   184	      } catch (e) { }
   185	    },
   186	    noise: function (dur, vol, hp) {
   187	      if (!this.ok || this.muted) return;
   188	      try {
   189	        var c = this.ctx, t = c.currentTime;
   190	        var n = Math.floor(c.sampleRate * dur);
   191	        var buf = c.createBuffer(1, Math.max(1, n), c.sampleRate);
   192	        var ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
   193	        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) ch[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
   194	        var s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = buf;
   195	        var f = c.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = hp ? 'highpass' : 'lowpass';
   196	        f.frequency.value = hp || 900;
   197	        var gn = c.createGain(); gn.gain.value = vol || 0.2;
   198	        s.connect(f); f.connect(gn); gn.connect(this.master);
   199	        s.start(t); s.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
   200	      } catch (e) { }
   201	    },
   202	    coin: function (n) { this.tone(760 + (n % 6) * 60, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.16); },
   203	    jump: function () { this.tone(300, 0.16, 'square', 0.14, 700); },
   204	    slide: function () { this.noise(0.22, 0.16, 1600); },
   205	    land: function () { this.tone(140, 0.08, 'sine', 0.16); },

    19	      this._pm = function (e) { self.onMove(e); };
    20	      this._pu = function (e) { self.onUp(e); };
    21	      this._pc = function (e) { self.onCancel(e); };
    22

    25	        el.addEventListener('pointermove', this._pm, opt);

    27	        window.addEventListener('pointercancel', this._pc, opt);
    28	        el.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', this._pc, opt);
    29	      } else {
