    31	        el.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'move'); }, opt);
    32	        window.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'up'); }, opt);
    33	        window.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { self.touch(e, 'cancel'); }, opt);
    34	        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'down'); }, opt);
    35	        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'move'); }, opt);
    36	        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { self.mouse(e, 'up'); }, opt);
    37	      }

    40	      el.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);

    51	      e.preventDefault();

    53	      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    54	        var t = list[i];
    55	        var fake = { pointerId: 'T' + t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { } };
    56	        if (kind === 'down') this.onDown(fake);
    57	        else if (kind === 'move') this.onMove(fake);
    58	        else if (kind === 'up') this.onUp(fake);
    59	        else this.onCancel(fake);
    60	      }
    61	    },
    62	    mouse: function (e, kind) {
    63	      var fake = { pointerId: 'M', clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY, preventDefault: function () { } };
    64	      if (kind === 'down') { e.preventDefault(); this.onDown(fake); }
    65	      else if (kind === 'move') { if (this.pointers.has('M')) this.onMove(fake); }
    66	      else this.onUp(fake);
    67	    },
    68	
    69	    onDown: function (e) {
    70	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    71	      if (!this.enabled) return;
    72	      var id = e.pointerId;
    73	      this.pointers.set(id, { x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t0: performance.now(), fired: false });
    74	      if (this.el && this.el.setPointerCapture && typeof id === 'number') {
    75	        try { this.el.setPointerCapture(id); } catch (err) { }
    76	      }
    77	    },
    78	    onMove: function (e) {
    79	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    80	      var p = this.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    81	      if (!p) return;
    82	      p.x = e.clientX; p.y = e.clientY;
    83	      if (p.fired) return;
    84	      var dx = p.x - p.x0, dy = p.y - p.y0;
    85	      if (Math.abs(dx) < this.SWIPE && Math.abs(dy) < this.SWIPE) return;
    86	      p.fired = true;
    87	      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) this.push(dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left');
    88	      else this.push(dy > 0 ? 'down' : 'up');
    89	    },
    90	    onUp: function (e) {
    91	      var p = this.pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    92	      if (!p) return;
    93	      this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    94	      if (!p.fired && this.enabled) {
    95	        var dt = performance.now() - p.t0;
    96	        var dx = (e.clientX || p.x) - p.x0, dy = (e.clientY || p.y) - p.y0;
    97	        if (dt < 400 && Math.abs(dx) < this.SWIPE && Math.abs(dy) < this.SWIPE) this.push('up'); // tap = vault
    98	      }
    99	    },
   100	    onCancel: function (e) { this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId); },
   101	
   102	    onKey: function (e, down) {
   103	      var k = e.key;
   104	      var map = {
   105	        ArrowLeft: 'left', a: 'left', A: 'left',
   106	        ArrowRight: 'right', d: 'right', D: 'right',
   107	        ArrowUp: 'up', w: 'up', W: 'up', ' ': 'up',
   108	        ArrowDown: 'down', s: 'down', S: 'down'
   109	      };
   110	      var act = map[k];
   111	      if (act) {
   112	        e.preventDefault();
   113	        if (down && !this.keys.has(k) && this.enabled) this.push(act);
   114	        if (down) this.keys.add(k); else this.keys.delete(k);
   115	        return;
   116	      }
   117	      if (!down) this.keys.delete(k);
   118	      if (down && (k === 'p' || k === 'P' || k === 'Escape')) {
   119	        if (typeof this.onPause === 'function') this.onPause();
   120	      }
   121	      if (down && (k === 'r' || k === 'R')) {
   122	        if (typeof this.onRestart === 'function') this.onRestart();
   123	      }
   124	      if (down && (k === 'm' || k === 'M')) {
   125	        g.TD.Audio.muted = !g.TD.Audio.muted;
   126	      }
   127	    },
   128	
   129	    push: function (a) { if (this.queue.length < 6) this.queue.push(a); },
   130	    take: function () { return this.queue.length ? this.queue.shift() : null; },
   131	
   132	    releaseAll: function () {
   133	      this.pointers.clear();

   136	    },
   137	    reset: function () { this.releaseAll(); this.enabled = true; }

    76	  function rngFrom(seed) {
    77	    var a = seed >>> 0;
    78	    return function () {
    79	      a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    80	      var t = a;
    81	      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);
    82	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    83	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    84	    };
    85	  }

   240	    if (c.obsRooms[r + ':' + room]) return null;

   242	    c.obsRooms[r + ':' + room] = true;
   243	    var rows = [], i, caughtAny = false;
   244	    var present = MH.actualIn(W, room);
   245	    for (i = 0; i < present.length; i++) {
   246	      var id = present[i], kind, txt;
   247	      if (W.fake[id] === 2) {
   248	        kind = 2; txt = 'caught ' + W.act + ' — log says ' + MH.ROOMS[W.claim[id]].n;
   249	      } else if (W.fake[id] === 1) {
   250	        kind = 2; txt = 'faking it: ' + pick(c.rnd, MH.FAKETASKS[room]);
   251	      } else {
   252	        kind = 1; txt = W.task[id] + ' — matches the log';
   253	      }
   254	      if (kind === 2) caughtAny = true;
   255	      c.verdict[r][id] = kind;
   256	      if (kind === 2) { if (c.status[id] !== MH.CAUGHT) c.status[id] = MH.EXPOSED; }
   257	      else if (c.status[id] === MH.UNKNOWN) c.status[id] = MH.CLEARED;
   258	      rows.push({ id: id, kind: kind, t: txt });
   259	    }
   260	    var claim = MH.claimedIn(W, room);
   261	    for (i = 0; i < claim.length; i++) {
   262	      var q = claim[i];
   263	      if (W.place[q] === room) continue;
   264	      c.verdict[r][q] = 2;
   265	      if (c.status[q] !== MH.CAUGHT) c.status[q] = MH.EXPOSED;
   266	      caughtAny = true;
   267	      rows.push({ id: q, kind: 2, t: 'NO-SHOW — the log posted them here' });
   268	    }
   269	    var res = { r: r, room: room, rows: rows, hit: caughtAny };
   270	    c.lastObs = res;
   271	    return res;
   272	  };

   274	  /* ---------- questioning ---------- */

   276	  function nameOf(id) { return MH.STAFF[id]; }

   278	  MH.question = function (c, id) {
   279	    if (c.over || c.qLeft <= 0) return null;
   280	    var W = MH.world(c), r = c.round, i;
   281	    if (W.place[id] < 0) return null;
   282	    var k;
   283	    for (k = 0; k < c.stmts.length; k++) {
   284	      if (c.stmts[k].r === r && c.stmts[k].sp === id) return null;
   285	    }
   286	    c.qLeft--;
   287	    var D = MH.DIFFS[c.diff];
   288	    var mole = MH.isMole(c, id) && c.status[id] !== MH.CAUGHT;
   289	    var room, seen = [], line;
   290	
   291	    if (!mole) {
   292	      room = W.place[id];
   293	      var co = MH.actualIn(W, room);
   294	      for (i = 0; i < co.length; i++) if (co[i] !== id) seen.push(co[i]);
   295	      if (seen.length === 0) {
   296	        line = 'I was alone in the ' + MH.ROOMS[room].n + ', ' + W.task[id] + '.';
   297	      } else {
   298	        line = 'I was in the ' + MH.ROOMS[room].n + ', ' + W.task[id] + '. ' +
   299	          listNames(seen) + (seen.length > 1 ? ' were' : ' was') + ' in there with me.';
   300	      }
   301	    } else {
   302	      room = W.claim[id];
   303	      var smart = c.rnd() < D.smart;
   304	      var pool = [];
   305	      for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
   306	        if (i === id || W.place[i] < 0) continue;
   307	        var consistent = (W.claim[i] === room);
   308	        if (smart ? consistent : !consistent) pool.push(i);
   309	      }
   310	      if (!pool.length) {
   311	        for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) if (i !== id && W.place[i] >= 0) pool.push(i);
   312	      }
   313	      if (smart) {
   314	        seen = pool.slice(0, 3);
   315	      } else {
   316	        seen = [pick(c.rnd, pool)];
   317	      }
   318	      if (seen.length === 0) line = 'I was alone in the ' + MH.ROOMS[room].n + '. Nothing to tell.';
   319	      else line = 'I never left the ' + MH.ROOMS[room].n + '. ' + listNames(seen) +
   320	        (seen.length > 1 ? ' can' : ' can') + ' vouch for me.';
   321	      if (D.noise > 1 && c.rnd() < 0.5) {
   322	        var t = -1;
   323	        for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
   324	          if (i !== id && !MH.isMole(c, i) && c.status[i] === MH.UNKNOWN) { t = i; break; }
   325	        }
   326	        if (t >= 0) line += ' Ask why ' + nameOf(t) + ' keeps drifting off, though.';
   327	      }
   328	    }
   329	
   330	    // conflicts vs the public log
   331	    var conflicts = [];
   332	    for (i = 0; i < seen.length; i++) {
   333	      if (W.claim[seen[i]] !== room) conflicts.push(seen[i]);
   334	    }
   335	    var cl = MH.claimedIn(W, room);
   336	    for (i = 0; i < cl.length; i++) {
   337	      var q = cl[i];
   338	      if (q === id) continue;
   339	      if (seen.indexOf(q) < 0) conflicts.push(q);
   340	    }
   341	    var st = { r: r, sp: id, room: room, seen: seen, line: line, conf: conflicts };
   342	    for (i = 0; i < conflicts.length; i++) {
   343	      c.conf[conflicts[i]]++;
   344	      c.conf[id]++;
   345	    }
   346	    c.stmts.push(st);
   347	    while (c.stmts.length > 48) c.stmts.shift();
   348	    return st;
   349	  };

   351	  function listNames(ids) {
   352	    var a = [], i;
   353	    for (i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) a.push(nameOf(ids[i]));
   354	    if (a.length === 1) return a[0];
   355	    if (a.length === 2) return a[0] + ' and ' + a[1];
   356	    return a.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + a[a.length - 1];
   357	  }

     1	/* WebAudio synthesis only - no assets, no network. */
     2	(function () {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var MH = (window.MH = window.MH || {});
     5	  var ctx = null, master = null, ok = false, muted = false;
     6	
     7	  function unlock() {
     8	    if (ok) return;
     9	    try {
    10	      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    11	      if (!AC) return;
    12	      ctx = new AC();
    13	      master = ctx.createGain();
    14	      master.gain.value = 0.32;
    15	      master.connect(ctx.destination);
    16	      ok = true;
    17	    } catch (e) { ok = false; }
    18	    if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended') { try { ctx.resume(); } catch (e2) {} }
    19	  }
    20	
    21	  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, delay, slideTo) {
    22	    if (!ok || muted || !ctx) return;
    23	    try {
    24	      var t0 = ctx.currentTime + (delay || 0);
    25	      var o = ctx.createOscillator(), g = ctx.createGain();
    26	      o.type = type || 'square';
    27	      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
    28	      if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, slideTo), t0 + dur);
    29	      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
    30	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, vol || 0.2), t0 + 0.012);
    31	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
    32	      o.connect(g); g.connect(master);
    33	      o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
    34	    } catch (e) {}
    35	  }
    36	
    37	  function noise(dur, vol, delay, hp) {
    38	    if (!ok || muted || !ctx) return;
    39	    try {
    40	      var t0 = ctx.currentTime + (delay || 0);
    41	      var n = (ctx.sampleRate * dur) | 0;
    42	      var buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, n, ctx.sampleRate);
    43	      var d = buf.getChannelData(0), i;
    44	      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
    45	      var s = ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = buf;
    46	      var f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'highpass'; f.frequency.value = hp || 700;
    47	      var g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.15;
    48	      s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(master); s.start(t0);
    49	    } catch (e) {}
    50	  }
    51	
    52	  var S = {
    53	    tap: function () { tone(420, 0.06, 'square', 0.12); },
    54	    move: function () { tone(300, 0.05, 'triangle', 0.10); },
    55	    open: function () { tone(520, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.16); tone(780, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.10, 0.05); },
    56	    close: function () { tone(360, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.12); },
    57	    look: function () { noise(0.18, 0.10, 0, 1200); tone(660, 0.10, 'sine', 0.12); },

    59	    lie: function () { tone(220, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.20, 0, 110); noise(0.2, 0.12, 0, 500); },
    60	    alarm: function () { tone(500, 0.16, 'square', 0.16); tone(380, 0.20, 'square', 0.16, 0.16); },
    61	    catch_: function () {

   107	  function finish() {
   108	    var c = G.c;
   109	    var used = Math.min(MH.ROUNDS, c.round + (c.over === 1 ? 1 : 0));
   110	    store.cases.unshift({ w: c.over === 1, d: c.diff, r: used });
   111	    while (store.cases.length > 8) store.cases.pop();

   113	    if (!this.ok || this.muted || !this.ctx) return;
   114	    var t = this.ctx.currentTime;
   115	    if (t - this.last < 0.012) return; this.last = t;
   116	    try {
   117	      var o = this.ctx.createOscillator(), g = this.ctx.createGain();
   118	      o.type = type || 'square';
   119	      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   120	      if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, slideTo), t + dur);
   121	      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   122	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, vol || 0.2), t + 0.008);
   123	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   124	      o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
   125	      o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
   126	    } catch (e) { }
   127	  },
   128	  noise: function (dur, vol, hp) {
   129	    if (!this.ok || this.muted || !this.ctx) return;
   130	    try {
   131	      var t = this.ctx.currentTime, n = Math.floor(this.ctx.sampleRate * dur);
   132	      if (n < 8) n = 8;
   133	      var buf = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, n, this.ctx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
   134	      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
   135	      var src = this.ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
   136	      var f = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'highpass'; f.frequency.value = hp || 400;
   137	      var g = this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.2;
   138	      src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(this.master); src.start(t);
   139	    } catch (e) { }
   140	  }
   141	};

   159	EO.Particles = function () { this.list = []; };
   160	EO.Particles.prototype.add = function (x, y, vx, vy, life, col, size, grav) {
   161	  if (this.list.length >= EO.PMAX) this.list.shift();
   162	  this.list.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, t: life, mt: life, c: col, s: size || 3, g: grav === undefined ? 40 : grav });
   163	};
   164	EO.Particles.prototype.burst = function (x, y, n, col, spd, size) {
   165	  n = Math.min(n, 18);
   166	  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   167	    var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8);
   168	    this.add(x, y, Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s, 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4, col, size || 3, 60);
   169	  }
   170	};
   171	EO.Particles.prototype.update = function (dt) {
   172	  var l = this.list;
   173	  for (var i = l.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   174	    var p = l[i];
   175	    p.t -= dt;
   176	    if (p.t <= 0) { l.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   177	    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += p.g * dt;
   178	    p.vx *= (1 - 1.4 * dt);
   179	  }
   180	  if (l.length > EO.PMAX) l.splice(0, l.length - EO.PMAX);
   181	};
   182	EO.Particles.prototype.draw = function (g) {
   183	  var l = this.list;
   184	  for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
   185	    var p = l[i], a = EO.clamp(p.t / p.mt, 0, 1);
   186	    g.globalAlpha = a;
   187	    g.fillStyle = p.c;
   188	    var s = p.s * (0.5 + a * 0.5);
   189	    g.fillRect(p.x - s * 0.5, p.y - s * 0.5, s, s);
   190	  }
   191	  g.globalAlpha = 1;
   192	};
   193	EO.Particles.prototype.clear = function () { this.list.length = 0; };

   179	    /* [type, first map it can appear, first wave it can appear] */

   181	      ['runner', 0, 0], ['grunt', 0, 0], ['swarm', 1, 1], ['flyer', 2, 2],
   182	      ['shell', 3, 3], ['brute', 2, 4], ['bomber', 4, 5]
   183	    ];
   184	    for (w = 0; w < m.waves; w++) {
   185	      var pool = [];

   187	      var groups = [], gcount = 1 + Math.floor(w / 3) + (rng() < 0.4 ? 1 : 0);
   188	      if (gcount > 3) gcount = 3;
   189	      var budget = (24 + w * 16) * (1 + 0.11 * mi) * (np > 1 ? 0.84 : 1), airUsed = 0;
   190	      for (var g = 0; g < gcount; g++) {
   191	        var t = pool[Math.floor(rng() * pool.length)];
   192	        /* at most one airborne group per wave */
   193	        if (EO.ENEMIES[t].air) { if (airUsed) t = (rng() < 0.5) ? 'runner' : 'grunt'; else airUsed = 1; }
   194	        if (w === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'runner' : 'grunt';
   195	        if (w === 1 && mi === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'grunt' : 'runner';
   196	        var e = EO.ENEMIES[t];
   197	        var share = budget / gcount;
   198	        var n = Math.max(2, Math.round(share / (e.hp * 0.36)));
   199	        if (n > 14) n = 14;
   200	        groups.push({
   201	          type: t, count: n,
   202	          gap: e.air ? 0.55 : (0.75 - Math.min(0.3, w * 0.03)),
   203	          delay: g * (1.6 + rng() * 1.4),
   204	          path: Math.floor(rng() * np)
   205	        });
   206	      }
   207	      /* every third wave from map 3 onward gets an air flight */
   208	      if (mi >= 2 && (w % 3 === 2)) {
   209	        groups.push({ type: (mi >= 4 && w > 4) ? 'bomber' : 'flyer', count: Math.min(6, 3 + Math.floor(w / 4)), gap: 0.5, delay: 3.4, path: 0 });

    31	    }

    33	  }
    34	  function checkOrient(w, h) {
    35	    var land = w > h && h < 560;
    36	    if (land) {
    37	      if (!EO.blocked) { EO.blocked = true; rotOv.style.display = 'flex'; clearInput(); }
    38	    } else if (EO.blocked) {
    39	      EO.blocked = false; rotOv.style.display = 'none'; last = 0;
    40	    }
    41	  }

    43	  /* ---------- input state reset (hardening #2/#3) ---------- */
    44	  function clearInput() {
    45	    for (var k in pointers) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(pointers, k)) delete pointers[k];
    46	    keys = {};
    47	    EO.drag.active = false; EO.drag.id = -1; EO.drag.card = -1; EO.drag.cell = null; EO.drag.moved = false;
    48	  }

    51	  function fullReset() {
    52	    clearInput();
    53	    EO.clearTimers();
    54	    G.sel = null;
    55	    G.paused = false;
    56	    G.speed = 1;
    57	    last = 0;

    60	  /* ---------- coordinate helpers ---------- */
    61	  function pos(ev) {
    62	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    63	    return { x: ev.clientX - r.left, y: ev.clientY - r.top };
    64	  }
    65	  function cellAt(x, y) {
    66	    var L = G.L;
    67	    var c = Math.floor((x - L.ox) / L.tile), r = Math.floor((y - L.oy) / L.tile);
    68	    if (c < 0 || r < 0 || c >= EO.COLS || r >= EO.ROWS) return null;
    69	    return { c: c, r: r };
    70	  }
    71	  function defaultDir(c, r) {
    72	    /* face the nearest path tile */
    73	    var bd = 1e9, bdir = 0;
    74	    for (var d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
    75	      for (var k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
    76	        var cc = c + EO.DIRS[d][0] * k, rr2 = r + EO.DIRS[d][1] * k;
    77	        if (EO.isPath(cc, rr2)) { if (k < bd) { bd = k; bdir = d; } break; }
    78	      }
    79	    }
    80	    return bdir;
    81	  }
    82	  function dirFrom(dx, dy) {
    83	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) return dx > 0 ? 1 : 3;
    84	    return dy > 0 ? 2 : 0;
    85	  }

    89	  function goBase() { fullReset(); G.screen = 'base'; EO.sfx.ui(); }

    96	  function craft(kitId) {
    97	    var S = G.save, kt = EO.KIT_BY_ID[kitId];
    98	    if (!kt) return;
    99	    var slot = EO.baseSlot;
   100	    if (slot >= EO.slotsUnlocked(S.cleared)) { EO.sfx.deny(); return; }
   101	    if (S.kits.indexOf(kitId) >= 0) { EO.sfx.deny(); return; }
   102	    if (S.mats.scrap < kt.cost.scrap || S.mats.ember < kt.cost.ember || S.mats.alloy < kt.cost.alloy) { EO.sfx.deny(); return; }
   103	    S.mats.scrap -= kt.cost.scrap; S.mats.ember -= kt.cost.ember; S.mats.alloy -= kt.cost.alloy;
   104	    S.kits[slot] = kitId;
   105	    EO.writeSave(S);
   106	    EO.sfx.craft();
   107	  }

   109	  function handleButton(b) {
   110	    switch (b.id) {
   111	      case 'speed': G.speed = G.speed === 1 ? 2 : 1; EO.sfx.ui(); return true;
   112	      case 'pause': G.paused = !G.paused; EO.sfx.ui(); return true;
   113	      case 'resume': G.paused = false; EO.sfx.ui(); return true;
   114	      case 'quit': goMaps(); return true;
   115	      case 'skill': if (G.sel) EO.useSkill(G.sel); return true;
   116	      case 'recycle': if (G.sel) EO.recycle(G.sel); return true;
   117	      case 'again':
   118	        deploy(b.next);
   119	        return true;
   120	      case 'base': goBase(); return true;
   121	      case 'maps': goMaps(); return true;
   122	      case 'back': goMaps(); return true;
   123	      case 'playsel': deploy(Math.min(G.save.cleared, EO.MAPS.length - 1)); return true;
   124	    }
   125	    return false;
   126	  }

   128	  /* ---------- pointer ---------- */
   129	  function onDown(ev) {
   130	    if (EO.blocked) return;
   131	    EO.audio.resume();
   132	    var p = pos(ev);
   133	    pointers[ev.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y };
   134	    EO.kbActive = false;
   135	    var i;
   136	    /* UI buttons first (they are rebuilt each frame) */
   137	    for (i = U.btns.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   138	      if (U.btns[i].on !== false && EO.hit(U.btns[i], p.x, p.y)) { if (handleButton(U.btns[i])) return; }
   139	    }
   140	    if (G.screen === 'maps') {
   141	      for (i = 0; i < U.mapBtns.length; i++) {
   142	        var mb = U.mapBtns[i];
   143	        if (mb.open && EO.hit(mb, p.x, p.y)) { deploy(mb.idx); return; }
   144	      }
   145	      return;
   146	    }
   147	    if (G.screen === 'base') {
   148	      for (i = 0; i < U.slots.length; i++) {
   149	        if (U.slots[i].open && EO.hit(U.slots[i], p.x, p.y)) { EO.baseSlot = U.slots[i].idx; EO.sfx.ui(); return; }
   150	      }
   151	      for (i = 0; i < U.recipes.length; i++) {
   152	        if (EO.hit(U.recipes[i], p.x, p.y)) { craft(U.recipes[i].kitId); return; }
   153	      }
   154	      return;
   155	    }
   156	    if (G.screen !== 'play' || G.paused || G.state === 'won' || G.state === 'lost') return;
   157	
   158	    /* tray cards */
   159	    for (i = 0; i < U.cards.length; i++) {
   160	      if (EO.hit(U.cards[i], p.x, p.y)) {
   161	        var D = EO.drag;
   162	        if (D.active) return;
   163	        D.active = true; D.id = ev.pointerId; D.card = U.cards[i].idx;
   164	        D.x = p.x; D.y = p.y; D.sx = p.x; D.sy = p.y; D.moved = false;
   165	        D.cell = null; D.dir = 0;
   166	        G.sel = null;
   167	        G.kbCard = D.card;
   168	        EO.audio.tone(420, 0.04, 'square', 0.08);
   169	        return;
   170	      }
   171	    }
   172	    /* grid tap: select / deselect */
   173	    var cell = cellAt(p.x, p.y);
   174	    if (cell) {
   175	      var dd = EO.defAt(cell.c, cell.r);
   176	      if (dd) { G.sel = (G.sel === dd) ? null : dd; EO.sfx.ui(); }
   177	      else G.sel = null;
   178	    }
   179	  }
   180	
   181	  function onMove(ev) {
   182	    if (EO.blocked) return;
   183	    var pt = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   184	    if (!pt) return;
   185	    var p = pos(ev);
   186	    pt.x = p.x; pt.y = p.y;
   187	    var D = EO.drag;
   188	    if (D.active && D.id === ev.pointerId) {
   189	      D.x = p.x; D.y = p.y;
   190	      if (Math.abs(p.x - D.sx) > 6 || Math.abs(p.y - D.sy) > 6) D.moved = true;
   191	      var cell = cellAt(p.x, p.y);
   192	      if (cell) {
   193	        if (!D.cell || D.cell.c !== cell.c || D.cell.r !== cell.r) {
   194	          D.cell = cell;
   195	          D.dir = defaultDir(cell.c, cell.r);
   196	        } else {
   197	          var cx = EO.cellX(cell.c), cy = EO.cellY(cell.r);
   198	          var dx = p.x - cx, dy = p.y - cy;
   199	          if (dx * dx + dy * dy > (G.L.tile * 0.30) * (G.L.tile * 0.30)) D.dir = dirFrom(dx, dy);
   200	        }
   201	      } else {
   202	        D.cell = null;
   203	      }
   204	    }
   205	  }
   206	
   207	  function onUp(ev, cancel) {
   208	    var D = EO.drag;
   209	    if (D.active && D.id === ev.pointerId) {
   210	      if (!cancel && D.cell && !EO.blocked) {
   211	        var id = G.save.unlocked[D.card];
   212	        if (id) EO.placeDefender(id, D.cell.c, D.cell.r, D.dir);
   213	      }
   214	      D.active = false; D.id = -1; D.card = -1; D.cell = null; D.moved = false;
   215	    }
   216	    delete pointers[ev.pointerId];
   217	  }

   220	  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onMove(e); }, { passive: false });
   221	  cv.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onUp(e, false); }, { passive: false });

   230	  /* ---------- keyboard ---------- */
   231	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   232	    if (EO.blocked) return;
   233	    var k = e.key;
   234	    if (keys[k]) { if (k === ' ' || k.indexOf('Arrow') === 0) e.preventDefault(); return; }
   235	    keys[k] = 1;
   236	    if (!running) {
   237	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }
   238	      return;
   239	    }
   240	    EO.audio.resume();
   241	    if (G.screen !== 'play') {
   242	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   243	        e.preventDefault();
   244	        if (G.screen === 'result') { var nb = null; for (var i = 0; i < U.btns.length; i++) if (U.btns[i].id === 'again') nb = U.btns[i]; if (nb) handleButton(nb); }
   245	        else if (G.screen === 'maps') deploy(Math.min(G.save.cleared, EO.MAPS.length - 1));
   246	        else if (G.screen === 'base') goMaps();
   247	      } else if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'b' || k === 'B') { goMaps(); }
   248	      return;
   249	    }
   250	    EO.kbActive = true;
   251	    var C = G.cursor;
   252	    switch (k) {
   253	      case 'ArrowUp': e.preventDefault(); C.r = EO.clamp(C.r - 1, 0, EO.ROWS - 1); break;
   254	      case 'ArrowDown': e.preventDefault(); C.r = EO.clamp(C.r + 1, 0, EO.ROWS - 1); break;
   255	      case 'ArrowLeft': e.preventDefault(); C.c = EO.clamp(C.c - 1, 0, EO.COLS - 1); break;
   256	      case 'ArrowRight': e.preventDefault(); C.c = EO.clamp(C.c + 1, 0, EO.COLS - 1); break;
   257	      case 'r': case 'R': G.kbDir = (G.kbDir + 1) & 3; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   258	      case 'q': case 'Q': G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + G.save.unlocked.length - 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   259	      case 'e': case 'E': case 'Tab': e.preventDefault(); G.kbCard = (G.kbCard + 1) % G.save.unlocked.length; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   260	      case ' ': {
   261	        e.preventDefault();
   262	        var dd = EO.defAt(C.c, C.r);
   263	        if (dd) { G.sel = (G.sel === dd) ? null : dd; EO.sfx.ui(); }
   264	        else { var id = G.save.unlocked[G.kbCard]; if (id) EO.placeDefender(id, C.c, C.r, G.kbDir); }
   265	        break;
   266	      }
   267	      case 'Enter': e.preventDefault(); if (G.sel) EO.useSkill(G.sel); break;
   268	      case 'x': case 'X': if (G.sel) EO.recycle(G.sel); break;
   269	      case 'p': case 'P': case 'Escape': G.paused = !G.paused; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   270	      case 'f': case 'F': G.speed = G.speed === 1 ? 2 : 1; EO.sfx.ui(); break;
   271	    }
   272	  }, { passive: false });
   273	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });

   275	  /* ---------- keyboard cursor overlay ---------- */
   276	  function drawCursor() {
   277	    if (!EO.kbActive || G.screen !== 'play' || G.paused) return;
   278	    var L = G.L, t = L.tile, C = G.cursor;
   279	    var id = G.save.unlocked[G.kbCard];
   280	    var free = EO.buildable(C.c, C.r);
   281	    if (id && free) {
   282	      var cells = EO.fpPreview(id, C.c, C.r, G.kbDir);
   283	      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,84,0.16)';
   284	      for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) g.fillRect(L.ox + cells[i][0] * t + 1, L.oy + cells[i][1] * t + 1, t - 2, t - 2);
   285	      var cx = EO.cellX(C.c), cy = EO.cellY(C.r), d = EO.DIRS[G.kbDir];
   286	      g.strokeStyle = '#ffb454'; g.lineWidth = 3;
   287	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(cx, cy); g.lineTo(cx + d[0] * t * 0.7, cy + d[1] * t * 0.7); g.stroke();
   288	    }
   289	    g.strokeStyle = free ? '#ffb454' : '#e05f5f';
   290	    g.lineWidth = 3;
   291	    g.strokeRect(L.ox + C.c * t + 2, L.oy + C.r * t + 2, t - 4, t - 4);
   292	  }
   293	
   294	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   295	  function frame(ts) {
   296	    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   297	    if (EO.blocked) { last = 0; return; }
   298	    if (!last) last = ts;
   299	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   300	    last = ts;
   301	    if (!(dt > 0)) dt = 0;
   302	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   303	    EO.update(dt);
   304	    EO.render(g);
   305	    drawCursor();
   306	  }
   307	
   308	  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
   309	  function boot() {
   310	    if (running) return;
   311	    running = true;
   312	    EO.audio.init();
   313	    EO.audio.resume();
   314	    startOv.style.display = 'none';
   315	    G.save = EO.loadSave();
   316	    resize();
   317	    EO.startMap(Math.min(G.save.cleared, EO.MAPS.length - 1));
   318	    last = 0;
   319	    if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
   320	    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   321	  }
   322	  startBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); });
   323	  startBtn.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }, { passive: false });
   324	
   325	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   326	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { EO.after(120, resize); });
   327	
   328	  /* pre-boot layout so the first frame is correct */
   329	  G.save = EO.loadSave();
   330	  resize();
   331	
   332	})(window.EO);

   167	  function inFp(dd, e) {
   168	    var cells = EO.fpCells(dd), i;
   169	    if (!e.air) {

   177	    }
   178	    return false;
   179	  }
   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];

   183	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   184	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   185	      if (e.dead) continue;
   186	      if (tgt === 'g' && e.air) continue;
   187	      if (tgt === 'a' && !e.air) continue;
   188	      if (inFp(dd, e)) out.push(e);
   189	    }
   190	    /* front-most (furthest along) first */
   191	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.prog - a.prog; });
   192	    return out;
   193	  }

   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;

   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }

   240	  /* ---------- spawning ---------- */
   241	  function spawnEnemy(type, pathIdx) {
   242	    if (G.enemies.length >= 90) return;
   243	    var base = EO.ENEMIES[type];
   244	    if (!base) return;
   245	    var s = EO.mapScale(G.mapIdx);
   246	    var hp = Math.round(base.hp * s);
   247	    var e = {
   248	      def: base, air: base.air, hp: hp, maxhp: hp, dead: false,
   249	      slow: 0, stun: 0, root: 0, burn: 0, burnT: 0, oil: 0,
   250	      atkCd: 0, tgt: null, flash: 0, prog: 0, kbcd: 0, rage: 0, cc: 0, cr: 0, x: 0, y: 0
   251	    };
   252	    if (base.air) {
   253	      e.x = G.L.ox + EO.rnd(G.L.tile * 0.6, G.L.tile * (EO.COLS - 0.6));
   254	      e.y = G.L.oy - 26 - EO.rnd(0, 40);
   255	      e.gx = EO.cellX(G.gate.c); e.gy = EO.cellY(G.gate.r);
   256	      e.ph = Math.random() * 6.28;
   257	    } else {
   258	      var pi = EO.clamp(pathIdx | 0, 0, G.paths.length - 1);
   259	      e.path = G.paths[pi]; e.seg = 0; e.u = 0;
   260	      e.x = EO.cellX(e.path[0].c); e.y = EO.cellY(e.path[0].r);
   261	    }
   262	    G.enemies.push(e);
   263	  }

   265	  function updateSpawner(dt) {
   266	    if (G.state !== 'prep' && G.state !== 'wave') return;
   267	    if (G.state === 'prep') {
   268	      G.prepT -= dt;
   269	      if (G.prepT <= 0) {
   270	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) return;
   271	        var w = G.waves[G.waveIdx];
   272	        G.queue.length = 0;
   273	        for (var i = 0; i < w.groups.length; i++) {
   274	          var g = w.groups[i];
   275	          for (var n = 0; n < g.count; n++) {
   276	            G.queue.push({ t: g.delay + n * g.gap, type: g.type, path: g.path });
   277	          }
   278	        }
   279	        G.queue.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
   280	        if (G.queue.length > 200) G.queue.length = 200;
   281	        G.state = 'wave'; G.waveActive = true;
   282	        EO.audio.tone(300, 0.1, 'square', 0.16, 420);
   283	      }
   284	      return;
   285	    }
   286	    /* wave */
   287	    for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t -= dt;
   288	    while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= 0) {
   289	      var s = G.queue.shift();
   290	      spawnEnemy(s.type, s.path);
   291	    }
   292	    if (!G.queue.length) {
   293	      var alive = 0;
   294	      for (var e = 0; e < G.enemies.length; e++) if (!G.enemies[e].dead) alive++;
   295	      if (alive === 0) {
   296	        G.waveIdx++;
   297	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) { winMap(); }
   298	        else { G.state = 'prep'; G.prepT = G.waves[G.waveIdx].prep; G.energy += 6; EO.float(G.L.w * 0.5, G.L.oy + 30, 'WAVE CLEAR +6', '#8fe0a0'); }
   299	      }
   300	    }
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  /* ---------- enemy update ---------- */
   304	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   305	    var t = G.L.tile;
   306	    for (var i = G.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   307	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   308	      if (e.dead) { G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   309	      if (e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
   310	      if (e.slow > 0) e.slow -= dt;
   311	      if (e.kbcd > 0) e.kbcd -= dt;
   312	      if (e.oil > 0) e.oil -= dt;
   313	      if (e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;
   314	      if (e.root > 0) e.root -= dt;
   315	      if (e.burnT > 0) {
   316	        e.burnT -= dt;
   317	        e.hp -= e.burn * dt;
   318	        if (Math.random() < dt * 8) G.parts.add(e.x + EO.rnd(-5, 5), e.y, 0, -30, 0.3, '#ff9a3c', 3, -20);
   319	        if (e.hp <= 0) { killEnemy(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   320	      }
   321	      if (e.stun > 0) continue;
   322	
   323	      var spdMul = (e.slow > 0 ? 0.55 : 1);
   324	
   325	      if (e.air) {
   326	        var dx = e.gx - e.x, dy = e.gy - e.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
   327	        var sp = e.def.spd * t * spdMul;
   328	        e.ph += dt * 3;
   329	        e.x += (dx / d) * sp * dt + Math.cos(e.ph) * 22 * dt;
   330	        e.y += (dy / d) * sp * dt;
   331	        e.prog = 1 - d / 900;
   332	        if (d < t * 0.5) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   333	        continue;
   334	      }
   335	
   336	      /* ground: current cell + orthogonally adjacent defenders */
   337	      var cA = e.path[e.seg], cB = e.path[Math.min(e.seg + 1, e.path.length - 1)];
   338	      var near = (e.u < 0.5) ? cA : cB;
   339	      e.cc = near.c; e.cr = near.r;
   340	      if (!e.tgt || e.tgt.hp <= 0 || G.defs.indexOf(e.tgt) < 0) {
   341	        e.tgt = null; e.rage = 0;
   342	        var anchorFound = null;
   343	        for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   344	          var dd = EO.defAt(e.cc + EO.DIRS[k][0], e.cr + EO.DIRS[k][1]);
   345	          if (!dd) continue;
   346	          if (dd.def.id === 'anchor') { anchorFound = dd; break; }
   347	          if (!e.tgt) e.tgt = dd;
   348	        }
   349	        if (anchorFound) e.tgt = anchorFound;
   350	      }
   351	
   352	      if (e.tgt && e.def.dmg > 0) {
   353	        e.atkCd -= dt;
   354	        /* rage: a stalled attacker hits harder so no fight can stalemate forever */
   355	        e.rage = (e.rage || 0) + dt;
   356	        if (e.atkCd <= 0) {
   357	          e.atkCd = 1 / e.def.arate;
   358	          hurtDefender(e.tgt, e.def.dmg * (1 + 0.13 * G.mapIdx) * (1 + Math.min(2.5, e.rage * 0.13)));
   359	          shot(e.x, e.y, EO.cellX(e.tgt.c), EO.cellY(e.tgt.r), '#e05f5f', 1);
   360	        }
   361	        continue;
   362	      }
   363	
   364	      if (e.root > 0) continue;
   365	
   366	      /* advance along path */
   367	      var move = e.def.spd * spdMul * dt;
   368	      while (move > 0 && e.seg < e.path.length - 1) {
   369	        var need = 1 - e.u;
   370	        if (move >= need) { move -= need; e.seg++; e.u = 0; }
   371	        else { e.u += move; move = 0; }
   372	      }
   373	      if (e.seg >= e.path.length - 1) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   374	      var a = e.path[e.seg], b = e.path[e.seg + 1];
   375	      e.x = EO.lerp(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellX(b.c), e.u);
   376	      e.y = EO.lerp(EO.cellY(a.r), EO.cellY(b.r), e.u);
   377	      e.prog = (e.seg + e.u) / e.path.length;
   378	    }
   379	    if (G.enemies.length > 90) G.enemies.splice(0, G.enemies.length - 90);
   380	  }

   137	  EO.float = function (x, y, txt, col) {
   138	    if (G.floats.length >= 30) G.floats.shift();
   139	    G.floats.push({ x: x, y: y, t: 0.85, mt: 0.85, s: txt, c: col || '#e8e2d4' });
   140	  };
   141	  function shot(x, y, tx, ty, col, type) {
   142	    if (G.shots.length >= 90) G.shots.shift();
   143	    G.shots.push({ x: x, y: y, tx: tx, ty: ty, t: 0.16, mt: 0.16, c: col, k: type || 0 });
   144	  }
   145	
   146	  /* ---------- footprint helpers ---------- */
   147	  EO.fpCells = function (dd) {
   148	    var out = [], fp = dd.def.fp;
   149	    for (var i = 0; i < fp.length; i++) {
   150	      var o = EO.rotFp(fp[i][0], fp[i][1], dd.dir);
   151	      var c = dd.c + o[0], r = dd.r + o[1];
   152	      if (c >= 0 && r >= 0 && c < EO.COLS && r < EO.ROWS) out.push([c, r]);
   153	    }
   154	    return out;
   155	  };
   156	  EO.fpPreview = function (id, c, r, dir) {
   157	    var d = EO.DEF_BY_ID[id]; if (!d) return [];
   158	    var out = [];
   159	    for (var i = 0; i < d.fp.length; i++) {
   160	      var o = EO.rotFp(d.fp[i][0], d.fp[i][1], dir);
   161	      var cc = c + o[0], rr = r + o[1];
   162	      if (cc >= 0 && rr >= 0 && cc < EO.COLS && rr < EO.ROWS) out.push([cc, rr]);
   163	    }
   164	    return out;
   165	  };
   166	
   167	  function inFp(dd, e) {
   168	    var cells = EO.fpCells(dd), i;
   169	    if (!e.air) {
   170	      for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) if (cells[i][0] === e.cc && cells[i][1] === e.cr) return true;
   171	      return false;
   172	    }
   173	    var t = G.L.tile;
   174	    for (i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
   175	      var cx = EO.cellX(cells[i][0]), cy = EO.cellY(cells[i][1]);
   176	      if (Math.abs(e.x - cx) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5 && Math.abs(e.y - cy) <= t * 0.5 + e.def.r * 0.5) return true;
   177	    }
   178	    return false;
   179	  }
   180	  function targetsOf(dd) {
   181	    var tgt = dd.def.tgt, out = [];
   182	    if (tgt === 'n') return out;
   183	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   184	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   185	      if (e.dead) continue;
   186	      if (tgt === 'g' && e.air) continue;
   187	      if (tgt === 'a' && !e.air) continue;
   188	      if (inFp(dd, e)) out.push(e);
   189	    }
   190	    /* front-most (furthest along) first */
   191	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.prog - a.prog; });
   192	    return out;
   193	  }
   194	
   195	  /* ---------- damage ---------- */
   196	  function hurtEnemy(e, amount, col, crit) {
   197	    if (e.dead) return;
   198	    var arm = e.def.armor * (e.oil > 0 ? 0.5 : 1);
   199	    var dmg = Math.max(1, amount - arm);
   200	    e.hp -= dmg;
   201	    e.flash = 0.12;
   202	    if (Math.random() < 0.45) G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, crit ? 8 : 3, col || '#ffd08a', 70, 2);
   203	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e);
   204	    else EO.sfx.hit();
   205	  }
   206	  function killEnemy(e) {
   207	    if (e.dead) return;
   208	    e.dead = true;
   209	    G.kills++;
   210	    var gain = (1.4 + e.maxhp / 34) * G.mods.kill;
   211	    G.energy += gain;
   212	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 10, e.def.col, 120, 3);
   213	    EO.float(e.x, e.y - 8, '+' + Math.round(gain), '#8fe0a0');
   214	    EO.sfx.die();
   215	  }
   216	  function auraMul(dd) {
   217	    var mul = 1;
   218	    if (dd.brace > 0) mul *= 0.4;
   219	    if (dd.shieldT > 0) mul *= 0.55;
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   221	      var w = G.defs[i];
   222	      if (w === dd || w.def.id !== 'warden' || w.hp <= 0) continue;
   223	      if (Math.abs(w.c - dd.c) <= 1 && Math.abs(w.r - dd.r) <= 1) { mul *= 0.8; break; }
   224	    }
   225	    return mul;
   226	  }
   227	  function hurtDefender(dd, amount) {
   228	    dd.hp -= amount * auraMul(dd);
   229	    dd.flash = 0.14;
   230	    if (dd.hp <= 0) {
   231	      var i = G.defs.indexOf(dd);
   232	      if (i >= 0) G.defs.splice(i, 1);
   233	      if (G.sel === dd) G.sel = null;
   234	      G.parts.burst(EO.cellX(dd.c), EO.cellY(dd.r), 14, dd.def.col, 130, 4);
   235	      G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6);
   236	      EO.sfx.boom();
   237	    }
   238	  }
   239	
   240	  /* ---------- spawning ---------- */
   241	  function spawnEnemy(type, pathIdx) {
   242	    if (G.enemies.length >= 90) return;
   243	    var base = EO.ENEMIES[type];
   244	    if (!base) return;
   245	    var s = EO.mapScale(G.mapIdx);
   246	    var hp = Math.round(base.hp * s);
   247	    var e = {
   248	      def: base, air: base.air, hp: hp, maxhp: hp, dead: false,
   249	      slow: 0, stun: 0, root: 0, burn: 0, burnT: 0, oil: 0,
   250	      atkCd: 0, tgt: null, flash: 0, prog: 0, kbcd: 0, rage: 0, cc: 0, cr: 0, x: 0, y: 0
   251	    };
   252	    if (base.air) {
   253	      e.x = G.L.ox + EO.rnd(G.L.tile * 0.6, G.L.tile * (EO.COLS - 0.6));
   254	      e.y = G.L.oy - 26 - EO.rnd(0, 40);
   255	      e.gx = EO.cellX(G.gate.c); e.gy = EO.cellY(G.gate.r);
   256	      e.ph = Math.random() * 6.28;
   257	    } else {
   258	      var pi = EO.clamp(pathIdx | 0, 0, G.paths.length - 1);
   259	      e.path = G.paths[pi]; e.seg = 0; e.u = 0;
   260	      e.x = EO.cellX(e.path[0].c); e.y = EO.cellY(e.path[0].r);
   261	    }
   262	    G.enemies.push(e);
   263	  }
   264	
   265	  function updateSpawner(dt) {
   266	    if (G.state !== 'prep' && G.state !== 'wave') return;
   267	    if (G.state === 'prep') {
   268	      G.prepT -= dt;
   269	      if (G.prepT <= 0) {
   270	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) return;
   271	        var w = G.waves[G.waveIdx];
   272	        G.queue.length = 0;
   273	        for (var i = 0; i < w.groups.length; i++) {
   274	          var g = w.groups[i];
   275	          for (var n = 0; n < g.count; n++) {
   276	            G.queue.push({ t: g.delay + n * g.gap, type: g.type, path: g.path });
   277	          }
   278	        }
   279	        G.queue.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
   280	        if (G.queue.length > 200) G.queue.length = 200;
   281	        G.state = 'wave'; G.waveActive = true;
   282	        EO.audio.tone(300, 0.1, 'square', 0.16, 420);
   283	      }
   284	      return;
   285	    }
   286	    /* wave */
   287	    for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t -= dt;
   288	    while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= 0) {
   289	      var s = G.queue.shift();
   290	      spawnEnemy(s.type, s.path);
   291	    }
   292	    if (!G.queue.length) {
   293	      var alive = 0;
   294	      for (var e = 0; e < G.enemies.length; e++) if (!G.enemies[e].dead) alive++;
   295	      if (alive === 0) {
   296	        G.waveIdx++;
   297	        if (G.waveIdx >= G.waves.length) { winMap(); }
   298	        else { G.state = 'prep'; G.prepT = G.waves[G.waveIdx].prep; G.energy += 6; EO.float(G.L.w * 0.5, G.L.oy + 30, 'WAVE CLEAR +6', '#8fe0a0'); }
   299	      }
   300	    }
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  /* ---------- enemy update ---------- */
   304	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   305	    var t = G.L.tile;
   306	    for (var i = G.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   307	      var e = G.enemies[i];
   308	      if (e.dead) { G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   309	      if (e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
   310	      if (e.slow > 0) e.slow -= dt;
   311	      if (e.kbcd > 0) e.kbcd -= dt;
   312	      if (e.oil > 0) e.oil -= dt;
   313	      if (e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;
   314	      if (e.root > 0) e.root -= dt;
   315	      if (e.burnT > 0) {
   316	        e.burnT -= dt;
   317	        e.hp -= e.burn * dt;
   318	        if (Math.random() < dt * 8) G.parts.add(e.x + EO.rnd(-5, 5), e.y, 0, -30, 0.3, '#ff9a3c', 3, -20);
   319	        if (e.hp <= 0) { killEnemy(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   320	      }
   321	      if (e.stun > 0) continue;
   322	
   323	      var spdMul = (e.slow > 0 ? 0.55 : 1);
   324	
   325	      if (e.air) {
   326	        var dx = e.gx - e.x, dy = e.gy - e.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
   327	        var sp = e.def.spd * t * spdMul;
   328	        e.ph += dt * 3;
   329	        e.x += (dx / d) * sp * dt + Math.cos(e.ph) * 22 * dt;
   330	        e.y += (dy / d) * sp * dt;
   331	        e.prog = 1 - d / 900;
   332	        if (d < t * 0.5) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   333	        continue;
   334	      }
   335	
   336	      /* ground: current cell + orthogonally adjacent defenders */
   337	      var cA = e.path[e.seg], cB = e.path[Math.min(e.seg + 1, e.path.length - 1)];
   338	      var near = (e.u < 0.5) ? cA : cB;
   339	      e.cc = near.c; e.cr = near.r;
   340	      if (!e.tgt || e.tgt.hp <= 0 || G.defs.indexOf(e.tgt) < 0) {
   341	        e.tgt = null; e.rage = 0;
   342	        var anchorFound = null;
   343	        for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   344	          var dd = EO.defAt(e.cc + EO.DIRS[k][0], e.cr + EO.DIRS[k][1]);
   345	          if (!dd) continue;
   346	          if (dd.def.id === 'anchor') { anchorFound = dd; break; }
   347	          if (!e.tgt) e.tgt = dd;
   348	        }
   349	        if (anchorFound) e.tgt = anchorFound;
   350	      }
   351	
   352	      if (e.tgt && e.def.dmg > 0) {
   353	        e.atkCd -= dt;
   354	        /* rage: a stalled attacker hits harder so no fight can stalemate forever */
   355	        e.rage = (e.rage || 0) + dt;
   356	        if (e.atkCd <= 0) {
   357	          e.atkCd = 1 / e.def.arate;
   358	          hurtDefender(e.tgt, e.def.dmg * (1 + 0.13 * G.mapIdx) * (1 + Math.min(2.5, e.rage * 0.13)));
   359	          shot(e.x, e.y, EO.cellX(e.tgt.c), EO.cellY(e.tgt.r), '#e05f5f', 1);
   360	        }
   361	        continue;
   362	      }
   363	
   364	      if (e.root > 0) continue;
   365	
   366	      /* advance along path */
   367	      var move = e.def.spd * spdMul * dt;
   368	      while (move > 0 && e.seg < e.path.length - 1) {
   369	        var need = 1 - e.u;
   370	        if (move >= need) { move -= need; e.seg++; e.u = 0; }
   371	        else { e.u += move; move = 0; }
   372	      }
   373	      if (e.seg >= e.path.length - 1) { leak(e); G.enemies.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   374	      var a = e.path[e.seg], b = e.path[e.seg + 1];
   375	      e.x = EO.lerp(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellX(b.c), e.u);
   376	      e.y = EO.lerp(EO.cellY(a.r), EO.cellY(b.r), e.u);
   377	      e.prog = (e.seg + e.u) / e.path.length;
   378	    }
   379	    if (G.enemies.length > 90) G.enemies.splice(0, G.enemies.length - 90);
   380	  }
   381	
   382	  function leak(e) {
   383	    G.leaks += e.def.leak;
   384	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 9);
   385	    G.flashT = 0.25;
   386	    G.parts.burst(e.x, e.y, 14, '#e05f5f', 150, 4);
   387	    EO.float(e.x, G.L.oy + G.L.tile * EO.ROWS - 14, '-' + e.def.leak, '#e05f5f');
   388	    EO.sfx.leak();
   389	    if (G.leaks >= G.leakCap) loseMap();
   390	  }
   391	
   392	  /* ---------- defender update ---------- */
   393	  function updateDefs(dt) {
   394	    for (var i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   395	      var dd = G.defs[i], d = dd.def;
   396	      if (dd.flash > 0) dd.flash -= dt;
   397	      if (dd.born > 0) dd.born -= dt;
   398	      if (dd.brace > 0) dd.brace -= dt;
   399	      if (dd.shieldT > 0) dd.shieldT -= dt;
   400	      if (dd.skcd > 0) dd.skcd -= dt;
   401	      dd.pulse += dt;
   402	      if (d.id === 'scout') G.energy += 0.45 * dt;
   403	
   404	      dd.cd -= dt;
   405	      if (dd.burst > 0) {
   406	        dd.burstT -= dt;
   407	        if (dd.burstT <= 0) { dd.burst--; dd.burstT = 0.16; fire(dd, 1.0); }
   408	      }
   409	      if (dd.cd > 0) continue;
   410	
   411	      if (d.kind === 'heal') {
   412	        var healed = false;
   413	        var cells = EO.fpCells(dd);
   414	        for (var c = 0; c < cells.length; c++) {
   415	          var t2 = EO.defAt(cells[c][0], cells[c][1]);
   416	          if (t2 && t2.hp < t2.maxhp) {
   417	            t2.hp = Math.min(t2.maxhp, t2.hp + 14);
   418	            G.parts.add(EO.cellX(t2.c), EO.cellY(t2.r) - 6, EO.rnd(-14, 14), -34, 0.5, '#8fe0a0', 3, -8);
   419	            healed = true;
   420	          }
   421	        }
   422	        dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   423	        if (healed) EO.audio.tone(760, 0.05, 'sine', 0.05);
   424	        continue;
   425	      }
   426	      var tg = targetsOf(dd);
   427	      if (!tg.length) { dd.cd = 0.08; continue; }
   428	      dd.cd = 1 / d.rate;
   429	      fire(dd, 1.0, tg);
   430	    }
   431	  }
   432	
   433	  function fire(dd, mul, tg) {
   434	    var d = dd.def;
   435	    tg = tg || targetsOf(dd);
   436	    if (!tg.length) return;
   437	    var sx = EO.cellX(dd.c), sy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   438	    var dmg = d.dmg * mul;
   439	    if (d.kind === 'melee' || d.kind === 'single') {
   440	      var e = tg[0];
   441	      hurtEnemy(e, dmg, d.col, mul > 1.5);
   442	      shot(sx, sy, e.x, e.y, d.col, d.kind === 'single' ? 2 : 0);
   443	    } else if (d.kind === 'pierce') {
   444	      for (var i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], dmg, d.col); }
   445	      var lastp = tg[tg.length - 1];
   446	      shot(sx, sy, lastp.x, lastp.y, d.col, 2);
   447	    } else if (d.kind === 'chain') {
   448	      for (var j = 0; j < Math.min(3, tg.length); j++) {
   449	        hurtEnemy(tg[j], dmg, d.col);
   450	        shot(j === 0 ? sx : tg[j - 1].x, j === 0 ? sy : tg[j - 1].y, tg[j].x, tg[j].y, d.col, 3);
   451	      }
   452	    } else if (d.kind === 'splash') {
   453	      var c0 = tg[0];
   454	      var rad = G.L.tile * 0.85;
   455	      for (var k = 0; k < tg.length; k++) {
   456	        if (EO.dist2(tg[k].x, tg[k].y, c0.x, c0.y) <= rad * rad) hurtEnemy(tg[k], dmg, d.col);
   457	      }
   458	      G.parts.burst(c0.x, c0.y, 8, '#ffb454', 110, 3);
   459	      shot(sx, sy, c0.x, c0.y, d.col, 4);
   460	      EO.audio.tone(180, 0.08, 'sine', 0.09, 90);
   461	      return;
   462	    } else if (d.kind === 'slow') {
   463	      for (var m = 0; m < tg.length; m++) {
   464	        hurtEnemy(tg[m], dmg, d.col);
   465	        tg[m].slow = 1.2; tg[m].oil = 4.0;
   466	      }
   467	      return;
   468	    } else if (d.kind === 'shove') {
   469	      for (var n = 0; n < tg.length; n++) {
   470	        var e2 = tg[n];
   471	        hurtEnemy(e2, dmg, d.col);
   472	        /* knockback is rate-limited so nothing can be shoved in place forever */
   473	        if (!e2.air && (e2.kbcd || 0) <= 0) {
   474	          e2.kbcd = 1.1;
   475	          var back = 0.5;
   476	          while (back > 0) {
   477	            if (e2.u >= back) { e2.u -= back; back = 0; }
   478	            else if (e2.seg > 0) { back -= e2.u; e2.seg--; e2.u = 1; }
   479	            else { e2.u = 0; back = 0; }
   480	          }
   481	        }
   482	      }
   483	      shot(sx, sy, tg[0].x, tg[0].y, d.col, 0);
   484	    }
   485	    EO.sfx.shot();
   486	  }
   487	
   488	  /* ---------- skills ---------- */
   489	  EO.useSkill = function (dd) {
   490	    if (!dd || dd.skcd > 0) { EO.sfx.deny(); return false; }
   491	    var d = dd.def;
   492	    dd.skcd = d.skill.cd * G.mods.cd;
   493	    var tg = targetsOf(dd), i;
   494	    var cx = EO.cellX(dd.c), cy = EO.cellY(dd.r);
   495	    G.parts.burst(cx, cy, 14, d.col, 150, 4);
   496	    EO.sfx.skill();
   497	    EO.float(cx, cy - 18, d.skill.name, d.col);
   498	    switch (d.id) {
   499	      case 'blocker':
   500	        dd.hp = Math.min(dd.maxhp, dd.hp + dd.maxhp * 0.4); dd.brace = 4; break;
   501	      case 'pike':
   502	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 3, d.col, true);
   503	        break;
   504	      case 'arcer':
   505	        dd.burst = 4; dd.burstT = 0.05; break;
   506	      case 'sparker':
   507	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) { hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 1.5, d.col, true); tg[i].stun = 1.6; }
   508	        break;
   509	      case 'medic':
   510	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) {
   511	          var a = G.defs[i];
   512	          a.hp = Math.min(a.maxhp, a.hp + a.maxhp * 0.35);
   513	          G.parts.add(EO.cellX(a.c), EO.cellY(a.r), EO.rnd(-20, 20), -50, 0.6, '#8fe0a0', 3, -10);
   514	        }
   515	        break;
   516	      case 'sniper':
   517	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) hurtEnemy(tg[i], d.dmg * 4, d.col, true);
   518	        if (tg.length) shot(cx, cy, tg[tg.length - 1].x, tg[tg.length - 1].y, '#ffffff', 2);
   519	        break;
   520	      case 'oiler':
   521	        for (i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   522	          var e = G.enemies[i];
   523	          if (e.oil > 0 && !e.dead) { e.burn = 14; e.burnT = 3; }
   524	        }
   525	        break;
   526	      case 'warden':
   527	        for (i = 0; i < G.defs.length; i++) G.defs[i].shieldT = 5;
   528	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) {
   529	          var e3 = tg[i];
   530	          hurtEnemy(e3, d.dmg * 2, d.col);
   531	          if (!e3.air) { var bk = 1.2; while (bk > 0) { if (e3.u >= bk) { e3.u -= bk; bk = 0; } else if (e3.seg > 0) { bk -= e3.u; e3.seg--; e3.u = 1; } else { e3.u = 0; bk = 0; } } }
   532	        }
   533	        break;
   534	      case 'scout':
   535	        G.energy += 16; EO.float(cx, cy - 30, '+16', '#8fe0a0'); break;
   536	      case 'anchor':
   537	        for (i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) if (!tg[i].air) tg[i].root = 2.6;
   538	        break;
   539	    }
   540	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
   541	    return true;
   542	  };
   543	
   544	  /* ---------- end states ---------- */
   545	  function winMap() {
   546	    G.state = 'won';
   547	    var timeBonus = Math.max(0, Math.round(1200 - G.time * 4));
   548	    G.score = G.kills * 12 + (G.leakCap - G.leaks) * 140 + timeBonus;
   549	    var first = (G.save.cleared === G.mapIdx);
   550	    var mats = EO.matsFor(G.mapIdx, first);
   551	    G.save.mats.scrap = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.scrap + mats.scrap);
   552	    G.save.mats.ember = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.ember + mats.ember);
   553	    G.save.mats.alloy = Math.min(99999, G.save.mats.alloy + mats.alloy);
   554	    var newDefs = [];
   555	    if (first) {
   556	      G.save.cleared = G.mapIdx + 1;
   557	      var ul = EO.UNLOCKS[G.mapIdx] || [];
   558	      for (var i = 0; i < ul.length; i++) {
   559	        if (G.save.unlocked.indexOf(ul[i]) < 0) { G.save.unlocked.push(ul[i]); newDefs.push(ul[i]); }
   560	      }
   561	    }
   562	    var key = 'm' + G.mapIdx;
   563	    var rec = false;
   564	    if (!G.save.best[key] || G.score > G.save.best[key]) { G.save.best[key] = G.score; rec = true; }
   565	    EO.writeSave(G.save);
   566	    G.resultInfo = { win: true, mats: mats, newDefs: newDefs, record: rec, final: (G.mapIdx === EO.MAPS.length - 1) };
   567	    G.shake = 8;
   568	    EO.sfx.win();
   569	    EO.after(700, function () { if (G.state === 'won') G.screen = 'result'; });
   570	  }
   571	  function loseMap() {
   572	    if (G.state === 'lost') return;
   573	    G.state = 'lost';
   574	    G.score = G.kills * 12;
   575	    G.resultInfo = { win: false, mats: null, newDefs: [], record: false, final: false };
   576	    G.shake = 14;
   577	    EO.sfx.lose();
   578	    EO.after(800, function () { if (G.state === 'lost') G.screen = 'result'; });
   579	  }
   580	  EO.winMap = winMap;
   581	
   582	  /* ---------- main update ---------- */
   583	  EO.update = function (dt) {
   584	    if (G.screen !== 'play') { if (G.parts) G.parts.update(dt); return; }
   585	    if (G.paused) return;
   586	    var sdt = dt * G.speed;
   587	    if (G.state === 'prep' || G.state === 'wave') {
   588	      G.time += sdt;
   589	      G.energy += G.regen * sdt;
   590	      if (G.energy > 999) G.energy = 999;
   591	      updateSpawner(sdt);
   592	      updateEnemies(sdt);
   593	      updateDefs(sdt);
   594	    } else {
   595	      updateEnemies(sdt * 0.35);
   596	    }
   597	    /* shots */
   598	    for (var i = G.shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   599	      G.shots[i].t -= dt;
   600	      if (G.shots[i].t <= 0) G.shots.splice(i, 1);
   601	    }
   602	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   603	      var fl = G.floats[f];
   604	      fl.t -= dt; fl.y -= 26 * dt;
   605	      if (fl.t <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   606	    }
   607	    G.parts.update(dt);
   608	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   609	    if (G.flashT > 0) G.flashT -= dt;
   610	  };
   611	
   612	})(window.EO);
--- data continuation helpers ---
   176	  /* ---------- wave generation (deterministic per map) ---------- */
   177	  EO.buildWaves = function (mi) {
   178	    var m = EO.MAPS[mi], rng = EO.seeded(9137 + mi * 7717), out = [], w, np = m.paths.length;
   179	    /* [type, first map it can appear, first wave it can appear] */
   180	    var roster = [
   181	      ['runner', 0, 0], ['grunt', 0, 0], ['swarm', 1, 1], ['flyer', 2, 2],
   182	      ['shell', 3, 3], ['brute', 2, 4], ['bomber', 4, 5]
   183	    ];
   184	    for (w = 0; w < m.waves; w++) {
   185	      var pool = [];
   186	      for (var q = 0; q < roster.length; q++) if (mi >= roster[q][1] && w >= roster[q][2]) pool.push(roster[q][0]);
   187	      var groups = [], gcount = 1 + Math.floor(w / 3) + (rng() < 0.4 ? 1 : 0);
   188	      if (gcount > 3) gcount = 3;
   189	      var budget = (24 + w * 16) * (1 + 0.11 * mi) * (np > 1 ? 0.84 : 1), airUsed = 0;
   190	      for (var g = 0; g < gcount; g++) {
   191	        var t = pool[Math.floor(rng() * pool.length)];
   192	        /* at most one airborne group per wave */
   193	        if (EO.ENEMIES[t].air) { if (airUsed) t = (rng() < 0.5) ? 'runner' : 'grunt'; else airUsed = 1; }
   194	        if (w === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'runner' : 'grunt';
   195	        if (w === 1 && mi === 0) t = (g === 0) ? 'grunt' : 'runner';
   196	        var e = EO.ENEMIES[t];
   197	        var share = budget / gcount;
   198	        var n = Math.max(2, Math.round(share / (e.hp * 0.36)));
   199	        if (n > 14) n = 14;
   200	        groups.push({
   201	          type: t, count: n,
   202	          gap: e.air ? 0.55 : (0.75 - Math.min(0.3, w * 0.03)),
   203	          delay: g * (1.6 + rng() * 1.4),
   204	          path: Math.floor(rng() * np)
   205	        });
   206	      }
   207	      /* every third wave from map 3 onward gets an air flight */
   208	      if (mi >= 2 && (w % 3 === 2)) {
   209	        groups.push({ type: (mi >= 4 && w > 4) ? 'bomber' : 'flyer', count: Math.min(6, 3 + Math.floor(w / 4)), gap: 0.5, delay: 3.4, path: 0 });
   210	      }
   211	      out.push({ groups: groups, prep: (w === 0) ? 6.0 : 3.6 });
   212	      if (out.length >= 14) break;
   213	    }
   214	    return out;
   215	  };
   216	
   217	  /* enemy stat scale per map */
   218	  EO.mapScale = function (mi) { return 1 + 0.11 * mi; };
   219	
   220	  EO.matsFor = function (mi, first) {
   221	    var f = first ? 1 : 0.4;
   222	    return {
   223	      scrap: Math.round((22 + mi * 9) * f),
   224	      ember: mi >= 1 ? Math.round((4 + mi * 2.4) * f) : 0,
   225	      alloy: mi >= 3 ? Math.round((3 + (mi - 3) * 2.2) * f) : 0
   226	    };
   227	  };
   228	
   229	})(window.EO);

   154	    let a = seed >>> 0;
   155	    return function random() {
   156	      a |= 0;
   157	      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;

   174	  function safeLoad() {

   279	  function chirp(frequency, duration = 0.08, type = "sine", volume = 0.035) {
   280	    if (!audioContext) return;
   281	    try {
   282	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   283	      const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   284	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   285	      oscillator.type = type;
   286	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   287	      oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(60, frequency * 1.25), now + duration);
   288	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, now);
   289	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
   290	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   291	      gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
   292	      oscillator.start(now);
   293	      oscillator.stop(now + duration + 0.02);
   294	    } catch (error) {
   295	      // Audio is decorative; the game must stay playable without it.
   296	    }
   297	  }

   299	  function conditions() {
   300	    const now = Date.now();
   301	    if (conditionCache.value && now - conditionCache.stamp < 800) return conditionCache.value;
   302	    const date = new Date(now);
   303	    const hour = date.getHours();
   304	    let phase = "NIGHT";
   305	    if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) phase = "MORNING";
   306	    else if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) phase = "AFTERNOON";
   307	    else if (hour >= 18) phase = "EVENING";
   308	    const weatherIndex = Math.floor(now / 45000) % WEATHER.length;
   309	    const value = {
   310	      phase,
   311	      dateKey: `${date.getFullYear()}-${date.getMonth() + 1}-${date.getDate()}`,
   312	      weather: WEATHER[weatherIndex]
   313	    };
   314	    conditionCache = { stamp: now, value };
   315	    return value;
   316	  }

   349	  function neighbors(nodeId) {
   350	    const list = [];
   351	    for (const edge of district.edges) {
   352	      if (edge[0] === nodeId) list.push(edge[1]);
   353	      else if (edge[1] === nodeId) list.push(edge[0]);
   354	    }
   355	    return list;
   356	  }
   357	
   358	  function nextStepToward(startId, goalId) {
   359	    if (startId === goalId) return startId;
   360	    const queue = [startId];
   361	    const previous = Object.create(null);
   362	    previous[startId] = -1;
   363	    while (queue.length) {
   364	      const current = queue.shift();
   365	      for (const next of neighbors(current)) {
   366	        if (previous[next] !== undefined) continue;
   367	        previous[next] = current;
   368	        if (next === goalId) {
   369	          let step = next;
   370	          while (previous[step] !== startId && previous[step] !== -1) step = previous[step];
   371	          return step;
   372	        }
   373	        queue.push(next);
   374	      }
   375	    }
   376	    return startId;
   377	  }

   379	  function distanceToSegment(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) {
   380	    const dx = bx - ax;
   381	    const dy = by - ay;
   382	    const length = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1;
   383	    const t = clamp(((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / length, 0, 1);
   384	    const x = ax + dx * t;
   385	    const y = ay + dy * t;
   386	    return { distance: Math.hypot(px - x, py - y), t };
   387	  }
   388	
   389	  function destinationAt(x, y) {
   390	    const current = district.nodes[currentNode];
   391	    let nearestNode = null;
   392	    let nearestDistance = 9999;
   393	    for (const node of district.nodes) {
   394	      if (node.id === currentNode || !neighbors(currentNode).includes(node.id)) continue;
   395	      const distance = Math.hypot(x - node.x, y - node.y);
   396	      if (distance < nearestDistance) {
   397	        nearestDistance = distance;
   398	        nearestNode = node.id;
   399	      }
   400	    }
   401	    if (nearestNode !== null && nearestDistance < 44) return nearestNode;
   402	
   403	    let nearestPath = null;
   404	    let nearestPathDistance = 9999;
   405	    for (const edge of district.edges) {
   406	      const a = district.nodes[edge[0]];
   407	      const b = district.nodes[edge[1]];
   408	      const hit = distanceToSegment(x, y, a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
   409	      if (hit.distance < nearestPathDistance) {
   410	        nearestPathDistance = hit.distance;
   411	        nearestPath = edge;
   412	      }
   413	    }
   414	    if (!nearestPath || nearestPathDistance > 32) return null;
   415	    if (nearestPath.includes(currentNode)) return nearestPath[0] === currentNode ? nearestPath[1] : nearestPath[0];
   416	    const d0 = Math.hypot(x - district.nodes[nearestPath[0]].x, y - district.nodes[nearestPath[0]].y);
   417	    const goal = d0 < Math.hypot(x - district.nodes[nearestPath[1]].x, y - district.nodes[nearestPath[1]].y) ? nearestPath[0] : nearestPath[1];
   418	    return nextStepToward(currentNode, goal) === currentNode ? null : nextStepToward(currentNode, goal);
   419	  }

   421	  function chooseSpecies(habitat, weatherKey) {
   422	    const matching = SPECIES.filter((species) => species.habitat === habitat && species.weather === weatherKey);
   423	    const fallback = SPECIES.filter((species) => species.habitat === habitat);
   424	    const pool = matching.length ? matching : fallback;
   425	    const unseen = pool.filter((species) => !records[species.id]);
   426	    const candidates = unseen.length ? unseen : pool;
   427	    let total = candidates.reduce((sum, species) => sum + species.weight, 0);
   428	    let pick = rng() * total;
   429	    for (const species of candidates) {
   430	      pick -= species.weight;
   431	      if (pick <= 0) return species;
   432	    }
   433	    return candidates[candidates.length - 1];
   434	  }

   436	  function rollEncounter(nodeId, guaranteed = false) {
   437	    const node = district.nodes[nodeId];
   438	    if (!guaranteed && rng() > 0.86) {
   439	      encounter = null;
   440	      showToast("Only leaves. Keep exploring.", 1300);
   441	      return;
   442	    }
   443	    const weather = conditions().weather.key;
   444	    const species = chooseSpecies(node.habitat, weather);
   445	    encounter = { speciesId: species.id, age: 0, sparkle: rng() * Math.PI * 2 };
   446	    pulse = 1;
   447	    chirp(390 + rng() * 180, 0.1, "triangle", 0.025);
   448	  }

   450	  function moveTo(nodeId) {
   451	    if (!district.nodes[nodeId] || nodeId === currentNode) return;
   452	    const isPractice = practiceMode || steps <= 0;
   453	    if (!isPractice && steps > 0) steps -= 1;
   454	    if (steps <= 0) practiceMode = true;
   455	    currentNode = nodeId;
   456	    district.nodes[currentNode].visited = true;
   457	    visited.add(currentNode);
   458	    if (visited.size > district.nodes.length) visited.delete(visited.values().next().value);
   459	    walkCount += 1;
   460	    score += isPractice ? 2 : 10;
   461	    shake = Math.max(shake, 2.5);
   462	    burst(district.nodes[nodeId].x, district.nodes[nodeId].y, HABITATS[district.nodes[nodeId].habitat].color, 7);
   463	    rollEncounter(nodeId);
   464	    updateStatus(`Arrived at ${district.nodes[nodeId].label}. ${encounter ? "A field encounter is nearby." : "No creature this time."}`);
   465	  }

   467	  function moveByDirection(dx, dy) {
   468	    if (state !== "map" || !district) return;
   469	    const current = district.nodes[currentNode];
   470	    const choices = neighbors(currentNode).map((id) => district.nodes[id]);
   471	    let bestNode = null;
   472	    let bestDot = -Infinity;
   473	    for (const node of choices) {
   474	      const vx = node.x - current.x;
   475	      const vy = node.y - current.y;
   476	      const length = Math.hypot(vx, vy) || 1;
   477	      const dot = (vx / length) * dx + (vy / length) * dy;
   478	      if (dot > bestDot) { bestDot = dot; bestNode = node.id; }
   479	    }
   480	    if (bestNode !== null && bestDot > 0.05) moveTo(bestNode);
   481	  }

   513	  function releaseCapturePointer(pointerId, x, y) {
   514	    if (pointerId !== input.capturePointerId || !captureDrag) return;
   515	    const drag = captureDrag;
   516	    const now = performance.now();
   517	    const dx = x - drag.startX;
   518	    const dy = y - drag.startY;
   519	    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   520	    const elapsed = Math.max(0.07, (now - drag.startedAt) / 1000);
   521	    const speed = distance / elapsed;
   522	    const leadX = captureTarget.x + captureTarget.vx * 0.18;
   523	    const leadY = captureTarget.y + captureTarget.vy * 0.18;
   524	    const aimDistance = Math.hypot(x - leadX, y - leadY);
   525	    const ringPhase = (captureTime * 1.25) % 1;
   526	    const timing = Math.abs(ringPhase - 0.78) < 0.18 || ringPhase < 0.08;
   527	    const goodDirection = dy < -52;
   528	    const success = distance > 95 && speed > 180 && goodDirection && aimDistance < 78 && timing;
   529	    capturePointer = null;
   530	    captureDrag = null;
   531	    input.capturePointerId = null;
   532	    input.captureStart = null;
   533	    if (success) captureSuccess();
   534	    else captureMiss();
   535	  }

   537	  function captureSuccess() {
   538	    const species = speciesById.get(encounter && encounter.speciesId);
   539	    if (!species) { state = "map"; return; }
   540	    const size = Math.round((species.base + rng() * species.variance) * 10) / 10;
   541	    const previous = records[species.id];
   542	    records[species.id] = { seen: true, bestSize: Math.max(previous ? previous.bestSize : 0, size) };
   543	    best = Math.max(best, SPECIES.filter((item) => records[item.id]).length);
   544	    score += 100 + Math.round(size);
   545	    safeSave();
   546	    result = { species, size, newRecord: !previous || size >= previous.bestSize };
   547	    encounter = null;
   548	    flash = 0.9;
   549	    shake = 7;
   550	    burst(captureTarget.x, captureTarget.y, species.color, 26);
   551	    chirp(650, 0.12, "triangle", 0.04);
   552	    schedule(() => chirp(900, 0.18, "sine", 0.025), 90);
   553	    state = best >= SPECIES.length ? "medal" : "result";
   554	    updateStatus(best >= SPECIES.length ? "Naturalist medal earned. Every creature is in the field notes." : `${species.name} recorded at ${size.toFixed(1)} cm.`);
   555	  }

   557	  function captureMiss() {
   558	    throwsLeft -= 1;
   559	    shake = 4;

   566	      updateStatus("The encounter escaped without a failed run. Keep exploring.");
   567	    } else {
   568	      showToast(`${throwsLeft} field flick${throwsLeft === 1 ? "" : "s"} left. Lead the mark.`, 1200);
   569	    }
   570	  }

   578	      particles.push({
   579	        x, y,

   581	        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18,

   583	        maxLife: 0.5 + rng() * 0.55,
   584	        size: 2 + rng() * 4,
   585	        color
   586	      });
   587	    }
   588	  }

   649	  function pointerPosition(event) {
   650	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   651	    return {
   652	      x: clamp((event.clientX - rect.left) * W / Math.max(1, rect.width), 0, W),
   653	      y: clamp((event.clientY - rect.top) * H / Math.max(1, rect.height), 0, H)
   654	    };
   655	  }

   657	  function hit(rect, x, y) {
   658	    return x >= rect.x && x <= rect.x + rect.w && y >= rect.y && y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   659	  }

   661	  function assignPointer(pointerId, owner, point) {
   662	    if (activePointers.size >= MAX_ACTIVE_POINTERS) return false;
   663	    activePointers.set(pointerId, { owner, x: point.x, y: point.y });
   664	    return true;
   665	  }

   667	  function pointerDown(event) {

   670	    unlockAudio();

   693	      }
   694	      if (hit(ui.dexList, point.x, point.y)) {
   695	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "dex";
   696	        input.dexPointerId = event.pointerId;

   698	      }

   700	      return;

   701	    }

   705	      if (hit(continueRect, point.x, point.y)) {
   706	        activePointers.get(event.pointerId).owner = "back";
   707	        input.backPointerId = event.pointerId;

   720	      input.encounterPointerId = event.pointerId;

   724	      input.mapStart = point;

   727	    }
   728	  }

   730	  function pointerMove(event) {
   731	    event.preventDefault();
   732	    const tracked = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   733	    if (!tracked || pausedByOrientation) return;
   734	    const point = pointerPosition(event);
   735	    tracked.x = point.x;
   736	    tracked.y = point.y;
   737	    if (tracked.owner === "capture") moveCapturePointer(event.pointerId, point.x, point.y);
   738	  }
